tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //shā chi/hā sbya 7717shā 0'aḥcuXng060jib jing 50sgyug33 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog

༄༅/ /snyan dgon sprul sku gsung rab mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i snang ba bzhugs/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis 'tshol sdud dag sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

sngon 'gro'i gtam/sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang ske/ dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing /grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi 1

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/ nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/ brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/ gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing /dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng / 1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshul du(khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skru na byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing / bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag ltar byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa sngaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub ston la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang /mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gtsigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og(dpe tshogs〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te / mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing /mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog 5

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang —/ phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min :ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang /legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/la / 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang /skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas 7

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed / khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas te/ bu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dug da lta bsam na 'di ni goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang / sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la/ tha na bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/ mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing /krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon 9

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med nga/ zhig yod par snyam zhing /dus mtshungs su dpe tshogs〉 'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing /kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 10

'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing /grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu/ /zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/

dkar chag/sngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)rtsom pa po'i mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/ (1)rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar gsol 'debs/ (1)rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/ (21)skyabs 'gro'i sdom tshig blo gsal snying nor/ (125)thar lam nyams su len lugs/ (131)rang rgyud skul 'debs/ (147)dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel nyung ngu/ (165)dbu ma rgyan 'grel rigs lam snang ba/ (211)yig drug sher phyin dang sbyar ba don gsal sgron me/ (337)zla ba'i lugs la yang log kun rdzob med tshul/ (349)'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin ut+pal phreng ba/ (355)'jigs byed cho ga sogs/ (385)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ (399)

rtsom pa po mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/rtsom pa po mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/mchog sprul smra ba'i seng chen blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho'am mtshan gzhan sprul sku gsung rab tu grags pa gang nyid yab stong dpon rta mgrin rnam rgyal dang yum che bo'i bza' sher mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bod rab tshes chu yos(spyi lo1903)lor mgo log 'bum pa khag gsum las stod dbang chen 'bum du sku 'khrungs/chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang bzhin mchog tu gsal zhing /dgung lo drug la slebs tsam nas bzo gso sgra tshad sogs thun mong gi rig gnas phal mo che dag rang stobs kyis mkhyen pa sogs so skye'i blo yul las 'das pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i khyad chos shin tu mang / dgung lo bdun gyi steng bla ma dpa' dbyangs kyi mdun nas tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te mtshan thub bstan zla ba bzang bor gsol/dgung lo bco lnga'i thog a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyis 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos bzung nas dpal snyan mo dgon gyi mi shigs rdo rje'i chos khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog brag dkar dge bshes blo bzang bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom 1

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa bzhes te mtshan blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtshor gsol/gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i mgon po rnam gnyis sogs lha dang bla ma che dgu'i lung gis 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i rnam rol tu yang yang bsngags pa ltar don la'ang gnas mod kyang / gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor rigs gsum sems dpa' mi yi sha tshugs su rol ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po a mdo dge bshes dang / brag dkar sku zhabs/ gter chen las rab gling ba bcas gtso byas pa'i gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas grub dam pa bcu phrag du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas/ lung sde snod gsum la thos bsam dang /lam bslab pa gsum la nyams len go rim ma 'chol bar mdzad/khyad par du rgyu bskal pa du mar legs par spyad pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi sa bon de rkyen bla ma'i byin rlabs cig char du zhugs pa'i stobs kyis yongs su smin pa'i tshul gyis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi gnas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don spyi dang / lhag par du zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gnad mtha' dag thugs nyams su chud nas/ don dam gnyug ma chen po rang byung ye shes kyi snang ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa la dbang 'byor bas spobs pa'i gter chen po brgyad yongs su grol/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom 2

rtsom pa po mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/gsum la thogs pa med pa'i smra ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/dpal snyan mo dgon gyi bstan bdag khri rabs gnyis pa dang /'dul 'dzin mkhan rabs gsum pa'i thugs 'gan bzhes nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa mchog tu spel/ sang sang dung dkar dgon pa dang lho rgyud se ra dgon/ dbang mda' dgon/ sder nang dgon / stong skyabs dgon/ rdo ri khrod dgon sogs dgon sde dang ri khrod bcu phrag du mar byon nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor cing bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dgu ba blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dang rwa rgya'i a lags legs bshad rgya mtsho sogs gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur rgya cher mdzad cing chos kyi bdud rtsi mnos/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen pos lung gis san 'o rul thu zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cod pan dang 'brel dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mkhan thob dang mtshungs pa'i mkhan po chen po'i go gnas kyi 'ja' sa gnang / bskal pa du mar chos kyi mched por skyes pa'i grogs skya shul dge slong thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs slob chen mang bo'i ngor legs par bshad pa'i gsung chos mang du spel/ rgyal khab gsar ba dbu brnyes rjes su'ang khong gis krung go gung khran tang la gong bkur dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs la gong bkur/3

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal khab la dga' zhing / chos lugs la gces pa'i mdzad spyod kyis mgo log bcings 'grol gyi las don la dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa nges can zhig thon pas/ rim pa khag gi tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi gdeng 'jog bzang bo thob/ mthar bod rab rgyal me bya(spyi lo1957)lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs/ gsung skyes slob ma'i tshogs la gtso bo mchog sprul blo bzang 'phags pa phun tshogs dang —/ dbang mda'i gyang sprul/ dung dkar mkhan po dam chos/ se ra'i yang sprul/ dom tsha gter ston tshe dbang mgon po/ rta shul mkhan a bhi/ lcang ma'i mkhan po rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sprul sku chos grags/ sprul sku ka dag skya shul dge slong thub bstan rgya mtsho/ glo bla bshad sgrub/ mchog sprul 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo ldan / sprul rin po che blo bzang kun mkhyen sogs mang du yod/dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsung rtsom gyi skor mang bo zhig dus kyi dbang gis mi bzhugs kyang da lta yod pa'i skor phal cher zhig sprul rin po che ka dag sogs slob chen rnams kyis nyar tshags mdzad nas dpal snyan mo dgon du bsdus yod pa la gtso bo 'di lta ste/ (dbu ma rgyan gyi gzhung 'grel rig pa'i lam gyi snang ba〉dang / 〈gsang sngags gsar rnying gi lta ba gcig tu sgrub pa dag snang nor bu'i me 4

rtsom pa po mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/longan / (sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rig pa'i 'khor lo〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung bshad kyi skor dang / (dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa gdung ba'i mun sel nor bu'i cod pan〉sogs bstod tshogs kyi skor/ (theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong〉sogs nyams len gyi skor dang / gzhan yang sgrub thabs cho ga'i skor dang /zhu 'phrin chab shog gi skor/ rtogs brjod rnam thar gyi skor/ zhal gdams nyams mgur gyi skor/ zin bris kyi skor sogs bsdoms pas pod gsum lhag cig bzhugs pa phal cher yongs su da reb kyi par du 'khod yod pa bcas so/ /zhes pa 'di'ang rang khul dpe rnying gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor rje btsun gang gi slob 'bangs kyi gral mtha' ba rmongs rtul nor sde yis gus par sbyar ba dge/1995lo'i zla8par/
rje 'jam dpa/ kyi rnam thar bzhung

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄ga /bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/༄/ /na mo gu ru/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum gyi dpal / /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rnam par yongs rol ba'i/ /blo gros bzang bos mngon mtho nges legs lam/ /ston mdzad 'jam dbyangs bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod bgrang yas bskal pa'i snga rol nas/ /rdzogs smin sbyangs te mngon par byang chub bzhin/ /gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dul sprul ba'i gar/ /bsam mi khyab par bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can ljongs 'di ru/ /zhi ba lha dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa sogs/ /rlabs chen bstan 'gro'i gsos sman cher mdzad pa'i/ /dam pa'i 'khrungs rabs mang la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par sku tshe 'di yi sngon rol tu/ /srin yul gnyis pa'i dmu rgod 'dul ba la/ /thugs bskyed 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo yi / /'gro don rgya chen mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon de phag la gshegs nas sa byi'i lor/ /phun tshogs dngos dgu tshang ba'i mtsho chen po/ /dam pas byin rlabs khri gshog rgyal mo'i 'gram / /gzigs pa rnam lngas gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /2

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/der yang sngon gyi bod kyi rigs 'khrul med/ /dus kyi mthar 'phos gnubs kyi gdung gtsang mar/ /yab yum chos ldan sngags 'chang rigs rgyud du/ /bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe gzhon nur gyur kyang sngon goms mthus/ /bag med spyod la nam yang mi 'jug pas/ /bdag nyid chen po ji bzhin zhi dul gyi/ /ngo mtshar gnas su gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgung lo lnga nas yab kyi pang bzung nas/ /nar son tshe na gong ma chen po yi/ /lung las 'dzin pa'i gsung gleng mdzad pa na/ /skyo shas dpag med 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lo bdun bzhes tshe a phyis klog slob bzhin/ /lha ldan gnas bskor jo shāka rnam gnyis drung/ /tshe 'dir dkor dang log 'tshor mi 'bag pa'i/ /smon lam shugs drag mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang mchog las srad brgyud bla rnam sogs/ /thob pas chos sgo thog mar phyes gsungs shing —/ /phyis kyang sku 'bum bzhugs tshe mang gsan pas/ /rigs bdag mchog tu bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri khrod 'dzin pa bsod nams rgya mtsho las/ /bslab tshigs snga ma dge tshul legs mnos te/ /blo bzang mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes/ /mtshan gyi cod pan dpyang la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgung lo bcu 3

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bar grogs 'ga'i gleng mo yi/ /rkyen gyis sngon goms bzang bo'i spyod pa'i mthus/ /bar chad bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gro zhes/ /ngo mtshar mgur dbyangs bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu gcig bgrang byar gzhan gyis bzlog na yang / /mi nyan rang gis bzhed pa'i mthus brtol te/ /gangs can lum+bi'i tshal mchog sku 'bum gyi//chos sde chen por zhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas mkhas pa'i dbang phyug har chen pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gtso gyur dge ba'i bshes / /mang thos tshul khrims ldan pa du ma las/ /bka' pod rnam lngar sbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe khyod kyi skyes thob shes rab tshad/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me 'dra 'o zhes/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bsngags pa yi/ /rnam dpyod mchog dang ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par gangs can mgon po'i rigs bdag mchog /mkhas pa'i mchog gyur blo bzang rab gsal las / /'grel chung don gsal gsan pas phar phyin gzhung / /theg mchog gdams par shar la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyab bdag dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho las/ /brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum 'dres a ti sha'i/ /rang lugs skyes bu gsum gyi lam srol gyi/ /man ngag chen po bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang rje btsun tā ra 4

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/nā tha yis/ /bsdus pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog brgya rtsa yi/ /gsang gsum byin rlabs rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /khyod thugs yur bar drangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang ngag dbang phun tshogs las/ /bslab tshigs phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs legs mdzad cing —/ /gsang ba 'dus pa bde mchog rnam gnyis sogs/ /gsang chen mang du gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par 'jam mgon bla ma'i snyan brgyud mchog /rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum 'khor lo yi/ /dbang bzhi mnos tshe mdo rgyud rab 'byams la mi 'jigs spobs pa brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /drung chen byams pa rgya mtsho'i spyan snga ru/ /sgra snyan la sogs rig byed thun mong dang —/ /thun min snyan brgyud chos bka' mang gsan te/ /gdams pa'i gter du gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtag tu ngu dang gzhon nu nor bzang ltar/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tshol ba lhur len zhing —/ /bsam sbyor rnam par dag pas legs bsten pas/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba tshugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog skyong sogs 'jig rten gyi/ /chos brgyad 'dor len don med nyid gzigs te/ /yang yang thugs thag chos la bcad nas ni / /kun spangs mdzad par bzhed la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgung 5

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/grangs nyer lngar lha sar phebs bzhed steng / /spyan ras gzigs dbang brag dkar rin po che'i/ /snyan pas thugs 'phrog bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bar khams lho brgyud phebs la gsol ba 'debs / /dam pa mchog de mjal nas yab sras gnyis/ /phan tshun mnyes gshin 'brel zab ngo mtshar sgos/ /lam rim gnyis dang theg chen blo sbyong sogs/ /gdams pa mang du bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang ri khrod chos grwa der zhugs nas/ /gsan bsam sgom pas byang chub sems sbyangs te/ /chu dang sran phye tsam gyis 'tsho ba yi/ /dka' spyad legs par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs / /snga 'gyur theg pa'i rang lugs 'dzin pa yi/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma grub pa'i dbang po sogs/ /dam pa du ma bsten te bka' gter gyi/ /ris med bdud rtsi bzhes la gsol ba 'debs//dam pa'i dbang phyug stong skor hu thog thus/ /gtso byas skal bzang dad ldan du ma la/ /chos bka' mang spel 'gro don rlabs po che'i /thog ma'i dbu brnyes gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas skyabs rje mchog gi bkas bskul bzhin/ /sum cu'i lo la srin yul gnyis pa ru / /dbang chen dpon gyi mchod gnas la phebs nas/ /dam chos gang 'dod bstsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rgyal sku lngas yang 6

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/yang gzim lam du/ /bskul bzhin sbas tshul 'chang ba'i grub mchog las/ /gsang chen snyan brgyud gdams pa legs bzhes te/ /mgon de'i 'phrin las spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /de skabs sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa yi/ /sems dpa' chen po rnam gnyis gsung mthun pas/ /dad 'dun mos gus tshad med kyis mchod de//dpal dge sprul skur bsgrags la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchod yon gnyis gas rgyal dbang la zhus te/ /sa mo lug la rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi/ /'dus sde'i rmang bting gzhi gsum phyag bzhes dang / /'chad nyan mang du mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan pa rgyas shing yul phyogs 'jigs skyob slad/ /ston pa'i sku gzugs gser zangs las grub pa/ /dge legs 'od mtshan stong 'bar legs bzhengs te/ /bsod nams mchod sdong bskrun la gsol ba 'debs / /sku keg bzlog dang zab chos bzhes pa'i phyir/ /grub brnyes las rab gling pa'i drung bcar tshe/ /zhing skyong lung gis zhabs tog la bskul bzhin/ /dgyes tshor dpag med mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab chos spyi dang yang gsang spu gri'i skor/ /gnang zhing phan tshun chos kyi skyes mang phul/ /sngon nas chos bdag skyes bu mchog nyid du/ /pad+ma'i lung gis bsngags la gsol ba 7

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'debs / /de mthus zi ling rgya 'khrug cher g.yos skabs/ /sku chas phogs nas bkrongs par thag bcad kyang / /gshed ma'i sems rgyud byams pas slar brlan te/ /gnod 'tshe'i ru mtshon bsnyil la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge rtse sems dpa' chen po'i sku don phyir/ /'jigs rung dmag gi yo lang 'gyed pa ru/ /sku srog bsdos nas tsham tshom med gshegs pa'i/ /snying stobs chen po mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgon gsar dga' ldan bkra shis chos gling du/ /dbang khrid lung gi bka' chos mang bstsal zhing / /mtshan nyid rtsod 'dzin chos grwa gsar btsugs sogs/ /snga phyir 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /sde dge lhun grub steng du dge ldan lugs/ /'gog pa'i gzhan phyogs rgol ba'i dpung gnon pa'i/ /'jigs med rtsod pa'i nga ro cher bsgrags nas/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos mdzod chen por 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung / /gcig las du mar 'char ba'i par gyi 'phrul/ /gsar du bskrun te dge ldan bka' srol che/ /snying stobs dpung bas btegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rma smar byang 'brog 'gro ba ches blun pa/ /bde sdug go log ming don mtshungs pa rnams/ /gangs can mgon po'i bka' 'bangs la sbyar te/ /'jigs med 8

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/skyabs sbyin mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po las/ /dgon sde khag bzhir thub bstan bshad sgrub srol / /legs par tshugs pa'i bka' lung bca' rtsa mchog /zhus bzhin dgyes pas gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /skabs der mi bzod snying rje'i gzhan dbang gis/ /yul khams 'khrug rtsod bsdum sogs thabs mang bo/ /mdzad la kun gyis dgra bzhin gshe na yang / /thugs brtse g.yo ba med la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnyed bkur dman zhing mi snyan sgrogs pa yi/ /sdug bsngal dang len bzod pa'i go bgos te/ /bcu gnyis lo bar chos dang 'jig rten gyis / /bskyangs nas chos gzhi btsugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bzhi bcu me yos rigs ldan khrir 'khod lor/ /rma nyin sgar gsar btsugs nas dam chos char/ /tshad med phab ste bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan che/ /slar yang bskrun par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhe gcig tsam na bstan 'gro gzhan dgongs skabs/ /dad ldan pho nyas legs par bskul ba bzhin/ /chab mdo dpal gyi sde chen byams gling gi/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon du phebs la gsol ba 'debs / /grwa tshang khag dgu'i dge 'dun spyi sger la/ /dngul 'gyed mang ja phul zhing 'phags chen zhabs/ /bsnyen bkur sri 9

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/zhus mnyes pa legs bstar nas/ /phan tshun dag snang thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /der ni mdo khams spyi khyab chen po yis/ /dngul srang lnga stong chig brgya'i thebs sbyar nas/ /blo gsal khrims ldan 'dus pa brgya brgal ba'i/ /mtshan nyid grwa tshogs tshugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas mchog der yang dam pa mang bsten nas / /phreng po'i dbang gi chu bo bzhes pa sogs/ /tshur la gsan zhing phar la spel ba yis/ /thub bstan sgron me sbar la gsol ba 'debs / /zhe bzhi'i lo la dbus 'gyur chos kyi mtshor/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser zhal mjal ba'i phyir/ /ngang ba pad+ma'i rdzing bur chas pa bzhin/ /dad gus spro bas phebs la gsol ba 'debs / /gdan sa gsum dang rgyud grwa stod smad dang / /dge 'phel phur lcog ri khrod la sogs par/ /dngul 'gyed mang ja'i mchod sprin rab spros te/ /bsod nams rlabs chen bsags la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprel lo cho 'phrul chen po'i tshes bzang la/ /sku gsung thugs rten cha gsum gyis drangs pa'i/ /maṇ+ḍal dngos gtsang dang bcas nor gling du/ /pad dkar 'chang ba mjal la gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe ring nas 'brel ba'i mnyes gshin thugs / /legs par sad bzhin dgyes tshor dpag med sgos/ /10

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/dbugs dbyung mchog gi skyes bzang lhug bstsal nas/ /bdag rkyen chen po gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' lung bzhin/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho nyin bzhin 'bab pa'i gnas/ /theg mchog chos kyi sgo mang phye ba yi/ /mkhas mang 'dus sder zhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' shod chos rgyal nyi ma lhun grub ces/ /gtong ba'i phyag yangs rnam dpyod mchog 'dzin pas/ /dad mos lhur blangs 'bras dkar spungs pa'i sder/ /ngo mtshar mchod ston 'gyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /dga' ldan khri chen shar byang chos rje gnyis/ /gtsor gyur bstan 'dzin dam pa du ma zhig /tshul bzhin bsten nas rgyu 'bras theg pa yi / /dam chos mang du gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /sman rtsis khang du dad 'dus brgya phrag la/ /rje btsun dam pa zhwa dmar rin po che'i/ /lam khrid zhib rgyas bstsal sogs bka' chos kyis/ /dad ldan smin grol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /yab gzhis srid blon chen pos dbu mdzad pa'i/ /dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi/ /'phrin las zhabs 'degs du mar rig byed ma'i/ /dngos grub gter kha phyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla sman mkhan po'i slob grwa la sogs par/ /sems can don byed bya ba bcu 11

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gcig gis/ /ji ltar 'tsham par grogs dan mdzad pa yis/ /kun gyis legs par bkur la gsol ba 'debs/ /de sogs dam pa'i yon tan ga bur dri/ /'grog pa med par 'phro ba legs shes nas/ /mchog dman bar ma'i skye bo mang bo yis/ /bsngags brjod gnas su gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnyed bkur snyan grags 'khor dang longs spyod la/ /nam yang chags pa'i go skabs ye med pa/ /lhan skyes nyid du thugs la 'khrungs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od lhung tsam nas / /lnga rig shes bya'i pad+mo gang dang gang / /'dzum ldan legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i gter grol ba'i/ /mkhas pa'i mchog gyur khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /sde lnga'i nyes pas ma gos so thar gyi/ /tshul khrims dri bsung sku yi khor yug ldang / /de bzhin sdom pa gzhan yang ches dag pa'i/ /btsun pa'i dbang phyug khyed la gsol ba 'debs / /ring nas rgyal sras spyod la goms pa'i mthus/ /rang gi grags pa sogs la mi blta bar/ /gcig tu gzhan phan spyod pa lhur bzhes pa'i/ /bzang bo'i dpal mnga' khyed la gsol ba 'debs / /lnga rig 'dzin pa'i mi dbang sde srid che/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la sogs sku'i phreng ba/ /du ma da lta bzhin du gsal ba yi /12

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/sngon gnas rjes dran mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod thugs shin tu sgam phyir mi sgrog kyang / /khyod kyis gang mdzad gzhan phan bya ba kun/ /phal cher don dang ldan par 'byung nges pa'i ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag tshe bsnyun 'don pa'i/ /gtar sreg rtsub mo'i rigs kyi dpyad gang la/ /zug rngu cung zad tsam yang mi mngon pa'i / /zab mo'i ting 'dzin brtan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus ring khyod dang lhan cig 'grogs na yang / /gcig tu gzhan la sman pa 'ba' zhig las/ /rang don sgrub pa'i go skabs mi mthong ba'i / /bdag nyid chen po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /nam yang khyod kyi sku la shig sro dang / /thugs la g.yo sgyu'i gya gyu phra mo'ang med / /rmi lam du yang zab mo'i don sgom pa'i/ /tshogs gnyis rgyun chad med la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgro btags tshig gis zol bstod ma yin par/ /byang sems phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags mang bos / /mtshon pa'i rgyal ba'i sras kyi brtul zhugs kyi/ /yon tan mngon du gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /chab mdo'i lam 'gag chu tshan la gzim tshe/ /gtong len dmigs pas der gnas srog chags grangs/ /khri phrag bco brgyad dga' ldan la skye ba'i/ /'gro 13

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/don lung bstan thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltas gzhal na khyod kyi gsang gsum gyi/ /mdzad pa kun kyang shin tu don che la/ /'gro don nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs skyo sangs phyir skad cig gzim yol ring / /bde gshegs gser thub brgyad bcu'i rtogs brjod glu / /gser g.yu'i sbrang ma gnyis kyis blang ba yi/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde gshegs de rnyed mnyes par byed pa yi/ /byang sems chos kyi blo gros mtshan mthun pa/ /rang nyid yin pa'i zhal bzhes mi mdzad kyang / /khyod nyid kho nar nges la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha dang bla mas dngos dang rmi lam du/ /zhal bstan gsung gi gdams pas dbugs dbyung sogs/ /ngo mtshar dag pa'i rnam thar mang mod kyang / /phal cher yon tan sbed la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgung lo bdun par lha ldan gnas bskor tshe/ /byang thang sgang du mkhas grub chos kyi rje/ /rje btsun pa dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gnyis/ /chos kyi bgro ba gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang nod pa'i tshe/ /mgon po che chung glog ltar 'khyug pa yis/ /sku las nad gdon gsol ba'i gzigs snang sogs/ /dgyes pa'i byin rlabs thob la 14

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/gsol ba 'debs/ /pad+ma dbang gi bsnyen bsgrub mdzad pa'i tshe/ /'jigs rung me lces gnas khang g.yogs pa yis/ /dngos grub mtshan ma sbar bar mi btub pa'i/ /grub brnyes skyes bur mtshon la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge thar lung du gcod dbang gsan pa'i tshe//bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro dngos su mjal/ /de yi rkyen las byang chub sems gnyis kyi/ /rtog pa me bzhin 'bar la gsol ba 'debs / /grub pa'i 'khor bsgyur pad+ma sam bha was/ /snga phyir rjes bzung byin rlabs gdams pa bstsal/ /'byung 'gyur lung bstan thub bstan spel ba'i grogs/ /bgyid pa'i zhal bzhes thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod thugs tha mal rtogs pas dben pa'i gshis / /'jam dpal rdo rje'i thugs dang bsre ba'i ngang / /'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor gyi/ /dgongs brgyud 'pho ba thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang gsang spu gri'i thugs dam gzhol ba'i tshe/ /bdun phrag zhag la bskal par bsgrub pa'i 'bras/ /thal 'byin rnam bzhi'i rtogs pa mngon gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /skabs shig gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje phur ba'i dbang bzhi'i chu bo bstsal/ /de yi rkyen dang sngon gyi las 'phro las/ /snyan brgyud man ngag thob la 15

sprul sku gsungarabakyigasunga'abum/ wa —gsol ba 'debs/ /grub dbang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po yis//shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar rjen phyung nas/ /rdo rje'i mgur bzhes byin rlabs lung bstan pa'i/ /ngo mtshar gzigs snang byung la gsol ba 'debs/ /'brong ri'i lha zhol nyi ma sbas pa dang / /'phrin las lha mos rjes bzung byin rlabs sogs/ /lha dang bla ma'i snang ba rtag 'char ba'i/ /dag pa'i skyes mchog khyed la gsol ba 'debs / /'jig rten lha klu gnod sbyin dregs pa can/ /du mas snga phyir gzugs bstan gus 'dud bcas/ /'phrin las bsgrub par dam bca' phul ba yi/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug khyed la gsol ba 'debs / /gzhan gyis bar chad byad phur btang ba'i tshe/ /dpal gyi lha mo khros pas nad rkyal che/ /phye ba gzim lam nyid du 'gog mdzad pa'i/ /snying rje'i gter chen khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku bsnyung bzhes tshe chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i sku yi 'od zer sner/ /rigs lnga'i khyung gis klu gdon za ba zhig /gzigs pas bsnyun las grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams gling kye rdor snang brnyan chen po'i drung / /gnyid kyi 'od gsal skabs na lha mchog des/ /bha dra nas bzung bcu gsum la sogs pa'i/ /snga phyi'i lung bstan mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa'i tshe 16

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/yang hor gyi rgyal khab che/ /lhag lha nga yi mthu las dbang bsdus bzhin / /da lta bstan 'gro'i don kyang de bzhin du/ /mdzod ces dbugs dbyung thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /te lo ba dang 'jam mgon bla ma mchog /mi phyed dag pa'i snang cha mngon gyur nas/ /dpal ldan bde mchog pad+ma gar dbang gi/ /gdams pa'i bdud rtsi thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyid kyi 'od gsal skabs na phra men ma'i/ /'jigs snang byung tshe bcu gsum lha'i 'khor lor/ /gdung bas gsol 'debs thogs med mdzad pa yi/ /rlung sems las su rung la gsol ba 'debs/ /nub phyogs nam mkhar pad+ma rā ga yi/ /them skas 'od zer dmar bo 'tsher ba ru/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi gar gzigs shing / /gsang ba'i glu dbyangs gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /de yi rkyen las bde chen skye ba'i tshul/ /mtha' bzhi'i skye ba'i shan dang ma 'dres par/ /gsang chen lam gyis tshe gcig sangs rgyas par/ /sgro 'dogs lhag med chod la gsol ba 'debs / /bgrang yas bskal bar tshogs gnyis goms pa yi/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod kyi rtogs pa'i tshad/ /gzhal bar dka' yang tshul bstan dben gsum gyi/ /rtogs pa legs par 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /da lta'i gzugs sku 'di dang gcig char 17

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/du'ang —/ /ri bo rtse lngas mtshon pa'i gnas du mar/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed dang brgyud gcig pa'i/ /sprul ba'i zlos gar mang la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na dge ba'i gshes gnyen lnga bcu lhag /tshul bzhin bsten nas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub mdzad pa yi/ /skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhe brgyad phag la rong bo dgon chen du/ /chibs bskyod mdo sngags chos bka' mang bo yis/ /phyogs de'i dad ldan skye bo'i mos 'dod bskangs/ /'gro don mthar phyin khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas re zhig dngos kyi gdul bya rnams/ /skal ba ji bzhin smin grol mdzad grub pas/ /da ni skyes chen 'degs kyang chog go zhes/ /gzhan don gzhan yang dgongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs bzang bo dang po'i nyin / /nyi shar dus na mchog gsum skyabs 'gro dang / /khas blangs tshul khrims rnam dag srungs shig ces/ /gsung gi tha ma bstsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ma thag tu rlung sems las rung khams / /snang gsum stong bzhi'i rim pas chos kyi sku/ /gnyis snang spros pa mtha' dag zad pa yi/ /'od gsal mngon du mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal de las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /18

bla ma'i rnam thar gsol 'debs/nam mkha' ji srid mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan zung 'jug rgyal srid la/ /longs spyod dang po'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid na bdag sogs sdug bsngal rnam gsum gyis //mnar ba'i 'gro gnas de srid sprul ba'i sku/ /rgyun mi 'chad par phan bde'i dpal ster ba'i/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar sku gsum go 'phang mngon mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma dang po'i mgon po mchog khyed kyis/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i rnam thar tshogs/ /dran bzhin sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas te/ /bdag nyid bran du 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /sdom gsum khas blangs dang 'gal nyes ltung dang / /sdig pa gzhan yang 'gyod sems drag pos bshags / /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas khyed rnams kyi/ /mdzad pa kun la snying nas rjes yi rangs/ /theg gsum spyi dang bye brag gsang chen gyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul/ /gang 'dul sprul ba'i bkod pa gzugs kyi sku/ /mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /'dis mtshon bdag gi rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /bstan 'dzin 19

sprulaskugasungarabakyigasung bum/dge 'dun tshogs rnams 'phel gyur cig /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang rgyas gyur cig /'gro ba'i phan bde yun ring gnas gyur cig /khyad par rnam rgyal chos kyi rdzing bu 'dir/ /mgon khyod sprul ba'i klu dbang dam pa mchog /yon tan nor bu'i gdengs ka 'bar ba'i sku/ /'jigs med seng khri'i khri la 'tsho gzhes shog /de mthus bshad sgrub lugs bzang chu bo 'bum/ /blo gsal rnams kyi yid la yongs 'khyil nas/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho chen por gnas gyur te / /thub bstan mi nub srog tu brtan gyur cig /bdag kyang tshe 'di'i sgo gsum bya ba yis/ /mgon khyod mnyes pa chen po legs grub ste/ /'chi tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i grogs dang bcas/ /dag pa'i zhing du khyed kyi zhabs drung du/ /skyes nas theg mchog chos la longs spyod cing / /nam mkha' ji srid mgon po mchog khyed kyi/ /bran du gyur nas 'gro don bzang bo'i spyod/ /lhan cig spyod pa'i rlabs chen mthu thob shog /shākya'i dbang bo 'dren pa 'od dpag med la sogs sbyar ro// //20
༄7/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar ba skal ldan snying gi gdung sel byin rlabs myur 'jug bdud rtsi'i zegs ma zhes bya ba bsngonags so/ /

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i dpal/ /dus mthar mi yi srid par rnam rol pa'i/ /mdo rgyud chos kun gzigs pa'i blo gros can / /yab rje mkhyen pa'i gter des ring du skyongs/ /ye shes sku ni chags thogs mi mnga' dus gsum shes bya gsal bar gzigs//gzugs sku'i bdag nyid sgrib bral thugs ni mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis lham mer spras/ /sku thugs mi phyed zung 'jug gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mkhyen ba'i gter kye bdag gi snying la da rol cig /mnyen lcug sor rtse'i 'phrul gyis brdungs pa'i rgyud mangs gsar pa'i rgyud re la/ /srid zhi'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'gyur kun rdzogs rgyal kun gsung gi rol rtsed 'dis/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las slong ba'i ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /bdag gi spobs pa nye bar brgyan te legs bshad 'chad pa'i grogs mdzod cig /rigs gsum gdul bya'i pad+ma kha phyes te/ /spang rtogs sprang rtsi'i 'bras bzang rnams 'god pa'i / /thub dbang nyin mor byed de'i zhabs kyi rdul/ /srid pa'i mthar yang spyi bo'i rgyan du 'dzin/ /rgyal ba nyid dang gsang gsum ro mnyam bzhin/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i zlos gar mi 'gog pa'i/ /rgyal tshab dam pa ma pham 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo gus 22

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/pa'i gtsug gis mchod/ /'dzam gling ma rig mun pa'i bla gos kyis / /g.yogs pa bsal te theg mchog 'od dkar gzis/ /khyab mdzad shing rta chen po rnam gnyis zhes/ /grags pa'i zla ba bdag gtsug mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /zab rgyas brgyud pa rin chen mu tig phreng —/ /thub bstan chos kyi 'dun sa mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /rtsod dus ngo mtshar rnam thar 'bum 'dzin pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po rim par byon la 'dud/ /khyad par gangs can ljongs 'dir snga phyi ru/ /thub bstan shing rta 'dren pa'i kha lo pa/ /za hor paṇa chen rnam gnyis sras bcas kyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mor dwangs pas phyag 'tshal lo / /dus kyi mtha' 'dir mdo sngags bstan pa'i klung / /snyigs ma'i tshad pas skem la srog sbyin te/ /ljongs 'dir bka' drin zla med mdzad pa po/ /'jam mgon ma dros gnyis par cis mi dad/ /mgon de'i phrin las thub bstan dge mtshan 'bum/ /ldan pa'i ring lugs li khri'i chu gter ngogs/ /bshad sgrub khrus kyis brel ba'i mkhas grub phreng / /nam mkha'i skar tshogs gnyis par su mi gus / /blo bzang chos kyi 'dun sa mdzes pa'i mkhas btsun bzang bo'i yon tan brgya/ /phyur bur spungs pa'i mkhyen brtse'i sgyu 'phrul shin tu rnyed dka'i nor bu bzhin/ /bstan 'dzin mkhas mang rgya 23

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mtsho'i dbus na lung rtogs rin thang gzhal med pa'i/ /'dren rmechog dpag bsam ljon pa'i grib bsil byang chub thob kyang bsten par 'os/ /'jam mgon snyan brgyud man ngag bdud rtsi yis / /yongs bkang zab rgyas gdams pa'i ka la shas/ /phra rags dri ma 'khrud pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rnam gnyis phyag gi yul / /brtse chen sprin gyi glang po'i phang ba nas/ /yon tan sbrang chang stsol pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan gyur thams cad kyi/ /zhabs rdul zla ba ji bzhin gtsug gi rgyan/ /gang zhig ngo mtshar gtam gyi me tog thub bstan skyed tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan / /rgyan drug la sogs 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams kyi rjes 'gro'i rnam thar che/ /che ba bzhi ldan rtogs brjod phreng ba gang gi mgul na yongs 'dzin pa/ /pa sangs ltar dkar dkar bo'i chos kyis de ni nyin bzhin 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de slad gna' bo'i sgrung rgyud tsam min par/ /rgyal bstan rin chen phyag mtshan bzhes pa'i tshul / /bla ma'i rnam thar dri med mchod sdong 'di/ /sde snod gsum bzhin thar 'dod 'jug ngogs yin/ /'on kyang snyan tshig gzi 'od 'phro ba yi/ /legs bshad nor bu brgyu bar mi nus mod/ /sgro skur 'dam gyis sbags pa dang bral ba'i/ /rnam thar pad+ma'i phreng ba 24

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/'bad de bgyi/ /thub bstan lnga brgya phrag bcu'i drug pa'i nang / /thub dbang bstan pa'i sgron me jo 'brom gnyis/ /thub bstan spel phyir slar yang byon 'dra ba'i/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs/ /mkhas pa'i grags snyan phyogs kyi rna bar rtsen/ /btsun pa'i rnam thar nye bar 'khor la 'gran/ /bzang bo'i spyod pa rgyal sras kun dang mnyam/ /yab rje'i rnam thar yon tan rgya mtsho yin / /thos bsam skya rengs 'phrul gyis drangs pa yi/ /mdo rgyud nyams rtogs nyi ma 'od po che/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rlabs chen bsgrubs pa'i tshul/ /yab rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs yin / /gnyen la ma zhen mdza' bshes ring du spangs/ /dgra la mi sdang gnod byed yan par gtong / /dgra gnyen spang blang nam yang mi mnga' bas/ /yab rje'i rnam thar chos brgyad ro snyoms yin/ /gser dngul dar zab rta phyugs 'bru rigs sogs/ /nor la nor gyi 'du shes dam pa'i sgos/ /nam yang gsog brun cha tsam mi mdzad pas/ /yab rje'i rnam thar chags med bya btang yin/ /chos brgyad chang gis myos pa'i gzhan dbang gis/ /log 'tsho'i dkor gyis mchod sbyin brgya rtsom pa'i/ /gzhan don brdzus mas cha tsam ma sbags pas/ /yab rje'i rnam thar dri med gtsang ma yin/ /'gro ba 25

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nyam thag re re'i phyir yang ni/ /zas gos gnas mal mkho dgu'i yo byad cha/ /mi phangs lhug par gtong ba'i phyag yangs pa'i/ /yab rje'i rnam thar 'jung pa skrag byed yin/ /lnga rig shes bya'i chu bo ci mchis pa/ /rnam dpyod hub kyis btung la rangs ba yis/ /nam yang thos pas ngoms pa ma mchis pa'i/ /yab rje'i rnam thar mkhas pa mgu byed yin/ /sdom gsum chos kyi khang bzang yangs pa'i nang / /bag yod 'gros kyis dal bur rgyu ba'i thugs/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin ngang du rtsen pa yi/ /yab rje'i rnam thar bstan 'dzin dga' skyed yin/ /bde med sdug bsngal brgyas gang mtha' 'khob che/ /'di 'drar phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'dzugs la srog 'dor tsam gyis dka' spyad sogs/ /yab rje'i rnam thar bya dka'i spyod pa yin/ /gzhan don lhun po phrag par thogs pa yi/ /rlabs chen spyod la nam yang mi zhum par/ /snying stobs go cha rgyun mar bgos pa'i tshul/ /yab rje'i rnam thar theg mchog mdzod khang yin/ /rang don 'du byed phra mos ma bslad par / /thub bstan spel dang 'gro don khur bzhes pa'i/ /gsang gsum mdzad pa rgya che grangs mang bas/ /yab rje'i rnam thar gzhan phan gter chen yin/ /de phyir tha snyad dri bzang 'dzin pa yi/ /ro 26

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/'dzin pad+mo stes kyis rnyed skabs 'dir/ /mgon 'di'i yon tan rgya che'i gzhal med khang / /mdzes par brgyan pa'i mchod sprin cis mi byed/ /legs par gnas pa'i yon tan brjod kyi zhen ltas sgro 'dogs dug bzhin spangs/ /nyes skyon nges par spangs pa brjod kyi log ltas skur 'debs yong mi byed/ /sgro skur spangs te rnam thar rtsom gyi spyi brtol bskyed de zol bstod min/ /de phyir dad ldan nyan par rigs kyi phyogs re'i blo yis 'dor mi rigs/ /dam pa'i mdzad bzang rtsi bcud brgya ba'i gtam/ /phrag dog dug can snying la mi 'bab kyang / /gzur gnas blo gsal tshogs kyi dga' ston du/ /'bad pas spel gyis dad ṅge'i gsos su zungs/ /zhes shis par brjod pa dang / phyag bya ba dang / dngos po nges par bstan pa'i sgo rnams sngon du btang nas/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mdo rgyud rin po che rnams kyis dgongs pa 'grel ba la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i rgyal bstan mtha' dag lhag bsam gyi khyogs la blangs te rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar bskyal bas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i sgo nas thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag tu bzhugs pa/ nges pa'i don 27

sprulagagasungarabakyi gsung 'bum/du na rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs gcig tu bsdus pa'i spyi gzugs chen po/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smros te/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bla ma rin po che/ 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang po zhes grags pa'i mu khyud dkar pos gangs can gyi ljongs phal mo che mngon par 'khyud pa'i bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyi rnam par thar ba rgya mtsho lta bu zhig mchis pa las/ 'dir rang gis gang shes ku sha'i rtse mos blangs pa'i chu thigs tsam zhig 'chad pa la gsum/ sku'i skye ba snga ma'i tshul mdo tsam gleng ba dang / sku tshe de nyid kyi rnam par thar ba cung zad rgyas par phye ba dang / rnam thar gyi don bsdus nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'phags bod kyi bdag nyid chen po du mar 'khrungs pa'i rabs spyi dang / bye brag srin yul gnyis pa sogs kyi bstan 'gro'i don la ji ltar thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus so/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sngon bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i ngo bor mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas su zin kyang / da dung 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sangs rgyas byang 28

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/semashānyanarangadage ba'i bshes gnyen sogs sprul ba'i rnam rol tshad gzung du med la/ /sems can gyi khams la phan pa dang bde ba'i bgo skal rang rang gi bsod nams kyi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin 'gyed par mdzad pa zhig yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul ba'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis / /sogs nas/ yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes dang / mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las / gang gi srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod / /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang bye brag tu bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can 'di nyid kyi bstan pa la/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sprul ba'i rnam rol ji snyed cig byung ba ni tshu rol mthong ba'i blos dpag par mi nus mod/ rtsod bral gyi lung gis grub pa ltar rags rim zhig 'god na/ ji skad du dbu ma snying po las/ gdul bya ji bzhin sprul ba yi/ /sprul pa yis ni phyogs bkang nas/ /bstan pa 29

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rin chen char babs pas/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba bskyed//ces gsungs pa dang mthun par rim dang cig char gyi sku yi bkod pas thub bstan rin po che'i srog mthud cing skye dgu'i phan bde bskrun pa'i tshul la/ thog mar shing rta chen po klu sgrub zhabs kyis mi yi sha tshugs can gyi 'grel byed gzhan la ma brten par yum gyi dngos bstan zab mo'i lta ba'i shing rta'i lam srol gang la brten nas phye ba'i slob dpon lha'i bu blo gros rin chen nam blo gros seṅge dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dpal sha ba ri dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dngos su rjes su bzung ste bstan pa 'di la theg pa chen po thun mong min pa rlabs chen spyod brgyud kyi bka' srol chen po 'byed pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha dang /bod 'dir bstan pa snga dar la bod 'bangs kyi phyug dbul lan gsum du snyoms par mdzad pa'i chos skyong ba'i rgyal bo lha sras mu ne btsan po dang / phyi dar la bka' gdams bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chen po jo bo rje lha cig gi sras kyi thu bo rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i nang mdzod chen po sgyu 'phrul gsang sngags snying po'i bka' babs zur chung pa shes rab grags pa/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i rgyan gcig dpal 30

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/ldan sa skya pa'i 'jam dbyangs dngos byon gong ma lnga las ti shri 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'ishing rta'i srol 'byed bsam yas pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po / rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i nang thugs kyi sras gcig pu mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma/ gsang chen slob bshad kyi bstan pa'i bdag po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo gsum ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i gar du bzhengs pa 7 rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga ba chen po'i chos srid 'phrin las kyi ba dan gang la gtad pa'i mi yi dbang phyug sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ dbang phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po rnams su 'khrungs nas/ rgyal bstan rin po che la bshad sgrub kyi phyag rjes da lta'i bar du yang mngon sum du gyur ba re bzhag nas bstan 'gro'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad do/ /'di rnams ni gzhon nu nor bzang ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa lhur len pa'i rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi mkhan thog dang po bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs nyi ma rin po che nas yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rdo rje 'chang rang nyid kyis sam ṭar btab pa'i mtshan tho ltar bkod la/ de yang zhal snga nas/ nga rang dam pa 31

sprul sku gsungarabakyigasunga'abum/ wa wa —'di dag yin pa ga la rung yang de thams cad la 'brel ba re yod las che/ 'on kyang dam pa de dag gi ngo bor mos te gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'byung bar the tshom mi dgos zhes gsungs so / /gsung 'di ni deng sang rang la gdeng ci yang med par rnyed bkur snyan grags la re bas rang nyid dam pa'i skyes bu che ge mo 'di dang 'di 'dra yin no zhes sgrog pa la ya mi nga ba'i yul srol ngan pa 'gog pa'i ched du gsungs pa ma gtogs don du na dam pa de dag tu zhal gyis bzhes pa yin la/ rje btsun 'di nyid dam pa de dag yin pa ni shin tu rung ste/ ji ltar sbas kyang sba bar mi btub pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan ni ga bur gyi dri bzhin du ldang zhing / de yang tshe 'dir tshegs kyis gtso bor bsgrubs pa tsam ma yin par tsan dan dang de'i dri bzhin ngam ngam shugs kyis byung ba'i lhan skyes yin pas mkhas grub du ma'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba sngon song yin pa ni/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug des/ rgyu la rang bzhin ji snyed cig /med na mi 'byung 'bras bu ni/ /gtan tshigs zhes gsungs pa ltar shes sla la/ bgrangs ma thag pa'i dam pa de dag yin pa la'ang gnod byed med pa'i phyir ro/ /yid ches pa'i lung gi shes byed gzhan yang yod de/ rtsod bral dus babs kyi grub 32

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/shā'igatera'abyin chen po o rgyan las rab gling pa'i gter lung las / dang po sā ra badz+ra shrī/ zhes pas sde srid dang / 'bri rgyud glang ri'i phyogs kyi bla ma rdo rje'i mtshan can dang / 'chad 'gyur dpal dge sprul ba'i sku sogs su bsngags shing / rigs pa'i 'byung gnas gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos skyong bse khrab pa'i lung gis mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen par bsngags pa sogs dang /sde srid pa'i dus kyi bya byed phal mo che da lta bzhin dran par grub dbang gter chen rin po cher dngos su zhal gyis bzhes 'dug pa sogs dang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul du grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba 'ga' res gleng tshul ngo mtshar ba yang yod do / /rgyal sras zhi ba lha dang / sha wa ri sogs su yang grub ste/ ris med kyi bstan pa'i dpal mgon chen po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/ phyi ltar rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha/ /nang ltar grub pa'i dbang phyug sha wa ri/ /gsang ba 'phags mchog sdug bsngal rang grol dngos/ /zhes dpal sprul tshang la bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na khyod kyis 'jam pa'i dbyangs su bshad pa dang / 'dir spyan ras gzigs su bshad pa gnyis mi 'gal lam zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ bka' gdams glegs bam rin 33

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/po che'i lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ de yang rigs gsum mgon po las/ /tha dad nyid du ga la 'gyur/ /sems can kun la spyan ras gzigs/ /'di ni snying rje byams pa'i rigs/ /nga ni snying rje chen po yin/ /nga la spyan ras gzigs zhes grags/ /zhes pa nas/ de yang rigs gsum mgon po nyid/ /phyogs su ma zad dngos yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan rje bdag nyid chen po'i dngos slob phyogs mthar bstan pa'i dar chen btsugs pa'i smad shes rab bzang bo dang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa rnam gnyis yin par yang dpal kye rdo rjes rmi lam du zhal gzigs te gsungs pa'i tshul ngo mtshar ba yod do/ /de lta na mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dang dus mnyam pas mi 'thad do snyam na/ so skyes rang ga pa'i skye ba len tshul ltar ma yin par byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po pa la yang sprul ba brgya phrag cig char 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ dper na kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i sku phreng du grub pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / rigs pa'i dbang phyug phyogs kyi glang po gnyis su dus mnyam du 'khrungs par gsungs pa bzhin 'gal ba med do/kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / smin 34

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/gling gter chen o rgyan gter bdag gling pa dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos sde 'debs pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo ju nang wang rnams/ jo nang kun mkhyen phyi ma tā ra nā tha'i rnam 'phrul yin pa'i lo rgyus tshad ma yod pa ltar kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon po'i rnam 'khrul bcas dang / kun mkhyen de nyid la sku chung ngu'i dus nas 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sngon gnas rjes dran shin tu gsal por yod pa ltar/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan sogs rim dang cig char gyi sprul ba'i bkod pa drag po'i blo'i ra ba las 'das pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i rnam thar ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa kho na'i spyod yul lags pas dad pa dang gus pas rjes su yi rangs dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par bya'o / /de bzhin du mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa nas mkhas grub lha dbang blor 'khrungs pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran sku chung ngu'i dus nas yod pas de ltar zhal bzhes gnang nas mkhas grub chos rjer grags pa'i lo rgyus ltar mkhas grub lha dbang blo dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa 'gro mgon sa skya parnyi ta dang thugs rgyud gcig par bshad pa yod pas sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal 35

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mtshan dpal bzang bo sogs so so'i rnam thar dang lo rgyus gang thon gyi 'phags bod kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang bo zhig rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid kyi sprul ba'i rnam 'gyur du bzung nas bstan 'gro'i don ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams kyang dad pa'i gsos su spel bar bya ste/ de la yid ches kyi lung rigs kyi rgyab brten mang du yod cing / rang gi blo skyon tsam min pas gnod byed ci yang mi rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag ni dad pa 'phel ba'i sgor ci 'gyur du bkod pa las/ rang gi bla ma la yon tan gang yang snang rgyu med pa dang / yon tan med par bsam nas 'phags bod kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi ngor u tshug gis yar sbyar ba ni min pas blo gsal rnams kyis dmigs phyed par byas te dad pa 'phel ba'i sgor 'gyur nges pa bya dgos so/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu mtha' 'khob srin gling 'di sogs su thugs ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'khri ba rgyang ring du bsrings nas sku tshe hril po sgrub la gzhol zhing nang du byang chub kyi sems gnyis legs par 'byongs pa'i sgo nas grub ba'i sar gshegs kyang thugs shin tu sgam pas yon tan mtha' dag bum nang gi mar me ltar sba bar mdzad pa sogs bka' 36

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/gdams bstan pa'i sgron me 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang sgo kun nas mtshungs pa'i byang sems bdag nyid chen po o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po zhes mtshan snyan pa'i gzegs ma grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i skye bo mtha' dag gi rna bar 'jeb cing yid la sim pa de nyid du sku 'khrungs te mgo log srin yul gnyis pa 'di sogs su phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che dar ba'i thugs bskyed mdzad cing / de dang dus mnyam par rje bdag nyid chen po'i dngos kyi slob ma 'dab ma yon tan dpal gyi sku phreng rim byon gyi nang tshan lab mdo rgyud mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje zhes grub pa'i snyan grags phyogs kyi rna rgyan du 'god pa de nyid du 'khrungs te yang yul dus 'dis mtshon par rgyal bstan rin po che dar ba'i thugs bskyed rgya cher mdzad cing / rnam pa gnyis mas yul 'dir zhabs kyis bcag pa sogs rten 'brel mthu can du mdzad do/ /gzhan yang dam pa de gnyis su ma zad rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis dus der 'dzam gling 'di'i rgya bod hor gsum sogs dang /phyogs bcu'i zhing gzhan dpag tu med pa nas sku'i rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pas dmu rgod gdul dka' ba'i sems can gyis 37

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gang pa'i mtha' 'khob las kyang mtha' 'khob/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa mang pos spangs pa'i yul ngan 'di lta bu'i gdul bya 'dul pa la thugs bskyed kyi go cha bzhes par gor ma chag ste/ de lta bu'i sku'i rnam 'gyur yod par tshad mas grub cing de thams cad kyang phyogs re tsam min par 'jig rten gyi khams mang bo'i gdul bya'i gzugs dang / bsam pa dang / dbang po sogs so sor mkhyen pa'i spyan dang / mngon shes la dbang 'byor ba dang / gdul bya mu rgod la lhag par brtse ba sha stag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rje btsun bla ma mchog gi sku'i mchod sdong gcig nyid rgyal ba dang rgyal sras grangs med pa'i sprul ba'i skur bzhugs pa'i tshul shin tu shes sla bas gu dog mi dgos par gsal lo/ /yang 'ga' zhig de dag ni khyod kyis sgro btags par zad kyi rgyu mtshan yang dag pa ci yang med pas mi 'thad do zhe na/ don 'di ni 'di ltar dpyad de/sngar phan btags pa la ma ltos par rnam pa kun tu sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i sems can gyi don kho na lhur len pa'i sgo nas gzhan don gyi bya bar sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa lta bu'i sangs rgyas byang sems zhes bya ba zhig yod dam med/ yod na de dag gis sems can so so'i khams la skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i bkod pa spyi dang /38

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/khyad par du da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus sems can shin tu sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i thugs bskyed lhag par che ba'i sgo nas sems can 'dul ba'i mdzad pa dus las mi yol ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur dag ma dag rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i sgo nas dngos su mjal rgyu yod dam med/yod na deng sang gangs can gyi ljongs 'di lta bu na lung rtogs kyi yon tan la dbang 'byor ba'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don chen po khur du bzhes pa'i skyes bu dam pa gdul bya'i dpal mgon du gyur ba 'di rnams yin dang / de las logs su mi yi sha tshugs can min pa'i lha lta bu re 'ong rgyu yod pa yin/ kho na re/ logs nas 'ong rgyu med mod/ 'on kyang khyod kyi bla ma de lta bu'i gdul bya'i dpal mgon yin pa'i tshul ci yod ce na/ bden mod/ 'di la mi 'khrul ba'i gtan tshigs mdor bsdu na ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar chen mo gsum zhig yod de/ skyes thob kyi yon tan rgya che ba tsan+dan gyi dri bzhin lhan skyes su yod pa dang / sku tshe 'dir sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan thos bsam sgom gsum gyi mdzad pa shin tu grangs mang ba dang / de dag thams cad kyang rang 'dod kyi zhen 'khris med par gzhan don kho na'i gzhan dbang du gyur ba ste/ 'chad 'gyur 39

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/las shes par nus pas 'dir ma spros so/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang por 'khrungs pa ni/bshad ma thag pa ltar grub dbang gter chen rin po che'i lung dang / rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang / dpal sprul rin po che rang gi dngos slob sku tshe sgrub la gzhol ba'i kun spang bya bral gyi dbang phyug bshad sgrub dge legs dpal bzang dang / yang dngos slob dam pa sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pa'i grub dbang dge rtse mchog sprul rin po che ngag dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po dang / 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i yang sprul grub dbang kun bzang bde chen rdo rje rnams kyis snga phyi mthun par mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa yin la/ rje btsun dam pa rang la yang sngon gnas rjes dran yod pa 'ga' re nyag rong ba gter ston rin po cher zhus pa phyis su khong gi zhal nas thos so/ /des na dam pa de nyid kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus shig brjod na/ mdo smad sgang drug gi ya gyal 'bri rgyud sde dge sa skyong chen po'i byang rnam thos sras kyi bang mdzod du grags pa'i rdza stod 'brog sde chen po'i nang /dpa' bo las rab rtsal dang / 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu sogs skyes bu dam pa mang bo 'khrungs pa'i yul der rgyal thog zer ba'i 40

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/rigs rus gtsang mar rab byung bcu ba'i sa pho 'brug la sku 'khrungasam/ dbu gdugs ltar 'dug pa dang / zhal ras pad+ma ltar rgyas pa sogs gzugs byad bzang la snyun nyung ba/ chung ngu nyid nas shes rab dang snying rje che ba/ snying stobs che la spobs pa mtho ba sogs yon tan du ma'i rgyan dang ldan par bzhugs shing / 'bri klog kyang dka' ba med par mkhyen/ rdo bla 'jigs med skal bzang gis dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyi sprul ba'i skur ngos bzung ba la phyis su grub dbang kun bzang gzhan phan rin po che nas kyang mthun 'gyur dang bcas/ ngas klong chen snying thig gi bstan pa yongs rdzogs dgongs gtad smon lam dang bcas pas gtad pa yin zhes mtshan o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po zhes gsol te dgyes bsngags mdzad/ de nas rim pas gsan sbyang ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul la/ dang po rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i thugs sras rdza 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i drung nas klong snying sngon 'gro'i lam khrid snga phyir tshar nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam gsan te khrid sbyangs yang de'i grangs snyed mdzad/ gzhan yang rtsa rlung dang rdzogs chen gyi khrid gnad smin dang / snga 'gyur bka' ma'i skor sogs mang du gsan/ mkhas pa 'jigs med 41

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/skal bzang dang kun mkhyen gyi dngos slob bla ma 'jigs med ngo mtshar rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas sogs las kyang ngal gso skor gsum/ spyod 'jug rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po/ rig gnas skor 'ga' re dang / zhe chen dbon sprul mthu stobs rnam rgyal las bka' 'gyur gyi lung dang sgra rig pa gsan/ gang gsan de dag lan re tsam gyis thugs su chud cing / gtso bo bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang kun mkhyen snga phyi sa paṇa rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po sogs ris med kyi bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyi legs bshad la dpe gzigs kho na drag 'grus su brtson par mdzad pas nyin re zhing mkhyen rtogs zla ba yar ngo ltar gong 'phel du gyur/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'jigs med ye shes rdo rje'i drung du bcar nas kyang zab chos mang du gsan zhing / khyad par du khong gis rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad skabs shig khyi rgan zhes drag shul gyi spyod pas bsdigs te tshar bcad pa la brten nam mkha' g.ya' bral ltar kun rtog gi rnyog pa dwangs pa'i 'od gsal gyi rig pa la bogs chen po thon te rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po bsod nams dpal dge dang lhan cig klong snying rig 'dzin rtsa rlung la yang khrid sbyangs rgyun ring 42

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/mdzad / dpal dge dbon po gshegs rjes bla brang bsdus nas kun spang kun tu rgyu'i tshul gyis gnas nges med du phebs/ rdzogs chen gdan sar yun ring tsam bzhugs te rdzogs sprul rin po che mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje dang / rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer sogs las dam pa chos kyi bdud rtsi mang du bzhes/ ru dam yang dben gshin rje'i phug dang tshe ring phug sogs su thugs dam mdzad pas byang chub sems gnyis dang / khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa la rtsal thon/shugs chen stag mgor yun ring tsam bzhugs nas/ bka' 'gyur rin po cher zhib tu gzigs shing bklag pas mdo sde mang po thugs la zin par gsungs/ de mtshungs a ru'i nags dang / rdi chung phug sogs ri khrod dben pa rnams su thugs dam kho na lhur bzhes skabs shig mkhyen brtse'i sgar ba dar mdo nas btegs te g.yu rtse'i gnas mdun du bzhugs pa la mjal/ dgyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing yum bka' bde chen rgyal mo'i dbang zhig zhus pa yang dgyes bzhin gnang zhing / gnas der tshogs 'khor zhig gi tshe de ring smon lam ci btab 'grub pas thob gsungs pa la / brjod gzhi med pa'i stong skad bstod ra gcig /phan pa med 43

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ —pa'i che bkyag bkur bste gnyis/ /rnam smin lci ba'i dad rdzas 'bul nor gsum/ /spangs nas khyi rgan ci bzhin 'chi nus shog /ces thugs smon gnang bas sku mched gsum sogs bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams bzhin du chags med bya btang gi rgyal por bzhugs par/ de tshe mkhyen brtse rin po che nas dgung grangs brgyad cur 'tsho ba'i lung bstan dang 'grel tshad don ldan gyi dbugs dbyung sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i bka' lung mang po gnang / rdzogs chen shrī sedha'i chos grwa sogs su mngon rtogs rgyan dang rtsa ba shes rab/ mdo sde rgyan/ mngon pa mdzod dang / yar lung pad+ma bkod sogs su sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po/yon tan mdzod/ sdom gsum rnam nges sogs mang du gsungs/'dzi ka dzam thang gi chos sde sogs su don 'grel gyi steng nas rgyud bla ma rgyas par gsungs shing gtsang ba ngag dbang chos 'byor las sbyor drug gsan/ rdza rgyal dgon du byams chos dang / rtsa shes/bud bha pā li ta/ spyod 'jug yon tan mdzod/ bzad spyod sogs mang po gsungs/ phyogs yas mar thams cad du sa dge rnying gsum gyi chos sde mang por spyod 'jug gi bshad pa shin tu mang po gnang bas spyod 'jug sa dar rdo dar du btang ste theg pa chen 44

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/po'i bstan pa la phyag rjes chen po mdzad cing / 'gro ba shin tu mang po zhig theg pa chen po'i rigs can du bsgrubs pa dang rigs sngar yod mang po zhig kyang gong nas gong 'phel du sad par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang rdza rgyud dang mgo gser gyi yul sogs su dge sgrub sdig spangs kyi chos mang po gnang ste 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ sku tshe smad du sngar dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyis rdza ma mo'i mdar rdo 'bum chen mo bzhengs nas da dung skye ba phyi mar da lta'i 'di las rgya mi chung ba'i kha gso byed rgyu yin gsungs pa ltar yig drug gi rdo 'bum shin tu rgya chen po bzhengs shing / mgo log gi jag rkun rgyun chad pa'i don du thugs bskyed rgya chen po mdzad cing / o rgyan snang srid zil gnon gyi sku zhig rdo la bzhengs nas shar du zhal bstan pa bzhag par mdzad pa dang /spyod 'jug 'chad skabs/ mgron po lam zhugs thams cad la/ /phyogs rnams thams cad bde bar shog /gang gi don du 'gro byed pa / /de 'bad mi dgos 'grub gyur cig /ces dang / sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang / /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub pa dang / /zhes pa dag gi thad du mgo log gi jag pa dang / kha char 'gog mkhan tsho la go bzlog ste smon lam 'debs dgos zhes 45

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsungs par grags so/ /bsgrubs 'bras kyi gtso bo bsgom rtags nyon mongs chung ba zhes grags pa ltar smyo shul lung rtogs la rgyud la nyon mongs mi skye ba'i gsung mthon po bya'o/ /thun mong gi yon tan gyi dbang du byas na yang mngon shes rgya chen po mnga' ste/ ru dam gshin rje'i sgrub phug tu bzhugs skabs grogs rgya rong pa zhig la snga ma'i tshe rabs brgya phrag lhag dran pa dang / sngon dus grub chen nag po spyod pa grong khyer du byon skabs nga rang grong khyer gyi smad 'tshong mar gyur bas gser gyi gdu bu zhig phul pa de tshun chad du blun rmongs phag thom lta bur nam yang ma skyes pa zhig kyang dran gsungs pa la/ rdza rgyal du bzhugs skabs shig 'ga' res gza' lnga'i ri mo ma song ba dris pas zho gsol zhor du brang la ri mo 'ga' re bris nas 'di ltar dgos zhes zhal bkod gsal bar gnang ba la/ a bu tshang de tsam ri mo'i byang cha nam song zhes dris pas nga sde srid kyi dus/ kha spu zhol le be+eḍūr dkar bo brtsam pa dran gsungs pa sogs yod do/ /lhag pa'i lha ni rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la mdzad de/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'ba' zhig thugs dam gyi mthil du 'dzin cing shes rab shin tu che la/ de nyid kyis rjes su bzung ba'i gsung gi nyams kyang / rab dkar ke 46

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/la sha dpal mdzes pa la/ /be+eḍūr+ya thor tshugs bkod dang gang mtshungs pa/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes 'dzin mtshungs med lha / /tshe rabs phreng ba rnams su slar yang skyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu sogs yod par snang / dus nam yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kho na thugs dam dge sbyor thams cad kyi rtsa bar 'dzin cing / skye bo mchog dman thams cad bsam pa bzang po bzang po gyis/ 'di las gal che ba med gsungs pa ni jo bo chen pa'i rnam thar dang mtshungs shing / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi gzhi ma byang chub kyi sems rin po che yin kyang / snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus kyi dbang las da lta'i phal cher zhig byang chub kyi sems dgos mi dgos kyi som nyi za ba sogs ya nga ba'i ngang tshul mang mod/bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni/ yod na sangs rgyas bsgrub la des chog cing / /med na sangs rgyas bsgrub la thabs chas pa'i /sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sa bon ma nor ba'i/ /rnam dag byang chub sems mchog skye bar shog /ces dben pa'i ri ngogs rnams su rang gis theg chen blo sbyong kho na la thugs dam gtso bor 'don cing / gdul bya gzhan dag kyang de ltar bkri ba'i sgo nas byang chub kyi sems la bcos min gyi myong ba thon pa smyo shul lung rtogs 47

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang —/ 'gya ba mdo sngags sogs mang po zhig yod par yongs su grags la/ byang chub kyi sems gdams pa'i mthil du mi 'dzin par sngags kyi zab khyad la 'gram chu langs nas theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rkang rtsa chad pa rnams la thugs gting nas sun te khrel bdas pa'i gsung yang 'di ltar gnas te/ gal chen byang chub sems la thun gcig kyang / /nyams len mi byed bskyed rdzogs bsgom lo dang / /bzlas brjod byed lo chos pa'i gzugs brnyan 'di'i / /kha de grong tsho dgu yi skyag pas chod/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /de ltar theg pa chen po'i chos kyi snying po byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi bdag po lha cig dī baṃ ka ra ltar gyur ba ni / rnam thar gyi gtso bo ngo mtshar ba'i gnas bla na med pa lags so / /sku tshe'i mjug la nye ba na/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa srin yul du bzhud kur zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi cho ga mang por 'dir sku dngos kyi gdul bya'i 'phro rdzogs par mdzad pa bzhin bla ma 'tshams pa rin po che'i sku gdung gi drung du dung sprugs kyi sgrub mchod lo lnga'i bar du rgyun chags su mdzad de/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i srid pa'i rgya mtsho gting nas sprugs/ rab tshes thams cad 'dul zhes me phag gi lor sku khams cung zad bsnyung tshul 48

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/bstan / de skabs ma 'ongs lung bstan sogs gzigs snang gi 'char sgo mtha' yas pa'i gsung gi dbyibs 'dod kyang sngar dus de 'dra zhu ba la mi mnyes pa'i dbang gis su bka' 'dri zhu bar ma spobs / gling bla'i dbon po 'jam dpal zer ba'i sman pa zhig gis bsnyung g.yog byed skabs/ khos a bu tshang gi snga phyi'i gsung sgros gang la bsams kyang nged rang tshos tshe phyi ma'i don du smon lam 'debs yul nub phyogs bde ba can kho na la mthil gtad na snyam pa de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ cung zad bzhugs nas/ 'o khyod nub nga shar red pa zhes gsungs/ mthar bsnyun cung zad je thur song skabs nyin mo'i res shig cung zad gzims la yur ba ltar mdzad rjes/ da res nga gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam na ban de 'dra ba gnyis kyis khyod kyi gdul bya shar phyogs na yod zer ba zhig byung / nga 'dra ba la gdul bya tsho cang yod dam gsungs/yang sngar dus shig tu nang gcig nged tshos gzhan la bde smon 'dra ba bshad/ rang gis kyang dag pa'i zhing khams der smon lam mang po 'debs mdog byas pa yin yang / mdang sum tshor ko mo'i 'o lu na sngar dus bzhin bsdad yod pa'i nying 'khrul kho nas mtshan thog thag yol ba byung / da dung yang der gcig yong dgos pa 49

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yin nam zhes kyang gsungs pas/ 'gro don shar na yod pa dang /phyis su yab rje nyid ko mo'i 'o lur phebs pa sogs 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigs pa'i lung du snang / rgyun du yang skabs 'ga' rer mgo log gi mi rang bzhin drang la g.yo zol med ces bstod ra gnang zhing / skabs 'ga' rer ar jag chom rkun gyi rigs 'di rtsa ba nas med pa zhig byung na zhes bka' bkyon gnang ba sogs rnam pa kun tu thugs la 'dogs pa'i lo rgyus mang ngo / /lo de'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad nyin sku drang bor bsrangs/phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs te 'chi srid rnam par dag pa ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings su snyoms par zhugs so/ /smras pa/ ring nas goms pa'i bzang po'i yon tan rnam dag gser sbyangs btso ma'i dngos/ /gzhan phan spyod la kun tu chags pa'i smon lam bzo pos kha bsgyur te/ /bstan 'gro'i bsod nams rab tu yangs pa'i lha yi lam la nyer bkod pa'i/ /theg mchog chos kyi rgyal srid mdzes pa'i skyes mchog 'khor lo 'di 'dra rmad/ /dam pa'i 'khrungs rabs mu tig bstar ba'i phreng / /thub bstan sgeg mo'i lus bzang mdzes pa'i slad/ /gang gis brgyus pa'i thugs rje'i phreng brgyud mkhan/ /srid 'dir bde 50

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/ legs sbyin pa'i tshangs pa yin/ /a ho don gnyis lhun grub dpag bsam ljon/ /'khrungs pa'i rtsa lag snying rje'i myu gu de/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i chab kyis nyer bcus nas/ /blo gros mig ldan su zhig skyong mi byed/ /theg mchog chos kyi rta bdun ldan pa yi/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i nyin mor byed/ /re zhig 'od gsal chu lha'i phangs pa ru/ /gzims pa dus kyi gshis la bcos med de/ /smon lam skya rengs gsar bas yongs drangs nas/ /byin rlabs drod brgya bcud du chags pa yi/ /legs bshad 'od stong bdal ba'i nyi ma zhig /slar yang gsal bar 'char la su yis bston/ /snga 'gyur chos kyi khang bzang yangs pa'i nang / /re zhig byi dor byed pa grub pa'i 'phral/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i nor bu 'bum spungs ba'i / /dge ldan shing rta 'dren la rangs par gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sku ni mthong tsam nyid nas kun rtog rnyog pa dwangs pa'i yid la 'jug /gsung ni thos pa'i mod la blang dor gnas la rmongs pa ring du skyod/ /thugs rje lan gcig dran kyang mi 'bral smon pa'i 'o dod rtag 'bod pa'i/ /yab gcig 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor gus pas phyag byas te/ /gsang gsum yon tan 51

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nor bu'i mthar son kyang / /rags pa'i rnam thar 'od zer brgya ba'i gzi/ /bdag blo khang par zhugs pa de tsam zhig /sgro skur med par dbye ba'i khur len na/ /sngo bsangs ral gri'i 'khri shing phyar tsam nas/ /rmongs mun gcod mdzad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs / /rin chen be+eḍūr pi waṃ bsgreng tsam nas / /blo mchog stsol mdzad rgyal yum dbyangs can ma/ /bdag yid rmongs pa'i sbubs rgya da khrol la/ /bzang po'i rnam thar sgo brgya ston pa dang / /bdag mgrin longs spyod 'khor lor da rol la/ /snyan 'gyur ngag gi dngos grub myur stsol cig /gnyis pa/ sku tshe 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar ba cung zad rgyas par dbye ba la/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po nas dpal a ti sha'i sku che ba'i yon tan gsungs pa ltar 'chad pa la gsum/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid rigs phun sum tshogs par skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul dang / rten de la yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul dang / brnyes nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ ji skad du/ mdo sde rgyan las/ tshangs pa'i gnas pas gnas pa yi/ /blo ldan rtag tu 'dod par skye/ /des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing / /sems can dag kyang rnam smin byed / /ces rgyal ba'i sras po byams sogs tshad med bzhi yis 52

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/gnas pa rnams kyis rang gi tshogs rdzogs pa dang / gzhan sems can smin par byed pa'i don du rtag tu 'khor bar skye ba 'dzin par gsungs pa ltar snyigs dus kyi gdul bya dmu rgod shin tu nyam thag pa rnams la shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po dang / smon lam shugs drag po kho na'i dbang gis gzigs pa lngas skye ba'i myu gu ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul ni/ yul la gzigs pa thub bstan byang nas byang du dar bar sher phyin las lung bstan don ltar mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi rgyan dang ldan pa'i ngur smig 'dzin pa stong phrag du ma 'dus pa'i sku 'bum byams pa gling sogs dge 'dun gyi sde mang po dang 'dab 'brel bas yon tan gyi rgyan nye bar bzhes sla ba la dgongs te/ thub bstan snying po 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs la 'dod dgur spyad chog pa'i bdag rkyen mkhas grub kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu brgya phrag gis gang ba'i yul/ lha klu grub pa'i drang srong 'bum phrag gi rol gnas bsod nams dpal gyis nye bar brjid pa'i mtsho khri gshog rgyal mo'i 'gram nyin lung zhes bya ba'i nor 'dzin yangs pa'i lto bar dus la gzigs pa ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong bdun brgya don bdun lon pa'i dus kyi dbang las thub 53

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bstan snyigs mar spyod pa la dgongs te/ tshul khrims le'u'i lo nyis brgya don lnga tsam song rab byung bco lnga ba'i kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi ba'i lor/ rigs la gzigs pa rigs kyis bkur ba la yon tan du ma yod par dgongs te/ dge slong nam mkha'i snying po dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs 'khrungs pa'i sngon gyi gdung rus gtsang ma gnubs kyi rigs las mched pa'i dpa' mdzangs rtul phod sogs yon tan gyi yan lag du ma dang ldan pa'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa 'khyam ru dpon gyi rigs su/ yab yum la gzigs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol gyi dngos slob a lag pad+ma rang grol gyi skye srid du grags pa'i lugs gnyis kyi yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba nyin lung sku chen zhes bya ba/ bram ze mo tshul khrims gsar ba'i me tog ltar dgos dbang chen mo nas bar skabs su rab byung gi brtul zhugs dor ba de nyid dang / yum rang bzhin gyis rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su gor ma chag pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan ldan hrang bo'i bza' gnyis la dgongs te lhums su zhugs nas/ dus la babs pa na bya dka' ba'i spyod pa'i gter du gyur ba'i mtshan dpes spras pa'i rnam smin chen po'i sku dang ro 54
