rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/mnyam du gyur bzhin/ tshu rol mthong ba'i gdul bya ma dag pa rnams la yang 'dod dgur snang du btub pas dgos khyad che zhing /dam pa'i yon tan gyi dri bsung dang / gzhan phan phrin las kyi sbrang rtsi g.yur du za ba'i rags pa'i sku mchog puṇ+ḍa ri ma'i bdag nyid de nyid mig gi bdud rtsir mngon du gyur to/ /bsod nams chen pos nyer drangs te/ /'dzam gling 'di na mun pa'i smag /rmeg med bcil la ches rno ba'i/ /nam mkha'i nor bu slebs pa bzhin/ /lus can 'bum gyi legs byas mthus/ /snyigs ma ngan dgu'i smag rum du/ /dam chos 'od zer 'gyed pa yi/ /bstan 'dzin nor bu 'di shar ro/ /g.yo can dbyig la gdung ba re res kyang / /mig 'phrul ltad mo 'dod pa bslu ba'i blos/ /phal gyis gsang sngags re zhig bzlas pas kyang / /myur bde'i rta glang bzhin pa snang lags na / /rgyal dang rgyal sras sa chen rdul snyed kyis/ /mi mtshon gzhan phan las la gzhol rnams kyis/ /snying rje'i rigs sngags dus ring bgrangs pa las/ /sprul ba'i sgyu ma 'di 'dra cis mi 'byung / /e ma bdag cag blo yi rdzing bu yang / /ma dad dri mas rnyog pa med mchi ste / /skyes mchog zla ba'i lang tsho 'di 'dra zhig /shar zhes rab dga'i zlos gar cis mi bsgyur/ /zhes dga' ba'i tshigs su bcad 55

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa 'o / /de tshe thar shul rdo rje 'chang gis dri bzang dang byin rten sogs bskur te bka' slob gnang nas gur kum gyis ljags la dhīḥ'abri ba sogs blo rno ba'i cho ga byas pa red ces zhal las thos sku lhums su zhugs pa dang bltams pa'i dus de tshe dge ba'i ltas ya mtshan pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di lta bu 'khrungs pa la gor ma chag par yod nges kyang ma thos la/ zhal nas/ nged kyi pha de nyid kyis slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i bsnyen bsgrub byas pas ma sha'i las sbyor gyi tshe zla 'dzin gcig gi ring myu gu sor gang skye ba red de/ 'on kyang 'jig rten gyi lugs la shes dpyod mi zhan zhing gtam la mkhas pa tsam las chos kyi shes rab ni cang che bar med pa ci 'dra yin ang gsung ste/ de ni gangs can gyi mgon po 7 rgyal dbang bcu gsum pas kyang mkhas pa'i dbang por bsngags pa'i parnyi ta chen po 'di lta bu 'khrungs pa'i ltas su gor ma chag cing nges pa'i don du na rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid bu ru brdzus nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel mngon du gyur ba lags so/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i tshe sku ni phyis kyi mjal dus ltar dka' thub can gyi drang srong bzhin skem la mdzes pa/ dbu gdugs ltar rgyas 56

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/shing dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ shings mtho zhing dpyad gzugs gzhan yang legs pa zhig yod par mngon la/ de tshe sku bsnyun med cing mthun pa'i dngos pos skyed bsring bas rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa'i pad+ma bzhin dar bar gyur to/ /dgung lo gnyis gsum tsam bzhes pa'i tshod du sgyu 'phrul lha mo ltar ma yum yang gshegs/de nas yab kyis bskyangs te dgung lo lnga bzhes pa na/ skabs shig yab kyi pang du bzung ste bu 'di nar son pa na/ gong ma chen po'i mdun du khrid nas ja sag bla ma'i dus ltar gser yig dang go thob zhus te/ 'jig rten gyi kha thabs chen po zhig byed dgos zhes byams skyong byas par/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la snying bo ci yod/ tshe 'dir chos rnam par dag pa zhig bsgrub dgos snyam pa thugs la shar ba dran gsungs te/ 'di kho na'i sku yon kyang gzhal du ga la yod / byis pa lo lnga ba zhig la tshe 'dir mi yi g.yam la rgyug pa'i bsam sbyor dge ba de lta bu ni rang dgar mi 'byung bas/ ji skad du / skyes rabs las/ dge dang mi dge'i las rnams goms byas na / /mi rnams la ni 'dris pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de lta bu dag ched du ma bsgrims kyang / /tshe rabs gzhan la rmi lam bzhin du spyod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ring mo zhig nas yang dag pa'i lam la gom 57

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa gdeng du gyur te/ sku tshe 'dir me yi rang bzhin tsha ba ltar dad pa dang nges 'byung gi sems byams snying rje sogs rang gi gshis su song ba'i ngang tshul te/ de 'dra'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar brjod du yod pa ni kho bo skal ba bzang bo ste/ rnam par thar ba zhes pa yang 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i rnam byang phyogs kyi yon tan la brten nas rang bzhin gyi don gnyis bsgrub pa'i lo rgyus tshad ma zhig las gang byung gi sgrung rgyud la mi byed pa 'dra'o/ /de nas dgung lo drug yas mas zhig tu yab de yang gshegs/ yab sngon chad 'khyam ru dgon gyi bdag por bzhugs pa las rig ma bzhes pa nas dgon pa dang nye bar bla brang logs su bzung yod pa'i bla brang yang 'thor te/'dul ba lung las/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' 'dzad cing / /mthon po rnams kyi mthar lhung 'gyur/ /'phrad pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul mngon du gyur to/ /de nas yab yum gyi sku nye'i phyogs nas rje 'di la sku bdag byed mkhan ma byung bas a phyi tras nag bza' byams me zer bas khrid de bskyangs pa yin la / phyis su yang nged la/ khyed la 'khyam ru na bdag po zhig med/skal ba zhig yod pa gzig phyar khra ra ma yin/ khyod dang gzig 58

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/phyar khra ra ma len mkhan nga las med pas phyin chad khyod cig skye ru byung na ma brjed ces yang yang zer gsungs/ dgung lo bdun pa la thos nag bza' de nyid kyis bstan 'dzin zer ba'i grwa ba dkyus ma zhig la klog gi thog ma mo rang gis slob pa las grwa ba zhig gis slob pa rten 'brel bzang zer nas ka kha slob tu bcug cing / de nas mo rang gis chos spyod ci rigs slob bzhin par lha ldan du gnas bskor la khrid de jo shākya sogs mjal/ dad gus tshad med pa skyes te tshe 'dir dkor dang log 'tsho la mi 'bag pa'i smon lam btab gsungs/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo thams cad mkhyen pa/7 ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde rin po che dang mjal te/bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung thob pa'i tshe 'di'i chos sgo dang po de nas phyes pas/ 7 rgyal ba'i dbang po de nyid bka' drin che/ bla ma'i thog ma yin gsungs/ de ma zad phyis su rje rang gis nyams mgur bzhes par yang / dal 'byor lus rten 'di la/ /bdud rtsi ster ba'i thog ma/ /'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo / /kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang bo/ /rig 'dzin ngag dbang phun tshogs/ /blo dman bdag la brtse phyir/ /gangs ljongs srid 59

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/zhi'i mgon por/ /sprul nas rjes su bzung 'dug /brgya phrag thabs mkhas mdzad pa/ /tha mal yin snyam mi 'dug /rtsod dus sangs rgyas mi gzugs/ /bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig /ces gsungs shing / grwa ba dkyus ma de dang a phyi de yang bka' drin shin tu che zhes bla ma'i grangs su brtsis te dad gus mdzad pa yin te / nyams mgur der yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma/ /dbyangs gsal brda dag slob pas/ /rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs mdzad/ /mtshungs bral bstan pa'i mtshan can/ /drin chen ngag dbang phun tshogs / /blo dman bdag la brtse phyir/ /slob dpon tshul du sprul nas / /rjes su bzung ba yin 'dug /snang tshul bag med spyod pa/ /tha mal yin snyam mi 'dug /rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i/ /yon tan byed po yin pa/ /jo shāka rgyal dbang yab sras/ /dngos su zhal mjal byed cing / /chos spyod ci rigs slob pa'i/ /ma ma'i gzugs can rgan mo/ /drin chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ /blo dman bdag la brtse phyir/ /rnam dkar dang po'i byed por/ /bsam bzhin sprul bar 'dug go /drin chen ma ma de yang / /tha mal yin snyam mi 'dug /yon tan du ma slob pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dngos zhig red do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gnas bskor 60

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/'khor nas phyir bslebs pa dang / a phyis dge rgan gzhan zhig la bcol nas klog byings slob par mdzad de/ zhi drag thabs mkhas mdzad pas/ /chos spyod cho ga du mas/ /rang blor byang bar chub mdzad / /mtshungs bral shrī'i mtshan can/ /drin chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ /blo dman bdag la brtse phyir/ /bsam bzhin yongs 'dzin gzugs su/ /sprul bar the tshom mi 'dug /'jig rten mkhan du snang ba/ /tha mal yin snyam min 'dug /gzhan la phan pa'i lag rjes/ /du ma mngon sum 'dug pa/ /zhes so/ /de skabs su yang byis pa phal ba'i kun spyod las 'das pa'i dam pa'i rnam thar gyi yon tan me tog gi dri bzhin 'gog tu med pa zhig yod par mngon yang zhib tu ma thos la/ kun rig gi cho ga klog pa'i tshe thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zer bar ga'u mgul du btags pa ltar gzar 'phyangs su yod snyam nas de'i steng du yig 'bru 'god pa mi bde ba'i snang ba shar gsungs pas de tshe yang gang klog rgyu'i tshig don la dpyod pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pa zhig yod par 'dug de skabs sku 'bum gzims khang gong gi sprul sku zhig red kyang la la zer/ la la lab mdo rgyud rgya nag tu sku gshegs pa'i sprul sku red zer srol yang byung gsungs te dkar phyogs kyi 61

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/lhas bsgrags pa lta bur snang / bdag po byed mkhan ni ma byung 'dug de nas mi ring bar klog legs par byang chub ste rgya'u ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab tu byung ste/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes nas mtshan 7 blo bzang mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor gsol/ snga phyir bla ma 'ga' re las bka' chos kyang ci rigs shig gsan yod 'dug dgung lo bcu gcig pa la sde snod gyi bslab sbyang yod pa'i chos sde zhig tu gtong dgos/ der btang na 'di rig pa shin tu bzang bas slob gnyer legs po zhig 'ong thag chod ces kun kha mthun par gleng 'dug pa la/ a phyi de 'jig rten la shes dpyod che ba zhig yod pas slob gnyer byed yul sku 'bum bzang yang der grwa 'tshogs che sar rgya sog gi mi chos spyod ngan can mang bas de 'dra'i shan zhugs shas che/ bcol ba'i dge rgan sogs kyang rgyus yod blo gtad pher nges shig med/ de bas la mo bde chen du btang na kha lta ngo shes yang yod/ ma zad 'di'i pha'i ring la bde chen gyi khri ba byas nas grwa ba re la snam phrug re 'gyed pas mchod yon 'brel ba zab gshis/ bu chung 'di la nyar tshags do dam zhig e mi sprod zer bar/ ngas sku 'bum rang du 'gro dgos zhes yang yang u tshugs byas pas der 'gro rgyur 62

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/thag chod/ a phyis kyang de lta na rdzong dkar tshang la zhal 'debs sogs 'brel ba cung zad yod pas der bcol ba drag zer nas rdzong dkar tshang la bcol gsungs/ de tshe sku 'bum du song na chos sde chen po yin pas mkhas pa mang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la kha mig gyen du blta ba las rgya sog spyod ngan gyi mi dang 'grogs 'dris ma byas na los chog snyam pa yang shar gsungs/ de lta bu thugs la shar ba ni/ sku nar ma son kyang thugs rgan po ltar blo gros dkyel che la spobs pa mtho bas gzhan gyis drang mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod dpag dka' ba yin te/ shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar ba'o/ /smras pa/ dam pa'i zla tshes na tshod phra na yang / /yon tan 'od dkar 'byung ba chos nyid de/ /re zhig dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa med na yang / /thub bstan mkha' dbyings mdzes pa'i rgyan du che/ /'o mas yang dang yang du bcus pa yi/ /bu ram shing bzhin gang sku'i 'khri shing nyid/ /chos ldan bsam dang sbyor ba'i ro mngar bos/ /dud pa gdul bya'i gdung sel sman chen yin/ /yon tan dri bzang rdzogs pa'i chos kyi tshal/ /gzhung lugs sbrang rtsi 'tshol bas 'jug ngogs te/ /blo ldan bung ba gzhon nu bcos na yang / /mi gtsang gzeb la mi 'du rang gi gshis/ /lung rigs 63

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dbyar gyi rnga gsang mthon po'i sgras/ /yid la dga' ba sbyin pa'i chos kyi sprin/ /bsod nams mkha' la brjid 'dis dbang med du//drangs nas skyes mchog rma bya'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ rten de la yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du skyes rabs brgya pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa rnams / /gti mug sgrib pa bsal gyur cig /dpag med shes rab mthu ldan yang / /rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms bzhin/ /legs par gsungs pas ngoms mi shes/ /ched du de la 'dun pa bzhin/ /gang dag blo yi mthu chung ba/ /cung zad tsam gyis ngoms gyur te/ /ba lang rkang rjes ci bzhin no/ /blo ldan blo ldan ma yin pa/ /brtag na khyad par re che 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nor ldan nor gyis mi ngoms pa dang / mkhas pa rig pas mi ngoms par grags pa ltar/yon tan gyi rje zhwa dmar rin po che/ 7 dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos byang chub lam rim gyi bka' chos gnang gin yod pa gsan nas der phebs te lam rim rdzogs par gsan pas chung ngu'i dus nas yod pa'i skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi blo sogs me lce la mar khu bran pa bzhin lhag par 'phel/ snga phyi 64

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/skabs gang yin ma nges kyang zhwa dmar rin po che'i drung nas kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon pos bsgrigs pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas paṇa chen gyi lhan thabs bcas gsan/ zhwa dmar rin po che'i dngos slob ri khrod khag gsum gyi bla ma mtsho sngon zhabs drung rin po che rdo rje 'chang / skya ngag dbang phun tshogs dpal bzang bo'i drung nas bka' chos ci rigs shig 'di dus nas gsan yod 'dug de nas bar skabs su yul phyogs la yang byon / lam rim chen mo'i skyes bu chung 'bring gi chos skor rnams blo la bzung bas lam nyams len gyi 'gros rags pa re'i go ba chags pas ha cang mkhas pa'i snang ba skyes dpe cha ba gsar bu la de 'dra 'char rgyu yod gsungs/ de nas sku 'bum du bzhugs nas slob gnyer mthar 'khyongs shig mdzad bzhed yod pa la/ mang po zhig da phan sku 'bum du sdod yun ring na mi bzang ngan spyod pa rtsing zhib sna tshogs yod pas mi legs zer bar dngos su smra ma nus kyang thugs la shar ba ltar yi ger bris te/ nyams mgur mdzad nas lkog tu kha cig la bstan/ phyis su yang ma brjed par yod gsungs pa ni/ rje rang rig don gyi bla ma la/ /blo gnyis su med pa'i ngang nas 'dud/ /gzhi bden gnyis kyi shes bya 'di dag 65

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kun / /phar dpyad tshe btags yod ming rkyang las/ /rang ngos nas 'ja' tshon ri mo bzhin/ /gtan med du 'gro ba 'di mthong tshe /tha snyad kyi rten 'brel bslu med la/ /nges shes de ches cher 'drongs 'di mtshar/ /ngo mtshar de de bzhin ma mthong bar/ /skur 'debs kyi mtha' la lhung ba dang / /sgro 'dogs kyi phyogs la zhen rnams la//rtog ge yi rigs pa ma yin par/ /nyams myong gi gad mo kho bos shor / /snang tsam gyi rang bzhin stong ba des/ /rtag lta yi brag ri rtse nas bsnyil/ /stong tsam gyi rten 'brel bslu med des/ /chad lta yi gcong rong rmang nas bsal/ /sngon sbyangs kyi las 'phro sad pa yi/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i seng phrug ngas/ /skyabs gangs ri'i bla ma bsten bsten nas/ /sdig grogs kyi srin bus 'tshe dogs med/ /gdams ngag gi lus stobs brtas brtas nas/ /rtag chad kyi g.yang la lhung dogs med/ /snying rje yi g.yu ral rgyas rgyas nas/ /zhi bde yi dpal la chags dogs med/ /bde stong gi lam bzang bsgom bsgom nas/ /rnam rtog gi bdud kyis tshugs dogs med/ /mi bskyod mgon bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis/ /gang dran gyi ngag kyal rdzun tshig smras/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sku na tshod chung ngu 'di 'dra bas tshe rabs nas tshe rabs su goms pa'i rgyal sras sems dpa' 66

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/chen po'i bya dka' ba'i spyod pa dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mngon sum du ngom pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan 'di dag gis gzhal na bla ma rje btsun 'di nyid da lta tha mal gyi mi yi sha tshugs su phebs kyang sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal kun bzang sogs kyi spyod pa ltar/ rgyal bar gyur kyang ma rgyal lta bur ston/ gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar ba'o / /de nas sku 'bum du phebs te slob gnyer 'phros legs par mdzad kyang / dgun thog dgun thog tsam las skabs 'gar yul phyogs la phebs pa dang / 'ga' rer yas mar bka' chos gang yod du phebs pa sogs sku 'bum rang nas slob gnyer nan tan rgyun 'khyongs shig re zhig bar byed rgyu ma byung gsungs/ bka' chos gtso bor gsan yul rdo rje 'chang 7 ngag dbang phun tshogs rin po che dang / a rig ri khrod pa rje byams pa rgya mtsho rnam gnyis yin la/ de la snga ma'i zhabs drung nas rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum dang / dpa' bo gcig pa gnyis/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs lha so gnyis/ bde mchog lū dril gnyis/ rta mgrin yang gsang sogs mang po zhig gsan yod 'dug la/ phyi ma'i drung nas mkha' spyod ma dang / rig byed ma/ rta mgrin gsang 67

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sgrub / mgon po phyag drug pa sogs dang / khrid kyi skor du ma dang /snyan ngag dang / dbyangs can ma'i sgra'i sa ris sogs gsan/khyad par du rdo rje 'chang 7 ngag dbang phun tshogs las 'jam mgon bla ma'i snyan brgyud thun mong min pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gsan skabs mdo sngags kyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa la rnam par dpyod pa'i byin rlabs kyi sgo chen po zhig rnyed ces 'jigs byed dbang bshad cig gi dus su gsungs/ bla ma 'di bla ma thams cad kyi gtso bo bka' drin che shos su 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin nam snyam/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi bsnyen sgrub cig mdzad nas mthar sbyin bsregs kyi skabs shig bzhugs sa urge yin pa la me dpung chen po zhig 'bar nas urge g.yogs pa phyi rol na yod pa mang pos mthong bas me shor zhes 'jigs dngangs 'ong ba zhal nas thos pas/ sku tshe snga ma dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje'i thun mong min pa'i yi dam gyi gtso bo yin pas lhag pa'i lha dgyes pa'i dngos grub kyi rtags mtshan zhig mngon sum du snang bar mdzad pa lags so/ /de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa la slob gnyer la sbyang brtson hur thag bskyed dgongs nas slar yang lha ldan du phebs kyang / de skabs mtsho sngon 68

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/po'i phyogs kyi grwa rgyun sdod khongs ma 'cham pa'i gleng brjod che ba'i skabs shig tu 'dug pas bzhugs ma bde/ skabs der dga' ldan gser khang sprul sku zer ba'i mkhas par grags pa zhig gis rje bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas su bsgrub pa red ces bshad pas de'i sgrub tshul ngo mtshar ba ci yod snyam nas rtsad bcad pas/ rje bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas yin te/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang thugs rgyud gcig pa gang zhig 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang ye shes gcig gi gzung rnam gyis bsdus pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi grangs su bzhugs pa'i phyir/ zer ba 'dra zhig 'god 'dug pas ngo mtshar cang ma byung gsungs/ de tsam ma gtogs ji ltar phebs sogs zhib par ma thos la/ de nas phyir phebs te dgung lo nyer lnga bar phal cher rgyun bzhugs mdzad nas chos grwa 'grims shing sbyang brtson mdzad de / skabs shig dbyar thog cig la/ 7 rgyal ba'i dbang bo thams cad mkhyen pa bcu gsum pa chen po nas kyang mkhas mchog ngo mtshar bar bsngags nas yongs 'dzin du bsten pa'i dpal ri'i dge rgan rin po che blo bzang rab gsal chu mig brgya rtsar byon skabs mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi dpe cha pa legs shos mang po zhig phyi 69

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bzhin 'brangs pa'i gral du zhugs nas 'grel ba don gsal gyi bshad pa rgyas pa zhig thob pas phar phyin gyi go ba legs po zhig skyes gsungs/ skabs der 7 rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa yang sku 'bum bla brang rtser lo gsum gyi ring bzhugs nas rtsod 'dzin gyi rgyug la gzigs rtog dang / skabs 'gar chos grwar phebs nas bzhengs te dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgan rim mkhas pa rnams la rigs lung gnang ba dang / grwa mang la brtsi bzhag dang dpe khrid 'ga' re gnang ba sogs zhib gzigs gnang ba'i rkyen gyis 'dzin skyor rtsod pa ha cang 'phel te kun la blo skyed che zhing /skabs der nga rang la yang blo skyed legs po byung gsungs/ dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i skor zhig tu rdo rje 'chang 7 ngag dbang phun tshogs dpal bzang po'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po bzhes te tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mig 'bras ltar bsrung bar mdzad do/ / 7 rgyal dbang rin po che sku 'bum du bzhugs ring dpe khrid lan du ma dang / bka' chos yang mang po zhig gsan yod 'dug kyang zhib tu ma thos so/ /dgung lo nyer bzhi nyer lnga'i skabs a phyi de yang shi zin pa 'dra/ skabs 'gar thos nag phyogs nas gnyen tshan 'ga' re sku 'bum du tshong la 'ong 70

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/nas da ni dgon 'dir lo mang song / sku yon re yang los yod/yul phyogs su 'ong nas lugs gnyis kyi khur len dgos pas sang phod tsam na nged rang bsu mar sleb 'ong bas phebs rgyu'i sta gon gyis zhes nan tan chen po byed 'dug pa la ngas kyang byed shag lta bu bshad/ don du tshe 'dir chos rnam par dag pa zhig ma 'grub thabs med pas de la gnyen tshan gyi khur len sogs chos 'gal gyi rigs 'byung nye ba'i bya spyod de 'dra mi skyong bar ma zad gnyen tshan sogs kyi ming tsam yang go rgyu med pa'i sa mtha' zhig tu 'gro dgos snyam pa rgyun mar byung gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med kyis/ gnyen gyi phyogs la 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo/ /dgra yi phyogs la zhe snang me ltar 'bar/ /blang dor brjed pa'i gti mug mun nag can/ /pha yul spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ji lta bu'i rgyal sras kyi phyag len gtsang ma bdag gir mdzad pa la ngang gis dgyes pa'i rnam par thar ba ngo mtshar ba yin no/ /bzhugs sa bla brang des kyang lugs gnyis kyi sku yon che ba'i stabs kyis bla phyag mgo 'dug cig gi re ba byas tshod gda' ste/ de dag ni ji skad du/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas / mche ba mi zad sbar mo'i shugs 'chang ba/ /gangs ri 'dzin 71

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i gdong lnga'i dbang bo ni/ /lcags kyis bcings nas btsog chus 'tsho ba yi/ /sgo khyir byed 'dod mkhas pa'i bzhad gad yin/ /gsungs pa'i dpe ltar gyur to/ /rgya nag gi lag ris kyi ltas rtog mkhan zhig la phyag ris bstan skabs phyag mthil 'chang mjug na dung dkar gyi ri mo zhig dus rgyun yod pas de las dpag ste sa mtha' zhig nas snyan grags can zhig 'byung zhes lung bstan/ de nas dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha zhes yongs su grags pa ltar don la gnas pas chos dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis phongs pa med pas rang yul spangs te lha ldan phyogs su song nas re zhig bar grwa sa rang du bka' pod kyi gzhung la da dung thos bsam gting thag chod pa zhig byed/ de nas de phyogs kyi ri khrod cig tu 'di snang gi yo lang dang ma 'dres par sgrub pa snying por byed dgongs nas blo thag yang yang bcad de bzhugs pa na/ rdza ser shul gyi grwa sa 'ga' re sku 'bum du tshong la slebs yod par phebs nas mdo smad lho rgyud du dgon sde dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang bo ji 'dra bzhugs dris pa'i lan gyi na mar/ da lta tre bo hor gzhung na skyabs rje brag dkar bla ma rin po che zhu ba zhig ri khrod 'dzin pa'i bya btang brgya phrag brgal ba dang bcas bzhugs tshul gsan pas 72

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/shin tu dga' ba dang dad spro gting nas skyes nas/ lha ldan du 'gro ba la lam 'gag der byas te sku drung du bcar nas bka' chos shig thob pa cis kyang byed dgos dgongs/ de skabs sku 'bum du yang dpe cha pa phal cher bzhugs snying mi 'dod pa'i 'gal rkyen zhig byung bar snang la/ 'dzin grwa'i mtshams ni dbu ma gsar rnying zhig la phebs yod tshod 'dug go /de yang ji skad du skyes rabs brgya ba las/ 'bad pas 'jig rten dge legs bsrung gyur kyang / /lus dang longs spyod mdza' ba kun bor te/ /las kyi shugs drag dbang med bdas nas su/ /dmyal ba'i gshed po mi bzad 'bar ba'i lce/ /mi bzad drag po'i khar ni ltung gyur na / /de tshe gnyen dang srid kyis ci zhig bya/ /blo ldan bshes kyis grogs byar ci zhig yod/ /des na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chu bo las / /sgrol ba'i dal 'byor gru chen yod bzhin du/ /bsam gtan 'khrul 'khor brtson 'grus kyis bskul nas/ /rgal bar mi byed de ni phyugs dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi don thugs la dgongs te/ dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i steng phebs rgyur thugs thag chod pas ston mjug bla brang de la mar rgya phyogs nyin lnga tsam gyi lam zhig la 'bru zhig bsdu ru yod par gnyer pa chos dar zer 73

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ba zhig yod pa der song / sgar ba de'i bla ma ni sngon nas sku gshegs te mi bzhugs pas shul der rje 'di dang grwa chung 'ga' re las med pa la/ grwa chung rnams nyal du bcug nas phyag khar lde'u mig rnams yod pa mdzod khang gi sgor btags te mun rub tsam la phebs pas/ sku 'bum dgon pa dang mi ring bar la kha zhig yod pa der byon tshe/ da phan chad chos sde rin po che gtsug lag khang dang —/ gser gdung chen mo'i gtso byas pa'i rten gsum bla ma grogs mched 'dus sde sogs mi mjal dgongs te thugs skyo bas zhal phyir gzigs pa na/ gtsug lag khang gi gyo rnams kyi steng du zla ba shar zhing dus bzang gi tshogs kyi mkhar rnga brdung ba dang thug pas shin tu yang dgon pa la thugs 'phrang nas phyir phebs dgos snyam pa yang skyes gsungs/ der zhib tu thugs rtog bcug ste gang la yang ma chags par tshe 'dir chos rnam dag cig 'grub dgos par yang yang blo thag bcad pa bzhin pha yul nye 'brel dang nye phyogs spong pa la cis kyang bshol du med snyam nas shar gyis mtshan mo'i ring la byon gsungs so/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/yid 'phrogs zla ba dkar po'i bzhin ras/ /mkha' la 'od dkar lam lam 'gyed bzhin/ /'dzam gling shar gyi ri bo'i rtse nas/ /74

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/bkags kyang mi khegs 'char ba chos nyid/ /rgyal sras zla ba dkar bo'i sku dkyil/ /sngon goms chags med ngang tshul spro bzhin/ /gangs can lum+bi'i tshal gyi 'dab nas/ /bkags kyang mi khegs phebs pa rang gshis/ /chu shel zla ba shar nas shar tshe/ /yab rje zla ba lho ru chas te/ /yon tan dkar po'i gzi 'od ngom pa'i/ /zla ba de gnyis mnyam du chas song / /chags pa'i dri ma cha tsam med cing ske/ /snying rje'i ri dwags ri mo 'dzin pa'i/ /skyes mchog zla ba 'gran med yin zhes/ /zla bas rang gzugs bstan te mtshon song ske/ /a ho rten 'brel 'di 'dra lags pa/ /a kye bsam na dga' zhing dad pa/ /e ma ngo mtshar gzhi ma lags pa/ /e e bdag cag skal ba bzang song / /zhes glu ru blangs so/ /de nas rim gyis zi lang du phebs/ sngar zhabs thang du byon ma myong bas zhabs mthil la chu bur mang bo rdol nas nyin kha shas shig rgan mo rgas 'khog gcig la gnas tshang g.yar nas sku ngal bsos/ de nas yar stod phyogs nas ma 'ong na mtsho sngon po'i 'grul 'grim dang 'phrad nas yul phyogs kyis thos na mi legs pa dang / rje me tri'i mtshan can mjal bzhed gnyis tshogs la dgongs te a rig phyogs su gtad nas phebs pas grwa ba 'ga' re dang 'phrad/ dris 75

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pas a rig sa char grong chog la 'gro ba yin zer nas/ nga yang a rig tu grong chog la 'gro ba yin pas lhan cig tu 'gro gsung nas lhan du phebs/ grwa ba de dag kyang rang bzhin bzang ba sha stag yin pas zhabs bsnyung ba sogs kyis stabs gas sku ngal gso dgos sogs la rje 'di nyid dang bstun nas zhabs zhu gang phan byed cing / khyed grong chog tu phebs pa zhig min 'dra bas shod zer / drang bor lo rgyus gsungs pas de bden/ khyed skyes bu dam pa zhig yin nges/ da nged cag kyang khyod dang 'bral mi phod pas lha ldan du 'gro zer/ de ltar ma byed gang dran lag len du 'debs pa las sdug pa med/ a rig tu song la lo shas grong chog gyis / mthun rkyen bag re rnyed tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen re bsten la thos bsam slob gnyer sogs chos rnam dag cig e 'grub ltos/gsungs pas legs so de bzhin bgyid par dam bca' 'bul zer / de nas rje drung chen byams pa rin po che'i ri khrod du slebs pas bla mas ci gsungs/ bka' bkyon e gnang snyam dgongs nas sku mdun du de ma thag bcar ma nus par ri khrod pa'i zhol de nas ja bskol te grogs rnams dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pas/ bla mas nyin gung gsol ba mdzad zin nas phyi rol tu khams sangs la 76

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/rgyun par phebs kyin yod pas phyi rol du phebs byung ba yar gzigs pas sku gzugs kyi babs kyis mkhyen te tsha zing nge ba zhig byung gsungs/ bla mas grwa ba 'di dag gar 'gro su red dris gsungs nas ri khrod pa zhig btang byung ba la/ lo rgyus zhus nas sku drung du bcar e chog zhus par/ da lta nyid du shog gsungs/phebs pas zhal mi dgyes pa lta bu'i nyams kyis sku 'bum du dpe cha yag po mi blta bar gang du 'gro gin yod gsungs pas 'jigs zhum pa zhig byung yang rang gi bya ba thams cad bla ma la mi zhu na su la zhu/ gal srid mi 'os pa zhig yin tshe yang thugs dang bstun pas chog snyam dgongs te lo rgyus rgyas par zhus nas/ de ltar mi rung na yang ci gsungs las med zhus pas/ 'o legs legs/chos rnam dag cig sgrub pa la spyir rang yul spangs dgos par bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs/ da lta sku 'bum yang skye bo ngan pa'i bya spyod dar drags pas sdod snying spro ba zhig yod ma song bas da bzang 'dug cis kyang chos rnam dag cig la blo thag chod/gsungs nas dgyes tshor gnang bas bla ma rin po che'i thugs la yang babs pas chos shig 'ong pa 'dra dgongs te dga' spro chen po zhig byung gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi grogs 'di 77

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rnams a rig sde nang du song / ngas kyang bcol gtam re yang byed gsungs/ khyod rang lam grogs stabs bde zhig ma rnyed par 'dir sdod gsungs nas/ bzhugs pas bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar mang bo zhal ta'i tshul gyis gsungs shing / lam rim dang blo sbyong gi bka' chos yang ci rigs shig gnang / zla ba drug lhag cig la a rig tu bzhugs/ skabs shig chan hū 'gyur med tshang la sku rim gsung chog yang du ma zhig dang / khyad par mgon po'i gtor sgrub dang / sbyin bsregs kyang mang zhig mdzad gsung ngam snyam / phyis su de tshang la rje zhwa dmar rin po che da lta 'di ba tshang yang de'i phyi lo yang lo zhig tu 'khrungs 'dug drung chen byams pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ da myur bar stod phyogs su song / 'gro don dang las 'phro yang de phyogs su legs po yod 'gro/ dus la babs pa'i bya ba la snyom las mi rung / myur du song / ngas lam du 'jog bla ma ye shes kyi mgon po la bcol ba yin gsungs nas nyin gcig la ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang tshar bcu gsum mdzad de/ myur mdzad ma tshar bcu gsum de rgyun du thon / bar chad med gsungs nas lam du bzhag go /de skabs a rig sde nang du hor brag 'go'i mdo mang dgon gyi 'bul sdud bla 78

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/ma zhig rang yul du 'byon ran yod pa la/ chan glus bcol/ lam chas la chan hū 'gyur med nas stod phyogs su dgun grang ngar shin tu che bas grwa ba'i na bzas lhags pa mi pher zer nas tshar dkar gyi slog pa spus legs gtsos dbu zhwa/ chag lham dor thung bcas sku chas nyer spyad cha tshang dang / bcib pa rta pho bzang shos shigagasol bca' bcas phul te phebs so/ /de nas stod phyogs rim gyis rma rgyal brgyud de a skyong dpon mo gzi brjid sgron ma'i sgor phebs / de nas lam yig blang nas dbang chen dpon po mdo sde'i sgor song zer ba ltar phebs lam/ dar lung nyag khar sngags pa ral ba can zhig dang 'phrad pas/ su yin/ gang nas 'ong zer/thag ring gi 'grul ba yin stabs rkun jag la dogs nas gzi brjid sgron ma'i sgo nas 'ong / dpon mdo sde gang na yod/ der 'gro / hor brag 'go'i bla ma zhig yin gsungs pas/ 'o dbang chen mdo sde dar legs rgyas mdo na yod/ bla ma dang zhabs phyi nor nas 'dug khyod 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul zhig red ces g.yag las babs te phyag dbang zhig zhu bas/ nged rang bla ma min / bla ma khong la mjal kha zhus gsungs par yang / yin yin zer nas mi btub par 'dug gsungs/ sngags pa de ni gter 79

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ston chos rgyal gling pa'i yang srid mthu stobs dpa' bo rdo rje'i sprul ba yin no/ /skabs der dar legs rgyas mdo zhes sa yi ming bkra ji 'dra'i legs po zhig 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs/ de nas dar gzhung nas yar phebs par snyan mo ri yang gzigs pas brag ri dang ske/ pha bong nyil ler yod pa'i ri bo kha lho phyogs su nyi ma la blta ba lta bu zhig la/ ri ngos kun tu da lta ltar ma yin par ha cang rtswa dang ldum bu rgyas pa ser yag ge ba la/ ri rtse sogs su na bun dkar bos g.yogs te rig pa dwangs shing sdod nyams spro ba lta bu la ri ba sogs med par g.yag nag po zhig gcig pur 'dug gsungs / de nyid ltas mtshan legs par bca' yig tu yang gsungs / dar legs rgyas mdor phebs/ dpon mdo sde'i ma shi skabs su 'dug gsungs/ de nas lam yig cig blangs te rim gyis hor stong skor dgon du phebs pas dgon pa'i nye char byon pa dang ske/ 'du khang steng nas dung 'bud pa dus mnyam du byung bas rten 'brel legs dgongs pa byung 'dug 'di ni phyis su der bka' chos mang du gsungs pa dang / zhabs drung rin po che sogs kyi rtags mtshan yin 'dug de nas hor brag mgor phebs/dgung grangs nyer bdun bzhes pa'i sa stag zla ba dang po'i cho 80

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/'phrul smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur tre hor brag 'go dgon du7 skyabs rje brag dkar rin po che bzhugs skabs thog mar skyes rabs gsung chos kyi skabs zhal mjal thob/ de skabs dam bca' la bgro gleng ci gtong rten 'brel gyi ltas su gsan pas longs sku nges pa lnga ldan las brtsams te rigs lung legs par btang song bas bkra ltas legs par dgongs/ de nas sku mdun du zhib mjal zhus pa la dgyes tshor tshad med pa mdzad de bla slob sku tshe dpag med du gzhan phan gyi spyod pa mnyam du mdzad pa'i tshul mngon par gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas smon lam grol nas dge thar lung gi ri khrod du mnyam du phebs/ lam rim blo sbyong gi chos bka' re'i zhu ba phul bas de byed chog cing / re zhig bzhugs dgos tshul nan tan gnang byung bas ri khrod chos grwar re zhig bzhugs par thugs thag bcad/ a rig chan hū'i rta dang tshar slog gi na bza' sogs phyag rten du phul/ gsol bca'i skor phran bu dang zhwa zla gam sogs grwa chas rdzogs pa zhig gnang 'dugade nas ri khrod kyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang du zhugs/ sku mdun du dge rgan zhig zhus par dge rgan blo bzang bsam gtan du grags pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa de bsten ces bka' phebs pa 81

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ltar mdzad/ de nas thugs rgyud khengs pa dang bral zhing spyod lam shin tu dul bas ri khrod kyi bsgrigs lam ci bzhin par chos grwar phebs so/ /de tshe na dang po mdo mang sgar la de gas sku 'bum gyi dge bshes mkhas pa zhig yin zhes bshad pas grags pa cher byung /de'i rjes su yon tan thams cad bum nang gi mar me ltar sba ba 'brom gyi phyag bzhes lta bu las rang gi yon tan sgrogs pa lhur mi len zhing shin tu dul bar bzhugs pa dang / khyad par sku 'bum tshogs chen la bod sog gi dpe cha ba mang ba dang / lung rigs la byang che bas ri khrod chos grwa chung ngu de ga'i cung zad dpe char grags rnams kyi spobs pa zil gyis gnon pa la tshegs med kyang khyad gsod dang shes mdog cung zad kyang med par mi dgongs pa'i rdzu yis/ shing rta'i srol 'byed ces pa'i tshig zur gyi shing rta la mgon po klu sgrub 'jog pa sogs gsar ba'i rigs kyi rigs lung la skabs phyes te nyams chung mdzad pas cang mi shes pa zhig 'dug go zhes gleng bar grags so/ /rnam par thar ba 'di yang shin tu dkon pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan zhig tu 'dug go /de nas skabs skabs lam rim dang / blo sbyong gi bka' chos yang du ma zhig gsan zhing chos thog chos mtshams med par ri khrod 82

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/bsgrigs lam la thun grol sdom yod pa ltar thugs nyams su bzhes/de skabs gsol bca' yi sta gon ma bsgrigs par gang byung du chog shes kho nas sran rtsam nyung ngu dang / chu tsam las med pa la/ nyin rer sran rtsam skya bo nyung ngu re chu yis 'phul te gsol nas dka' thub kyis bzhugs pas zla shas song nas rlung gis bsnyun cher byung nas chos grwar yang phebs ma thub pa la ri khrod pa 'ga' re dang /bla brang gi yang gsol ba nyung shas shig gnang nas a mdo rnga ba'i grwa ba blo rab zer bar snyun g.yog byed bcug pas snyan cung zad dwangs / de skabs shig nas sngar lha ldan gyi tshad rim bsnyun mjug rus la babs pa lta bus zhabs bsnyung nas phebs bzhud la zhabs mi bde ba lta bur gyur/ a mdo ba de mi gzhi legs pas zhabs zhu gang legs zhus/ a mdo ba la dpe khrid 'ga' re gnang bas blo skyed che bar byung ste chos grwa nang du yang rtags gsal tsha bo btang bas dpe khrid zhu mkhan 'ga' re byung / skyabs rje brag dkar rin po ches kyang dpe khrid sogs byed dgos tshul phebs pas khong gi yig cha gsar brtsams sa lam thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan steng nas zla ba gcig lhag la spyi thal sbrags pa'i mdzub khrid gnang bas blo skyed che bar byung nas rim gyis ri khrod grwa pa phal cher dge 83

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/phrug lta bur gyur zhing / stong skor zhabs drung rin po che blo bzang 'jigs med sogs la/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i khrid chen/ phyag chen byang chub gzhung lam khrid dang / 'jigs byed dpa' gcig dbang dang / de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid dang / yang mngon pa mdzod sogs kyi khrid gnang zhing —/ de mtshungs bka' chos mang du gsungs so/ /de nas chos dgar rnams su phyogs der bzhugs pa'i skyes bu dam pa du ma las gsan sbyang mang po zhig mdzad de/ de yang mdo mang mkhan po brtan mkhas kyi yon tan dang ldan pa dge 'dun grags pa las rat+na gling pa'i zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung dang / mdo mang gter ston bde chen gling pa las rang gter chos tshan gsan zhing de'i chos kyi bdag por mnga' gsol yang mdzad/ thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po ra hor mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i dbang po'i zhabs drung nas klong chen snying thig pod gnyis kyi dbang lung khrid rnams dang ske/ snying thig ya bzhi/ skyabs mchog brag dkar rin po che'i zhabs drung nas kyang klong snying pod gnyis dang / tre bo sa dkar bla ma rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho las kyang rdzogs chen snying thig 84

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/skor zhig gsan no/ snga 'gyur rnying phyogs kyi chos sgo dang po rat+na'i chos kyis phyes pas gter ston 'di nyid rten 'brel ma 'chugs pa'i bkra shis par brtsi ba ltar rten 'brel legs po byung gsungs so / /skyabs rje brag dkar rin po che las snga phyir bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs chos bka' mang po zhig gsan la/ khyad par du gcod dbang brgya rtsa/ grub dbang dharma seṅge'i gcod kyi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i khrid kyi yig cha'i steng nas gcod khrid yongs rdzogs gsan zhing / gcod dbang gi skabs bla ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro lab kyi sgron ma dngos su mjal te mos gus tshad med pa skyes/ de'i mthus kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bar gyur to/ /bla ma lab sgron dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor byin rlabs can de yang mdzad do/ /de ltar sku tshe 'dir lung rtogs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig brnyes pa'i tshul gnang ste/ de yang sngar bkod pa'i gsung mgur skyes thob kyi yon tan dpag med mnga' bas/ bskal ba dpag tu med pa nas nges pa'i don du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te zhing bye ba phrag khrig grangs med par/ la lar bltams shing zhing gzhan du yang byang chub tshul 85

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ston ston pa khyod kyi sku yi ni/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar tshad gzung du med pa zhig yin la/ drang ba'i don du ni rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i rnam rol gyis zhing 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa dang / zhing gzhan sna tshogs su sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing spel la bsrung ba'i chos smra ba dang /chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po sogs kyi rnam 'phrul tshad med pas gzhan phan gyi mdzad pas 'khor ba ji srid par 'da' ba zhig tu grub pa yin te/ sngar bshad pa ltar rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang ngo bo dbyer med du grub pa'i phyir dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'od chen po/ /mngon sum de yi yul dag na/ /byis pa'i gzugs kyis bzhugs pa yin/ /zhes dang / rgya dang rgya ni che nyid na/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni rab grub 'gyur/ /zhes rgya yul lung bstan zhing de na 'jam dpal gzhon nu byis pa sor skyes kyi gzugs sna tshogs kyi rnam 'phrul gyis mngon sum du bzhugs par gsungs la/ bdag nyid chen po 'di gang du 'khrungs pa'i gnas yul de dag kyang zhing chen bcu drug tu grags pa'i nang tshan mtsho sngon zhes bya bar bshad pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nu yang ston 86

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya tha ma la chos 'dzin cing skyong ba'i dge sbyong gi rnam rol gyis rgya bod kyi ljongs thub bstan dar ba'i yul kun tu bzhugs par gor ma chag la/ dam pa'i skyes bu chos spyan mnga' ba du mas sku snga phyi gnyis char rje btsun dang thugs rgyud gcig par bsngags pa ltar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs su legs par grub bo / /des na skye bas thob pa'i yon tan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku tshe 'di'i sbyang stobs la ltos pa med kyang sar gnas kyi bdag nyid chen po rnams kyang skyes rabs re re bzhin gsan bsam bsgom pa shin tu rgya chen po mdzad pa'i rnam par thar ba ltar / gangs can lum+bi'i tshal chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams gling du bzhugs te dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa mang po zhig las mdo rgyud kyi gsan sbyangs rgya chen po mdzad de/ thugs rgyud lung rtogs kyi yon tan rin po ches byur bur gtams nas kun tu chags pa med pa'i drang srong chen po'i spyod tshul phal ba'i blo yul du shong bar dka' ba thugs nyams su bzhes te tre bo hor yul du phebs nas kyang mdo rgyud spyi dang /khyad par gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi skor la gsan sbyangs legs par mdzad de gangs can gyi rgyud sde 'gyur khyad las byung ba'i 87

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dgongs pa mtha' dag phyogs dang ris su ma chad par/ ji skad du/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo lnga ba chen pos / ris med grub mtha'i bur shing 'o ma kun/ /gcig tu mngar ba'i ro myong ngag gi dbang / /zhes gsungs pa'i rnam par thar pa ltar rgyal bstan mtha' dag 'gal med du grub ste thugs nyams su bzhes pas mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan spyi la mnga' brnyes shing —/ khyad par byang chub kyi sems rin po che gnyis kyi gter du gyur ba'i tshul mdzad de/ skyes thob kyi yon tan rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du sbyangs stobs kyi chu bo grangs med pa bskyil te yon tan zad mi shes pa'i mdzod du gyur pa'i tshul mdzad do/ /de yang lung gi yon tan gyi dbang du byas te gzhung re gnyis kyi tshig don la rgyus yod pa tsam ma yin par pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i phyogs dang —/ rdo rje theg pa la yang gsar rnying gi rgyud sde gnyis char gyis bsdus pa'i mdo rgyud gangs ljongs 'dir da lta yongs grags su bzhugs so cog phal mo che zhig gi tshig dang don la mkhyen rab dbyar mtsho ltar gyur la/ rtogs pa'i yon tan la dang po tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ so so thar ba'i pham lhag gi nyes pa lta zhog ltung byed/ nyes byas la yang sdom gsum gong 'og gi gnang 88

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/bkag mi 'dra ba'i skabs thob kyi khyad par 'ga' re las bcas rkyang phra mo nub lhag nyal dang / rtsa sngon gcod pa lta bu yang ngo tsha dang khrel yod chen pos bsrungs te yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshul khrims la gus par byed cing legs par gnas pas/ sku la lhan skyes kyi dri bzang bo rjes phyogs su 'dom gsum bzhir 'gro zhing / gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas khang dang / na bza' sogs la lo du ma'i bar du yang dri de ngad mi yal ba zhig yod pa ni nges par tshul khrims kyi dri bsung yin par snang ngo / /de lta na yang btsun pa chos mgo ma thon pa'i ser khyim pa dang / dge bsnyen khyim na gnas pa sogs la nam yang sdang ba dang / brnyas thabs sogs cha tsam mi mdzad par thugs brtse bas chos dang bslab bya legs par gnang ste mnyes mnyes ltar mdzad pa zhig yod de/'di yang so skye rang bzhin pa ma yin pa'i gtan tshigs gcig tu 'dug go /byang sems kyi bslab bya la yang so thar las kyang gces spras chen pos pham pa dang nyes byas kyi ltung ba'i ris gnyis la rang bzhin gyis dran shes brtan pos srog dang bsdos te bsrung bar mdzad cing / gsang sngags kyi tshul khrims kyang de bzhin du rnam par dag par mdzad do/ /'on kyang 'di dag la ched du ma 89

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bsgrims kyang thugs rgyud rtsa nyon dang nye nyon gyi dri ma chung ba dang /gzhan phan gyi thugs dang / lha'i rnal 'byor sogs brtan pa'i stobs kyis sdom pa gong ma gnyis ngang gis dag pa zhig kyang yod par mngon no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa la thun mong ba dang /thun mong min pa gnyis yod pas thun mong ba ni/ sku tshe 'dir gsar du sbyangs pa la ma ltos par lhan skyes kyis dge ba'i dmigs rnam gcig la/ bzhag na g.yo med ri yi dbang bo bzhin/ /btang na dge ba'i dmigs pa kun la 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan po mnga' ste/ sku bsnyun gyi tshe dpyad rtsub po me btsa'i rigs dus gcig la bco lnga re bzhag pa sogs snga phyi du mar sgron pa la stong pa nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas tsha reg mi myong par 'dug pas ci tsam me btsa' sogs grangs mang dgos kyang skyon med ces zhal las gsungs pa thos so / /thun mong min pa la gnyis las/ theg pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems ni/ zhal lasal/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje de dngos su tshor ba sdug bsngal drag pos nyam thag pa la lhag par skye zhing de 'dra ma yin pa la mi skye ba zhig min par mnar med kyi mes dngos su gdung 90

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/bzhin pa'i dmyal ba dang lha mi'i bde skyid la spyod bzhin pa'i sems can gnyis la khyad par spu tsam med par skye ba zhig yin zhes gsungs pa ltar nyam thag la sha tsha snying nye'i nyams 'bur du mi btod par sems can kun la dus dang rnam pa kun tu thugs rgyud snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur ba zhig yin te/ de'i stobs kyis sgo gsum gyi mdzad pa gang mdzad la bstan 'gro la sman pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig lhur len pa las/ rang nyid kyi don du gzhol ba'i mdzad pa sna gcig yod pa phran bu lo ngo bcu gnyis su zhabs drung du bcar yang ma mthong la/ sku drung du bcar mkhan gzhan tsho'ang de ma mthong zhes gleng ba yin no/ /theg chen thun mong min pa rdo rje theg pa'i ting nge 'dzin la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan po mnga' bar the tshom med de/ gsung mgur du mar/ dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i 'dab brgya ci dga' ru bzhad cing / /mdo sngags zab rgyas lam gyi sbrang chang gis myos pas / /zhing sngags lhan skyes grogs kyi rkang drug gi tshogs rnams/ /rgyun ma'i zab gsang glu yi dbyangs snyan 'di a ho/ /snod 'di gzhi nas ma bcos lhun grub kyi gzhal yas/ /nang bcud rigs drug tshom bu dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ /gang snang dag pa rab 91

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'byams 'ba' zhig las med pas/ /'khor ba gzhi nas ma grub ngo mtshar 'di a ho/ /nyer bzhi'i gnas kyi bkod pa rang lus la tshang zhing / /rtsa khams dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rang bzhin du 'dug pas / /tsa ri ko ḍa la sogs gnas bskor yang ma dgos/ /ma bgrod gnas kyi ngo mtshar rang thob 'di a ho/ /nyi zla'i snang bar 'grogs pa'i cang shes la zhon nas/ /srid pa'i tshod khang 'grim pa'i nyon shes kyi dbang po/ /mtha' bral 'jigs rung khro bo'i rngam zhal du gsol bas/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong pham pa'i nga ro de a ho/ /zhes pa lta bu'i rdo rje'i glu ngo mtshar ba mang du mdzad pas shes so/ /shes rab kyi bslab pa la yang thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni/ gtso bo stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gi shes rab khyad par can yin la/ de yang gangs can gyi ljongs 'di'i nges don gyi lta ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i bzhed pa dri ma med pa de kho na la thugs nges shin tu chen pos snang stong phan tshun gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i stong dang rten 'brel gyi tshul la mngon par rtogs pa'i mkhyen rab kyis mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng thob pa ni/ sngar gyi sku gzhon nu'i dus kyi nyams mgur gyis kyang shes la/ gzhan yang de 92

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/dang mtshungs pa dus de tsam du sku mtshams bcad rgya'i khongs su lta ba'i mgur glu ru bzhes pa ni/ dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ngang nas / /gnyis med bla ma der 'dud do/ /rtsol med byin rlabs kyi gru char/ /skye med klong yangs nas phob cig /bsgom rgyu bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa/ /bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'di ngo mtshar/ /ngo mtshar skye mkhan gyi ban chung ske/ /kho rang rang ngos nas stong na/ /mtshar bya mtshar byed dang bral ba'i/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo de ha ha/ /bzla bya sngags 'khor gyi rim pa/ /bzlas bya'i sngags 'khor de mi dmigs/ /bzla bya zlo byed dang bral ba'i/ /sgyu ma'i sngags 'khor 'dingo mtshar/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo yi sngags 'khor/ /ngo mtshar blta mkhan gyi ban chung ske/ mtshar bya mtshar byed kyis stong na/ /ltad mo mthong mkhan de su zhig /dmigs pa lha sku la dmigs kyang / /dmigs bya'i lha sku de mi 'dug /dmigs bya dmigs byed dang bral yang / da dung dmigs mkhan 'di ngo mtshar/ /dmigs pa rang ngos nas bral zhing / /dmigs byed mkhan po yang stong nyid/ /dmigs med bde chen gyi dmigs pa/ /gnyis med zung 'jug du ha ha/ /zung gi rang bzhin kyang stong na/ /zung du 'jug rgyu de ci zhig /zung 93

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/med 'jug med kyi zung 'jug /tshe 'dir thob pa zhig smon no/ /smon bya smon byed kyis stong ba'i/ /bslu med rten 'brel gyi smon 'bras / /skye med chos dbyings kyi zhing sar/ /rtsol med rang byung du smin shog /ces pa 'di ni sngags btsun 7 mi bskyod rdo rjes hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gsum gyi thun mtshams su 'phral du bris pa dge'o/ zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang 'phags yul gyi lta ba'i 'jog mtshams la rang rgyud pa man chad kyi grub mtha' bzhi dang —/ bod 'dir yang rnying ma bka' brgyud sa skya sogs kyi lugs srol dang / gang dang yang mnyam pa med pa ri bo dge ldan pa'i ring lugs de la de mtshungs su yid ches thob tshul gyi lta ba'i gsung mgur zab mo ngo mtshar ba yod do/ /shes rab kyi bslab pa thun mong ba yin pa ni/ sngags bla med kyi 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa khyad par can de/ de yang / nyi zla'i snang bar 'grogs pa'i cang shes la zhon pa/ /srid pa'i tshong khang 'grim pa'i nyon shes kyi dbang po/ /mtha' bral 'jigs rung khro bo'i rngam zhal du gsol bas / /brgyad khri bzhi stong pham pa'i nga ro de a ho/ /zhes sngar drangs pas mtshon rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs rnams su mang du 'byung bas shes so/ /mdor na sku tshe 'dir yon tan gsar du brnyes 94

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/pa'i tshul mdzad pa'i rnam par thar ba rnams dgung lo sum cu'i steng du nyams dbyangs su 'di ltar bzhes te/ na mo gu ru/ mang mang bsod nams zung gi rin chen gyis nyos pa'i/ /gces gces dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i nor bu de lon byung / /skyid skyid snang ba spro ba'i spang ljongs la theg dus/ /lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu klung dang 'phrad byung / /dal dal sdod khom med par 'chi bdag gi drung du/ /myur myur 'gro ba'i ngang tshul ston byed du go nas / /yang yang ga nas bsam kyang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng zhig /gang gang yul nas ma rnyed bya thabs rang zad byung / /ya ya shi nas 'gro sa rang sems la dris pas/ /a a khyod la 'gro sa dmyal ba las med zer/ /'u 'u de ru skyes na ci byed la bsam pas/ /'jigs 'jigs khong nas lang bas sdod dbang rang ma byung / /mkhyen mkhyen re sa'i skyabs gnas khyod rang las med pas/ /bde bde zhing khams zhig la 'phen rogs ces zhus tshe/ /ha ha blun skad ma 'don sems can gyi las tshul/ /rang rang bgo skal yin pas las 'bras la 'dzem zer/ /zhib zhib bsam blo btang tshe sngar byas la 'gyod nas/ /gces gces srog la babs kyang phyin chad la sdom snyam / /dad dad gus pas sems kyis bzlas brjod dang phyag 95

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bskor / /yang yang bla ma'i gsung bzhin yun ring du 'bad pas/ /mang mang bskal bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung gi gangs ri/ /gsal gsal byin rlabs nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi rtse dgas/ /lhug lhug 'bol 'bol bzhus pa'i rgyun bzang gi btung bas/ /yang yang mas ded byas pas lan chags kyang tshim byung / /skyid skyid mgo skor gtong ba'i mngon mtho yi gnas na/ /brtan brtan yid gtad pher ba yod snyam zhig ma shar/ /mang mang mdo sde'i gzhung dang bla ma la dris pas/ ('di yan gyis skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i rtogs pa skyes tshul bstan) e e gnas tshul sems dang sdug bsngal las med zer/ /zab zab dri ma med pa'i lung rigs kyis dpyad tshe/ /mtho mtho srid pa'i rtse nas mnar med yan gnas bcas / /mang mang 'gro ba'i rang mtshang ji bzhin du rig tshe/ /ha ha rang gi gnas tshul ma mthong 'di mtshar snyam/ ('di yan skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes tshul bstan)nga rang thar bas ci byed ma rgan gyi sems can/ /kun kyang thar ba'i dus shig e yod na snyam nas/ /'khrul ba bzlog pa'i thabs la bsam blo zhig btang bas/ /'khrul gzhi 'jig ltar mthong nas dpa' gdengs zhig bskyed nas/ /rin chen byang chub sems kyi rta 96

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/mchog gi steng la/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam bzhi'i sga cha zhig spras te / /sar gnas sngon byon gong ma'i go cha de bgos nas/ /bden med rig pa'i rdo rje'i mtshon rnon des brgyabs pas/ /bden 'dzin brgyad khri bzhi stong dpung tshob/sa dang bcas pa/ /dngos med stong ba'i mkha' mthar rjes med du bros song / /de dus drin ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i rgyun gyi dag byed du babs tshe/ /nyes ltung dri ma'i rnam pa yongs dag la song nas/ /nyes bral rig pa'i shel dkar me long dang phrad de/ /snang srid 'khor 'das bde stong ye shes kyi rol rtsal/ /rang snang zhi khro'i lha tshogs rang byung gi sngags sgra/ /'od gsal lhun grub sku dang zung 'jug gi bkod pa/ /stong gzugs 'ja' tshon sgyu ma'i lha sku la shar song / /chos gzugs dbyer med mthar thug 'od gsal gyi 'bras bus/ /kun gyi thob 'dod smon pa don ldan du gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyis rang bzhin du smras ba dge /('di yan gyis skyes bu chen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs tshul gsungs) zhes skyes bu gsum gyi lam go rim bzhin du nyams su blangang pas mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan skyes tshul gsungs la/ yang rtogs pa'i gdeng khyad par can thob tshul las 97

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/brtsams pa'i nyams mgur 'di 'dra zhig kyang gnang ste/ na mo gu ru / ke la sha yi rtse mor gangs seng gi 'gying stangs/ /khe drag bla dpon phal gyi rang mthong de dor nas/ /ge sar 'dab stong bcud la rkang drug gis rol bzhin/ /de ring blo gros thos bsam sbrang rtsi la 'byar song / /ce spyang dregs pa'i skad bzhin mngon rlom gyi nga rgyal / /che che zab zab rang 'dod grub mtha' de dor nas/ /je zhig ma yin mdo sngags rab 'byams la sbyangs pas/ /nye ring chags sdang phyogs med dag snang la shar song / /te lo nā ro ba bzhin thugs rje yis rjes 'dzin/ /the tshom dra ba gcod pa'i drin ldan gyi bla ma/ /de las sangs rgyas gzhan med nges shes kyi drin las / /ne'u les nor bu ji bzhin gdams zab de thob pas/ /pe har dkor mdzod dbang na zhen rgyu dang dga' brod/ /phe ring 'phrul gyi mkhar la mtshar rgyu yang med par/ /be'us ma bzhin bsam rgyu bla ma las med pas/ /me dang spra bzhin byin rlabs pha phogs su thob byung / /tse nes 'gro 'dod blo mang rkang rgod kyis mtha' bskor/ /tshe 'dir gar thon med pas mdo shor gyi ro nyal/ /dza ya'i dgongs don sgrub la spang bya ru nges nas/ /wa mo'i bzur 'gros byas pas 'gro tshod kyang zin byung / /zhe nas 'khor bar skyo 98

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/ba'i nges 'byung gi blo sna/ /ze ba yar la 'then 'dod rigs drug gi 'gro la/ /'e thon yid gnyis med par lhag bsam gyis blangs pas / /ye shes lha tshogs dgyes pa'i dbugs dbyung yang thob byung ske/ /re dogs blun sgom stong bshad kha 'byams de dor zhing / /le lo gnyid rmug rnam g.yeng rgyang ring du bsrings nas/ /she mong gcig gis chos kun khur 'khyer gyi gdams par/ /se chen rgyal pa ji bzhin lhan skyes la ngos zin/ /he rog ma spangs rang rig rang sa nas zungs dang / /e ma gcig shes kun grol de ka rang lags so / /ka phreng /e la sbyar ba'i rang bzhin gyi dbyangs chung / /a mtshar rtsed mo'i tshul du e yig la bgrang bas/ /don gyi brjod bya 'brel ba thob tshod kyis shes nas/ /de bzhin spyod par rgyal ba sras bcas kyis mthun 'gyur/ /'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyis smras pa dge'o/ /zhes pa'i mgur dbyangs tshig don gnyis char bzang ba ngo mtshar can 'di 'dra zhig kyang mdzad de/ zhib tu bsam na thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rnam thar gyi don 'dus la/brjod don nyams rtogs kyi yon tan 'gangs che bar mngon no/ /des na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ ma ltar brtse ba'i bla mas legs bskyangs shing / /mi yi seng ge'i gsung rab pad+mo'i tshal/ /99

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/me tog la dga'i bung ba ltar bsten pas/ /mu mtha' yas pa'i chos la blo gros rgyas/ /zhes rang gi rnam par thar pa gsungs pa ji lta bzhin du yon tan gyi gter chen por gyur ba'i tshul mdzad do//gsum pa yon tan gsar du brnyes pa'i tshul mdzad nas bstan 'gro'i don gyi bya ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul la/ mgo log srin yul 'dir ji ltar mdzad pa dang / yul gzhan du ji ltar mdzad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dgung lo sum cu bzhes pa me mo sbrul gyi lo gsar skor nas stong skor dgon du zhabs drung sprul sku rin po ches gdan drangs te bla brang steng du bzhugs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang / gzhi bsnyen chen mo'i khrid gnang nas rje gser khang ba yab sras kyi phyag bzhes ltar bsnyen pa'i sbyor dngos mjug rnams phyag len du 'debs tshul gyi bsnyen yig rgyas pa klog pas don grub skal bzang yid kyi re skong zhes bya ba de mdzad do/ /gzhan yang bla ma mchod pa dang / dga' ldan phyag rgya chen po'i khrid rgyas par gnang zhing / dad ldan gyi slob ma khri zur blo bzang 'jam dpal dang / sngags rams pa blo bzang rab 'byor gnyis la phyag chen dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig kyang gsar rtsom gnang / de ltar so so'i mos bstun gyi bka' chos 100

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/du ma zhig gnang nas bzhugs skabs/ chos la shin tu dkar ba'i dad stobs dang rnam dpyod kyis mdzes pa dbang chen dpon dam pa mdo sde nas snga sor zhig nas skyabs rje brag dkar rin po che'i snyan pa gsan pa dang / dbang stod du dgon sde zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i bca' bsgrigs mang du byas kyang rkyen dbang du song bas/ brag dkar rin po che la gdan 'dren gyi zhu yig snga phyi du mar phul ba yod thog de skabs dge thar gyi chos sgar yang brtan mi brtan byung bas bstan 'gror dgongs te 'go log tu phebs dgos tshul gyi bka' yig bang chen bcas gnang byung bas bka' bzhin bsgrub pa legs tshogs kyi rtsa bar gzigs nas brag dkar bla brang nas phebs chas zhus te sku tshab mdzad nas/ stong skor nas tshur gser rta brgyud de wa shul dpon bla'i sgar du phebs/ der dpon bla bsod nams nor bus zhus pa bzhin gcod dbang brgya rtsa sogs 'dod chos du ma zhig gnang / khong gi sras che ba de khang dmar dege bshes kyi mtshan gsol dang 'brel khri 'don mnga' gsol mdzad / sang sang dung dkar dgon gyi mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa shel ldan dang / g.yu sgra sogs kyis kyang dad gus lhur len gyis bka' chos ci rigs zhus shing dngos 'bul dngul ting 101

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bdun cha dang / gling bu sogs phul nas mkhan po shel ldan gyis tshe rabs thams cad du 'bral med rjes 'dzin gyis skyabs 'jug zhus shing smon lam btab/ khong yang de nas yun ring ma thogs par sku gshegs so/ /de nas stag thog nang brgyud de sngar nas shes 'brel yod pa dang / brag dkar rin po che'i bka' bzhin lcags shul bla ma la ched du gtad de zla ba lnga ba'i nang tsam du dbang stod du phebs so/ /de tshe kho bos kyang bsod nams chen po'i mthu las/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi yi gzugs kyis bstan 'gro'i mgon du bsam bzhin du phebs pa'i nges pa don gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'di nyid zhal bzang mngon sum du mthong ba'i skal ba rnyed pas rang tshod kyi dga' ba dang mos pa rgya cher skyes so/ /de nas dbyar thog lcags shul rgya mtshos zhabs zhu zhus te dar stod dang dar smad ri bar dkar bsod mdzad/dpon g.yog 'bri rar bzhugs skabs shig o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po'i zhal gzigs te byin rlabs lung bstan du ma zhig thob/dar smad phebs skabs snyan mo ri'i mdun ngos kyi dar chu kha nas thod pa dum bu gcig pa mtshan ldan zhig rnyed pas shin tu dgyes tshor mdzad cing / 'bral med du bcing ste/ snyan mo ri 'dir 102

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/bshad sgrub kyi bstan gzhi zhig tshugs pa'i ltas dang dngos grub kyi rdzas su snang ngo / /ston ri ba dang lhan cig rgyu nang du phebs/ dung dkar mchod rten de lo gsar bzhengs kyi rab gnas kyi ched du/dpal sprul rin po che'i dngos slob bya bral bla ma dam pa bshad sgrub dge legs dpal bzang der gdan drangs pa dang mjal phrad mdzad/ phan tshun dad pa dag snang chen pos phar rten 'brel bstod pa'i zab khrid rgyas pa zhig phul zhing / tshur dpal sprul gsung gi zhal gdams kyi skor dang / tshig gsum gnad brdeg gi khrid cig gsan/ khos skor bla ma rin po che nas shin tu bsngags brjod chen pos kun la bka' chos zhu rgyu'i rting bskul mang po zhig mdzad song / ston mjug der kho bo cag 'ga' re la lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa dang bskyed rim gyi khrid/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i sems bskyed drug pa'i dgag bya ngos 'dzin bar gyi tshig spyi sbrags ma'i 'dzub khrid cig gnange kho bo gcig pu la gang zag gi bdag med nas bzung shes bya rtag dngos kyi mtshan nyid rab dbye'i mdzub khrid dang /khyab skor du mas mtshon bsdus tshan 'ga' re gnang bas dga' spro chen pos e shes bltas/ thugs brtse ba'i bka' mchid mang po 103

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang / 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang sogs lhag pa'i lha 'ga' re'i rjes gnang dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang /bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig kyang gnang ste dgyes bzhin du rjes su bzung / skabs der ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i zhal gzigs shig kyang dngos sam rmi lam ci rigs su yod par snang la bstod pa he ru ma'i rngams glu zhes bya ba zhig mdzad/ mtshams der dbang chen sgar pa'i sprul sku sngags 'chang 'gro 'dul rnam rgyal rdo rje nas gdan drangs te klong snying sngon 'gro'i khrid dang / snying thig pod gnyis kyi dbang dang / dngos gzhi rdzogs chen ye shes bla ma'i khrid bcas zla ba gcig ring gsungs shing kun mkhyen bstan rgyas smon lam dang / sham+bha la'i smon lam gnyis khong gis zhus ngor mdzad / skabs der sngon gnas rjes dran zhig kyang blo bzang rab rgyas dang nged gnyis la gsungs kyang rgyas par zhu ma spobs/ de nas yang dung dkar du phebs te rdo rje phur pa rgyud lugs sogs dbang bka' du ma gnang zhing / gtso bo dgun thog der yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod kyi khrid rgyas par gnang / sa rta'i lo gsar gyi dga' ba dang po'i tshes la kho bo cag gnyis dgos dbang 'ga' rer gzigs sprul ba'i sku re'i ming 'dog gnang ste mnga' 104

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/gsol khri 'don mdzad/ de mtshams dbang chen dpon po mdo sde'i spun dpon tshangs pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar phebs/ de bar dpon gyis kyang dang len cher ma mdzad pa la skabs der lugs gnyis kyi gsung 'phros mang du mdzad pas dpon po yang chos lugs kyi dad gus dang / 'jig rten lugs la mkhyen dpyod ha cang che snyam nas yid tshim pa byung zhing —/ kho bos sngar dar lags rgyas mdor dgon sde zhig e tshugs snyam nas kuḥthog si tu sprul sku dang / dbang mda'i gling sprul sogs skyes chen mang po zhig gis sa 'dul mdzad nas sa bcos su mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa re dang mkhar thog so gnyis pa zhig brtsigs nas sngar gyi chos rgyun gyis dbang gis maḥthog tshang nas 'debs rgyu byas te lo drug tsam bsgugs kyang cang ma byung bas ma theb / da dung phyogs 'di'i skye bos 'di phyi'i skyabs 'jug zhu sa'i chos sde zhig la re bci che bas kha sang rtsa shul sprul sku'i drung du dbyar gnas re 'dzugs rgyu'i gros byed kyin yod skabs/ nged kyi a mchod nas bos te mar me zad 'gro gin yod pas shog zer bas sprul sku tshang nas rten 'brel ma legs pas mi 'ong zhes bzhag song / kho bo las dang bsod nams dman par 'dug zhus pa la/105

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/de 'ong rgyu red thugs ngal mi dgos/ nged cag rim gyis gros mol byas pas chog ces gsungs pas dpon po yang mgu/ dpyid thog sde nang tshang gi ri khrod pa rnams kyi gtsos bla grwa mang po la gcod dbang brgya rtsa dang / snying thig ya bzhi gnang nas dbang chen sprul sku'i sgar du phebs te sems nyid ngal gso'i khrid rgyas par gsungs / skabs der glo bla ma grags bzang nas nyams sad kyi dri ba 'ga' re byas pa la dris lan gnang bas khong dad de bka' chos ci rigs zhu rgyu'i don du me tog thang du smyung chen khar gdan drangs / de nas gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dbang dang /sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung sogs gnang / yar phebs lam khos skor bya btang bla ma rin po che'i mdun du phebs/ dgung snying dang dgung grangs dris nas lo rtsis 'ga' re mdzad de/ khyed a bu tshang 'dra min nam zhes gsungs pa la cang mi gsungs par bzhad mo zhig mdzad/ a bu tshang red smras na yang yon tan gyi ngos nas ngo tsha bar mi 'dug lo rtsis byas na yang me phag la sku gshegs pa yin pas khyed kyi dgung snying sa byi dang 'grigasku 'das khar 'gro don shar phyogs su yod zer gsungs pa lta bu'i lo rgyus kyang yod/nges par yin rgyu red gsungs pas/ de nas bzung dpal sprul 106

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/sprul skur grags so/ /de nas sngar hor brag 'go'i dge thar chos sgar du bzhugs skabs shig nas bzung snga phyir dngos nyams rmi lam du chos rgyal li byin ha ras ched du bskul pa ltar grub dbang dge slong rin po che'i mdun du 'byon rtsis kyis sde nang ri khrod kyi bla ma 'od zer bang chen du bsdangs te/ shar wod chos mdzad bla ma rin po che der mkha' spyod kyi chos skor zhu rgyu'i yi ge rten bcas phul bas thugs dgyes tshor gnang 'dug pa ltar der phebs/rgyang grags gnyis gsum gyi tshod tsam khong chibs bsur zhabs thang du byon te/ phan tshun phyag mdzad res sogs dad gus rgya chen po mdzad/ der zla ba phyed tsam bzhugs nas mkha' spyod phyi nang gi dbang dang / de'i sgrub dkyil sogs chos tshan rnams kyi lung dang /gsang chen slob bshad zab mo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi yig cha gsar ba gsang chen lhun po'i mdzes rgyan gyi bshad lung bcas gsan zhing /yab sras gnyis kyis tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad skabs tshogs glur rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtogs pa mgur du 'then pa'i rdo rje'i glu shin tu ngo mtshar ba zhig phul bas mnyes so/ /grub dbang rin po che nas kyang chos rgyal sku lngar gsol mchod dgos pa'i zhal bkod gnang zhing 'byung 'gyur mkhyen pa'i phrin bcol gnyer gtad kyi 107

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ljags rtsom gsar ba 'di nyid gnang / de nas yar phebs te gling dgon par bla ma dam pa chos rdor gtsos bla grwa mang po la snying thig ya bzhi gnang / de skabs sku zhabs brag dkar rin po che 'dzi kur phebs yod zer ba gsan pas grub sgar bar du phebs kyang ma bden / a myes bla ma dam chos dang mjal/ phan tshun chos 'brel gsan zhing mdo sngags kyi gsung gleng 'ga' re byas pas khong ngo mtshar / de nas dbang stod spyi srung du phebs te/ dbang chen dpon tshe mgon gtsos tshogs mang la rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu'i dbang bstsal cing / rdo bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs nyi ma dang / de'i sku mched ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ sog po bla ma 'jigs med grags pa sogs bla grwa bco lnga skor la bde mchog dril bu phyi dkyil dang / rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis/ rig byed ma rnams kyi dbang rjes gnang bstsal/ skabs 'dir gnod sbyin g.yung drung lcags rtse yin zer ba zhig gis chang zom gang phul de chos zhu zer ba'i gzim lam byung zhing / yul lha de dbang chen gyi dpon po 'di dag gi thun mong min pa'i dgra lhar gyur gshis de nas bzung dpon rnams kyang shin tu dad 'dun che bar byung snang / dbyar gzhung lcim lung du rdo bla ma sku mched gnyis dang / sang sang bla ma 108

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/ban kho bcas bla grwa bco lnga skor la rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang / bde mchog lū u pa'i dbang gnang /mgo log bla ma phun tshogs kyis zhus ngor a ma la 'bod pa'i gdung 'bod thugs rje'i 'dab stong bkrol ba'i dad pa'i nyin byed ces pa'i rje btsun ma'i gdung 'bod gsol 'debs de yang mdzad / skyabs rje brag dkar rin po che'i bstan srid spyi dang /khyad par de skor dar mdo'i rgya'i mdun nas brag mgo dgon pa dang thag gcod dgos pas cir 'gyur thugs mi bde bar nyin bzhin gsar rnying gi bstan srung spyi dang / khyad par gnod sbyin chen po yang le ber gyi gsol mchod mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi gter byon brgya tshar chag med lta bur mdzad pas gzims lam du ce spyang bdun rjes su 'brangs pa sogs kyi srung ma dgyes pa'i rtags mtshan mang du byung yod par 'dug der nyin gcig skyo bsang du spang ljongs me tog bkra ba zhig tu bzhugs nas nyin gung nas gzims te phyi nyin nyin gung la sleb tsam du bzhugs yar bzhengs skabs byang phyogs dmag dpung chen po zhig g.yos byung ba sogs gzims lam du byung tshul gsung 'dug pa phyis su zi ling rgya dmag 'ong ba'i 'byung 'gyur gzigs par snang / de nas dar lag rgyas 109

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mdor dpon gyis drangs pa ltar phebs te gzhi chen stag rtse'i sprul sku chung ngu sogs 'ga' re la klong snying sngon 'gro'i khrid dang /dung dkar bla ma g.yu sgra dang / bla ma grags bzang / gter sprul rin po che pad+ma mkhyen brtse 'od zer/ rdo bla ma rin po che dang /lcags shul bla ma/ nged cag sogs bla grwa sum cu skor la/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs lha so gnyis kyi dbang dang sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas kyi rjes gnang rgyas par bstsal zhing /skabs der dpon pos dgon pa gsar 'debs dgos pa'i zhu ba nan tan chen pos phul bas/ zhal nas 'dir tsho ser dbang shed che ba yang mang du yod pas bla dpon thams cad nas zhib gros mdzod la gros thag chod/ dgon sde zhig 'dzugs rgyu red tshe dar gyi snyan mo rir snga phyir rten 'brel bzang po yod pas de ma gtogs gzhan du mi 'dzugs gsungs/ de yang skabs der gzims lam du lha mo'i cha byad can sha ba zhon pa zhig 'ong nas glegs bam chung ngu zhig bsnams te kho mo dar gyi snyan mo ri nas 'ong / glegs bam 'di dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rjes nged la gtad pa yin/ da khyod la 'bul ran song zhes phul ba mis pa sogs lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan du ma yod par 'dug der dbang stod kyi bla grwa rnams ni kha 110

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/mthun par ha cang blo babs ma byung yang dpon po la 'jigs nas dgon pa 'deb rgyur thag bcad do/ /de nas skyabs rje brag dkar rin po che 'dzi kur phebs pa gsan nas brel myur gyis phebs/yab sras mjal phrad mdzad nas phan tshun dgyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ lam zhor rdo grub sgar du yang phebs te/ grub sprul rin po che 7 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i mdun du zhu yig dang / sgyu 'phrul spyi don gsar rtsom gsang chen mdzod kyi lde'u mig dpar du 'khod rgyu'i rting bskul dang cha rkyen dngul phyed khe bcas phul/ grub sprul rin po che'i thugs sras mkhan thog pa 'jigs med 'od gsal gyis kyang shag tu drangs te dad gus dag snang mdzad/ de nas yar dung dkar lung du phebs te rta phyugs brgya skor gyi phyag rdzas byung rigs dang / sngar brag dkar bla brang gi chas ka rnams bcas thams cad mar 'dzi kur phul te dpon g.yog gnyis kho nar mdzad/ dgun thog sdong khrom gser sna'i khug tu bzhugs te pad+ma 'bum stod ma'i skor gyi chos zhu ci rigs la bka' chos mang du gnang zhing / khyim pa yang mang zhig sna gcig sna 'ga' sogs bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la bkod/de nas don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo gsar tshes kyi dpyid der 111

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dpon mdo sde rang nyid gser snar phebs te chos sde gsar 'dzugs kyi don du snyan mo rir phebs dgos tshul zhus pa dgyes bzhin gnang nas nag pa zla ba'i nang tsam du snyan mo rir phebs song —/ phebs phral phyag rdzas la rta gsum tsam yod pa dar chu kha nas jag pas ded kyang thugs bzod pa'i go cha bzhes te g.yo med du bzhugs pa ni/ ji skad du pad+ma'i rtsa ba'i skyes rabs las/ dam pa rnams ni sems 'khrugs pas/ /tshe zad nas ni shi yang bla/ /de bas mkhas pa srog phyir yang / /yid ni 'khrugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gtsug phud dbang phyug gi skyes rabs las/ brgyags pas bsnyems sam gal te ma brtags nas/ /bdag la gnod pa byed pa 'dir byung na/ /sa rdul stug po char gyis mnan pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid gson bzhin de ni yongs mi gtong / /zhes khro ba'i dgra gnon par gsungs/ de nas nyin bzhin dgon sde gsar 'dzugs dmigs te drug cu ba re bsngo bar mdzad cing / kho bo cag bcu skor la/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i grub mtha' gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kyi mdzub khrid gnang / nyin gcig rgyab ri'i rtser bsang gtong dgos zhes phebs te bsang btang skabs bsang re zhig ma 'bar bas thugs 'tshub ste bka' bkyon 112

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/dang phyag 'beb mang du gnang / khyad par rdo mgo bo tsam pa zhig gis gsol dpon dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi mgor brgyab kyang rma tsam yang ma byung ba kun gyis grub pa'i rtags mtshan ya mtshan par gleng ba byung zhing / dgon sde gsar 'debs la gegs byed pa'i nag phyogs pa zhig bskrad par yang grags so/ /de nas sngar nyag rong gter chen rin po ches sang sang dung dkar dgon du bum sgrub mdzad skabs bla ma g.yu sgra'i ngag las sems phyoṭa kyi chos kyi gsang mtshan 7 mkha' klong yangs pa rtsal zhes zhu ba sogs gsan pas lung zin du dgongs te dgyes tshor chen po mdzad nas/bla ma g.yu sgra'i gdong la phyag yig 'tshams zhus yod pa bzhin phan tshun las smon rten 'brel gyi mthun par yod par dgongs te nyag rong sgar du phebs/ de tshe lo de'i sngar lo tsam nas gter chen rin po che'i mdun du zhing skyong sedha mu kha dngos gzugs kyis/las 'phro'i dbang gis dgongs gter bton/ /snga rabs skye ba rjes dran gzhan/ /las can de 'dra'i skyes bu 'byung / /de tshe de la gus pa gyis/ /zhes lung ston byas yod pa de yin dgongs te mjal phrad dgyes tshor bcas mdzad nas sngon gnas rjes dran yod med bka' 'dri gnang bas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshor skye ba 113

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsal bor dran pa'i lo rgyus zhib zhus byas pas shin tu thugs dgyes shing ngo mtshar nas/ sngon gnas rjes dran yod na de 'dra zhig yod dgos pa red/ pho des zhes phyis su kho bo la bka' gnang —/ yang khyod dpal sprul rin po cher da lta grags gin yod pas de dran nam gsungs pa la de rab rib tsam las gsal bo rang med ces zhus 'dug pa yang phyis su nged rang la gsungs/yang gter chen rin po che'i zhal nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che phebs skabs kho bo sngon gyi las shig gis tshe rabs du mar grir gum pa yang dran/ da lta yang grir 'chi ba'i lha dang bla ma'i lung re yang yod 'dug pa la/ rkyen de rin po che khyed kyis sel ba 'dra bas thugs rjes bzung dgos gsungs par/ 'o legs so/ /nged cag gter ston du ming btags pa tshos re gnyis ma gtogs thad kur 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rgyal bstan la bya ba byed rgyu dka' 'dug na/ khyed bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyi sku gegs re bsal ma thub na gter ston du ming btags pas ci bya / de 'dra de nged tsho'i las skal yin pas ngas sel nus zhes ngas kha pho bton zhes rdo rje phur pa yang snying spu gri'i dbang lung byas zhes nged la gsungs/ phyis su zi ling rgya chen skabs sku srog 114

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/la nyen ma byung ba gter chen rin po che 'di'i bka' drin yin 'dug zhing skyong gi lung la dgongs te gter ston bla brang nas kyang dad gus chen pos bkur bzos yang dag pa byas shing byon khar dre'u re sogs 'bul ba yang sbam mtho ba phul/ sgyu ma'i rnam thar 'di dag la dpag na yang rang re tshos las 'bras kyi blang dor la shin tu gzab dgos par 'dug go /yar phebs nas stag lung mdor dbang stod kyi spyi srung khar dpon mdo sde dang rnam pa gnyis gas/ gling dbang chen dang / thang mjug rong ba gnyis sngar zhig nas ma 'jags pa bsdum par mdzad/ skabs der gnod sbyin chen po yang le ber gyis/ chos sde gsar 'dzugs kyi rkyen sel mthun grub kyi sku rim dang / khyad par yul phyogs 'khrug rtsod yo lang chen po 'byung bas de dag la phan par jo bo rin po che bdud 'dul thub pa chen po'i sku brnyan dang / phyogs bzhir sgrub sde bzhi 'dzugs dgos pa sogs kyi lung ston mdzad pa ltar de skabs jo bo'i sku gsar bzhengs dgos tshul gsungs nas thugs thag bcad/ de'i khur len do dam du ra skor bla ma tshogs rnam bsko bzhag mdzad/ sngar me tog thang du phebs skabs gzim lam du me tog sin rnyu wa ra dmar po zhig gcig gis phul te 'di khyed 115

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kyis kha 'byed dgos zhus par zhal chab btab pas 'dab ma stong ldan shin tu 'od chags pa zhig tu gyur pa la bud med min yang skyes pa'i kha phrus kyang me tog 'di kha phye bar 'dug dgongs pa byung gsungs shing / phyi nyin sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid kyi thugs gter yi ge 'ga' zhig gzigs 'bul byas pas rten 'brel legs po byung —/ nged rang la bcar na phan thogs pa'i las smon dang skal ba yod par 'dug gsungs pa ltar sku drung du bcar bas 'di skabs rang nyid kyi thugs gter lung byang rnams ltar chos skyong ba'i rgyal bo tshangs pa lha yi me tog gi rnam 'phrul du bkas bsngags nas mnga' gsol khri 'don mdzad/ de nas rje nyid dang gling bla ma rin po che dpon g.yog dang / rdo bla ma sku mched gnyis/lcags shul bla ma dang / nged cag sogs dge 'dun bzhi bcu skor gyis chos sde gsar 'dzugs kyi thog ma'i gzhi gsum gyi phyag len ches gtsang ba mdzad/ dbyar gnas nang der byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i bka' chos zhib rgyas yig cha'i dpe thog tu kha bshad rkyang ba'i bro 'tsham pa ma yin par nyams myong la bkal te thugs thog nas zla gcig tsam gyi ring gnang / phur ba yang snying spu gri'i bsnyen bsgrub mdzad pas me lce la mar khu ltar thal 'byin bzhi'i 116

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/rtogs pa la gdeng thob pas/ phur bu'i rtogs brjod kyi rdo rje'i glu ngo mtshar ba zhig kyang mdzad/ dbyar gnas nang der de'u mgo zhabs drung dang / dpal sprul tshang sogs kyi dngos slob sku tshe phal cher sgrub la gzhol ba'i sems dpa' chen po dge rtse sprul sku rin po che 7 ngag dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin tshang snyi'i chu tshan la phebs zhor du rje nyid dpal sprul yin pa'i snyan pa gsan pa la brten nas mjal du byon/ 'dam thang du zhag mal mdzad skabs gzims lam du ras gur gcig tu dpal sprul rin po che gzims nas bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal bas dbu btegs te/ 'o tshul lo khyed slebs pa e yin/ da mi rgas na rang yul dang / bya rgas na tshang yul snyegs pa'i dpe ltar rang yul du 'gro ran pa yin zhes sogs gsung gleng mang bo byas pa mis pa ltar phyi nyin mjal 'phrad mdzad pas bzhugs sa sogs gzims lam ji lta bur byung bar 'dug phan tshun dad pa dang dag snang chen pos tshur 'od dpag med la brten pa'i zhing sbyong cho ga dpag med myur lam gsan/phar sems dpa' chen po 'di la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang bo'i zhal nas/ rdor sems kyi chos 'dis 'gro don mdzod ces bka' bab tu bsngags pa ltar dad ldan shin tu mang po zhig 117

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/lha mchog 'di'i bsnyen bsgrub la bkod de srin gling 'dir 'gro don shin tu rgya che bas dad gus chen pos smin gling gter chen rin po che'i gter byon rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang khrid gsan/zhal ngo bzlog ma nus par khong gi mdzad pa 'byung 'gyur du ma zhig gsang thabs su lung ston kyang mdzad/ dbyar gnas grol nas rdo bla ma tshang gis ri khrod du gdan drangs/ rje btsun ma'i tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod cher mdzad/ rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu'i dbang dang / brtse'i rjes gnang bcas gnang rta skad thengs gsum gyi rdo rje'i mgur cig mdzad/ ri khrod der yang dbang mdzad bzhad pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i ming gnang /ston der kho bo cag bdun la dus bzang zhig tu rigs lung gnang nas mtshan nyid chos grwa gsar tshugs kyi skar 'dzin mdzad/dgun der gzims spyil sa khang chung ngu zhig gsar du bzor bcug ste der bzhugs/ nged cag bla grwa nyi shu skor la bse ngag dbang bkra shis kyi bsdus grwa'i yig cha'i steng nas mdzub khrid rgyas par gnang zhing / kho bo cag 'ga' re la dbyangs can ma'i brda sprod kyi mtshams sbyor lnga'i sa ris cig kyang gnang ngo / /lo de'i mjug sprel zla'i nyer brgyad la bya btang bla ma rin po che bshad 118

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/sgrub dge legs dpal bzang po sku gshegs pa'i bka' chems ltar dgongs rdzogs la phebs/ lcags sprel gyi lo gsar tshes la kun bzang sprul sku sogs khri 'don mdzad/ skabs shig ri zhig gi steng na sngags 'chang ral ba dang gzan dkar mnabs pa spyod lam zhi dul dang ldan pa zhig de'i phar ngos su yang sngags 'chang ral ba can shin tu gtum po lta bu snang ba zhig sdang mig bgrad de mi gcig gi lce la phur ba zhig btab nas yod pa la sngags pa snga ma de la khyed su yin/ khong gis ci mdzad pa red ces dris pas nged rang rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po yin/ khong nged kyi bla ma rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje yin pa la mi rnams kyi khyod la 'bar sha mang po zhig byed du 'ong bas de'i ngag gnon pa red ces gsungs pa mis/ dpyid der jo bo gsar bzhings kyi don du bla ma g.yu sgras zhabs zhu zhus te rma pha rir phebs/ der bcu shog bcu'i smyung chen steng du phebs/ bla brang bla ma tshang / gtsos bla grwa rnams kyis ser steng sogs dad gus dang len dang bkur bzos mdzad / klong snying sngon 'gro'i khrid thun gcig tu gnang / 'byor ldan gtong phod yangs pa skya shul byang lo sar gdan drangs/ jo sku'i thebs su dngul khol lnga sogs 'bul ba sbam che bar phul/ de 119

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nas dge rtse sgar du phebs/ der bla ma rin po che'i drung nas nyang gter rta nag gi dbang gsan/ jo bo'i thebs su dngul bcu khol drug tsam phul/ jo sku de bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi gsos sman du shin tu bzang bas legs par grub pa zhig cis kyang dgos/khyed phyag yangs pas dngul 'di dag gis mtshon dad 'bul che chung ci byung bar skabs nas chud zos su ma song ba zhig mdzod/ /nga dge rtse ban rgan lo rgan pa'i gtam yin sogs zhal bkod kyang mang zhig gnang / de nas tshur phebs skabs nyag rong gter chen rin po che nas lcags shul bla ma'i gdung la dus chos nges pa gling tshang rgyal po'i sar sgrub sde brgyad kyi bdud rtsi sman sgrub mdzad rgyu dang ske/ dre'u rting dkar du yang zhal 'dzom ste rten 'brel legs phyogs su bsgrigs na gangs ljongs kyi chos srid la phan pa'i lung byang yod pa ltar gsung bskul gnang yod pas gling tshang du phebs/der gter chen rin po che dang / rdzong sar mkhyen sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros sogs dam pa du ma zhig gdan 'dzoms / nyang gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus chen gyi bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa zhag bcu gcig tsam du mdzad/ skabs der sngar gyi gzim lam gyi rten 'brel la brten nas bdud 'dul 120

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/dang klong gsal gyi gter chos shig zhu rgyu byung na bar skabs su sgro skur sel ba la phan par dgongs te/ klong gsal gyi zab gter gtso bo bla ma zhi drag gang rung dang / bdud 'dul gyi rdo rje phur ba gsan bzhed nas zhus par/ gu ru drag po'i dbang zhig gnang zhing —/ phur ba'i dbang chog dang dkyil 'khor ras bris ma 'dzoms pas gsan rgyu bshol/ rten 'brel de gas phyis kyi kha gtong la de tsam phan pa ma byung / der mtshan mo'i ring gter chen bla ma rin po ches rang nyid kyi ru dam pad+ma thang gi pha waṃ dung gi glang po nyal stabs su gnas pa lta bu'i gter gnas nas chos bdag mkhan chen 'dul ba 'dzin pa pad+ma rdo rje dang lhan cig gsang thabs kyis gdan drangs pa'i rig 'dzin rtsa sgrub kyi dbang dang —/ de'i phyi'i gsang ba'i khrid cha lag dang bcas pa'i gdams zab yongs su rdzogs pa rgyas par gnang ba gsan/ mkhyen sprul rin po che yang tshur sku drung du bcar te dad gus dag snang mdzad cing phan tshun thugs dam ngo bo ro gcig tu gyur/ sgrub pa mdzad ring rdzong 'go'i slob dpon bla ma dam pa rab rgyas kyi sar bzhugs nas mdo sngags kyi bka' 'dri mang bo zhu ba la lan zhib gsal dgyes par gnang zhing khong gis zhus ngor sgrub sde brgyad la bstod 121
