sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa dpal chen dgyes pa'i rngam glu zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos skad tshig don shin tu bzang ba zhig mdzad pas khong yang shin tu dad cing ngo mtshar skyes/ gling tshang rgyal bo yab sras rnams dang / gter ston dri med yab sras/ rdzong 'go'i grwa tshang bcas la chos 'brel du klong snying sngon 'gro thun gcig la rgyas par gnang zhing / khyad par tshig bdun spyan 'dren la tshul bzhi'i bshad pa ngo mtshar ba gnang / dre'u rting dkar gyi rten 'brel gsal bsgrig ni rkyen dbang 'ga' res cher ma byung / mkhyen brtse rin po che'i drung nas sa lug gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang lung bcas gsan zhing / 'gu zi dgon du phebs te mkhyen sprul tshang la gsang 'dus sogs dbang 'ga' phul/ de skabs sde dge lcang ra pho brang du gzhung sa chen ngo/'i sku tshab sde spyi khyung ram mda' dpon yod sar sngar nas yig 'grul yod pa ltar jo sku gsar bzhengs kyi ched ra skor bla ma tshogs rnam dpon g.yog phyag yig rten bcas brdzangs te tshur phebs/ ting mdar spyi srung steng du dge rtse tshang yang phebs 'dug pas 'gro don chen por dmigs bde chen zhing khrid zhus par nyin kha shas la rgyas par gnang —/ de skabs rje nyid dbur bzhugs te ser skya pho mo 'tshogs 122

rje 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi rnam thar/che ba'i dbus nas dge rtse bla ma rin po che phyag 'khar la bsten nas yar bzhengs te/ 'o da lam 'dir 'tshogs pa kun gyi yid la nges rgyur khyed tshos nga dge rtse ban rgan la bla ma'i 'du shes kyis gsol ba 'debs khul sogs mos gus byed de/ nga rang bla rgan zhig gi gzugs brnyan du yod pa de a bu tshang gi bka' drin yin/ngas a bu tshang a bu tshang zer 'dug pa de skyabs rje rin po che 'di ba tshang lha rin po che dpang ma red na/ da phyin chad khyed tshos de shes par gyis la sprul sku rin po che khong la mos gus dang bkur bste ci nus gang lcogs kyis/ zhes sogs 'tshogs bshad mang po zhig mdzad nas dpal sprul tshang du thag bcad song bas thams cad la dad gus cher skyes so/ /de nas skyabs mchog brag dkar rin po che phebs nas bka' 'gyur gyi dbang gnang ba'i sgar chen lcags phreng du brgyab yod sar phebs/ yab sras mjal phrad mdzad / bka' 'gyur ro cog lung nyin bcu gsum du gnang ba gsan / gzhan yang skyabs rje rang gi ljags rtsom rnams sogs bka' chos gang yod gsan nas snyan dgon du gdan drangs/nyin kha shas bzhugs dgon sde gsar bskrun theb min zhus par ri ngos 'di dge 'dun gyis gang ba zhig rmi lam du byung bas theb 123

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/par 'dug ces lung bstan/ dbyar der dpon po nas mgo log rong nas shing blang du bcug dka' bcu blo bzang rab rgyas kyis rdza rgyud nas rgya shing bzo gnyis khrid de 'ong nas gzim spyil chung ngu zhig bzhengs/ ston pha ri nas 'bul sdud kyi 'phros rnams mdzad / de nas dka' bcu blo rab kyis rdza dgon du phebs dgos tshul zhus pa ltar dgon gsar du phebs/ /
bas 'a sal snyisdu bzhung

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/spro/ /skyabs 'gro'i sdom tshig blo gsal snying nor/༄༅/ /bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i bstan la 'jug pa'i sgo/ /skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag sdom du bsdu / /blo gsal tshogs kyis 'di zungs la/ /nang ba'i gral du tshud par gyis/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtogs pa'i 'jigs skrag dang ske/ /de las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog la/ /mthong ba'i yid ches dad pa rigs lam nas/ /drangs pa'i tshad ma'i nges pa rnyed pa yis/ /gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ /dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum ste/ /de ni skyabs su 'os pa'i tshul/ /gtan tshigs rnam pa bzhi yis 'grub/ /rang nyid 'jigs pa kun las grol / /gzhan yang sgrol ba'i thabs la mkhas/ /kun la thugs rje nye ring med/ /phan btags ma btags don mdzad phyir/ /de la skyabs su song ba'i tshad/ /yon tan shes dang khyad par shes/ /khas blangs gzhan du mi smra ba'i/ /dad shes gtso 'khor skyes pa'o/ /dang po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las bzhi / /chos ni sangs rgyas de'i rgyu dang / /dge 'dun chos kyi spyod yul can/ /gnyis par khyad par drug yod de/ /mtshan nyid 'phrin 126

skyabs 'gro'i sdom tshigalas mos pa dang / /bsgrub dang rjes su dran pa dang / /bsod nams mchog ni 'phel ba'o/ /sangs rgyas mngon byang chub pa dang —/ /chos ni de yi 'bras bu dang / /dge 'dun gzhan gyi man ngag gis/ /yang dag bsgrub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /sangs rgyas kyis lung 'bog pa dang / /chos kyis sdug kun spong ba dang / /dge 'dun bcas ni spro bar byed/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen bkur la gus dang —/ /dam chos mngon du bya la gus/ /dge 'dun chos mthun dngos po yis/ /'grogs la gus pas mos par bya/ /sangs rgyas mchod dang rim gro dang / /dam chos rnal 'byor sbyor sgom dang / /dge 'dun chos dang zang zing la/ /lhan cig spyod pas bsgrub par bya / /dkon mchog rjes dran khyad par ni/ /de yi mdo sde las 'byung bzhin/ /so so'i yon tan so so ru/ /legs par dran par byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas gang zag gcig nyid dang / /tshogs mchog dge 'dun du ma yi/ /dbang byas bsod nams mchog 'phel te/ /chos ni chos rikyi dbang byas so/ /gsum pa ji ltar khas blangs tshul/ /sangs rgyas skyabs ston chos skyabs dngos/ /dge 'dun skyabs bsgrub zla grogs su/ /tshad ma'i nges pa rnyed pa yin/ /bzhi ba gzhan du mi smra ba/ /gong bzhin tshad mas nges pa yis/ /skyabs 127

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gzhan med par rtogs pa ste/ /'di gnyis dgag sgrub so sos bzhag /skyabs su song nas bslab bya la/ /bsdu ba las gsungs bzhi tshan gnyis/ /man ngag las gsungs dgag sgrub gnyis/ /thun mong gi ni bslab bya'o/ /de la bzhi tshan dang po ni/ /skyes bu dam pa bsten pa dang / /dam chos nyan zhing yid la byed/ /chos kyi rjes mthun chos bsgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbang po mi rgod cing / /bslab pa'i gzhi rnams yang dag len/ /sems can la ni snying brtse ba/ /dus kun dkon mchog mchod la brtson/ /dgag sgrub gnyis las dang po ni/ /'jig rten lha 'drer skyabs mi 'dzin/ /sems can la ni gnod 'tshe spang / /mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa sku gzugs bris 'bur glegs bam dang / /dge sbyong rtags tsam 'dzin pa yan chad la/ /ma gus gshe dang phyogs ris yongs spangs te/ /dkon mchog dngos su bltas nas legs par mchod / /thun mong bslab byar rnam pa drug yod de/ /yon tan dran pas yang yang skyabs 'gro zhing / /bka' drin dran pas mchod pa rnam bcus mchod/ /snying rje dran pas gzhan dag skyabs 'gror 'god / /phan yon dran pas dus drug skyabs 'gro bya/ /bya ba gang byed dgos pa ci yod la/ /'jig rten thabs spang dkon mchog 128

skyabs 'gro'i sdom tshigamachod de bya/ /srog dang bzhad gad phyir yang skyabs mi btang / /de ltar skyabs song phan yon ni/ /nang ba'i gral du tshud pa dang / /sdom pa kun gyi rten du gyur/ /las kyi sgrib pa bslab cing 'dzad/ /bsod nams rgya chen gsog pa dang / /ngan 'gro'i gnas su mi ltung zhing / /mi dang mi min gyis mi tshugs/ /bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob pa'o/ /gtong rgyu srog phyir mi gtong dang 'gal dang / /'jig rten lha 'dre sogs bsten gnyis 'dzin byed/ /skyabs la blo gtad ma khel dag yin zhing / /gzhan dag bslab bya dang 'gal nyes par gsungs/ /'di tsam shes dang lag len du/ /'debs pa'i nyams bzhes mi 'dug par//chos gos tshos snum gang legs kyis/ /ston pa'i rjes 'jug ji ltar 'ong ne/ /de ltar tshig nyung rgyas 'dril du/ /bsdus pa'i dge bas rang gzhan kun/ /bstan pa'i 'jug sgo 'dir zhugs nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs thob par shog /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag cag la/ /lam bzang ston pa'i ston pa mchog /shākya seng ge khyed kyi zhabs/ /tshe rabs kun tu spyi bor 'dzin/ /dge'o/ /ces pa 'di yang rang gzhan la phan du re bas dharma sa ra zhes bya bas rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi chos grwar bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel/129

༄khya/ /thar lam nyams su len lugs rags rim ston pa shākya thub pa'i ring lugs bzhin cung zad bshad pa bden gtam bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'di ni rang la legs bshad kyi skyabs re ba rnams la bsam pa drang bos bshad pa yin gyi/ gzhan dgag pa'i ched du bris pa min pas sus kyang thugs kyis dogs zon mi dgos so//

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄/ /thar lam nyams su len lugs rags tsam brjod pa/༄7/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi thugs rje'i 'phrul/ /gcig bsdus blang dor snang ba sbyin pa'i skyabs/ /bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag byas nas / /rang dang skal mnyam dag la sman pa'i ched/ /rang gi shes tshod drang bor gleng ba yi/ /bden gtam bdud rtsi'i thigs pa nyung zad cig /spro yi rigs dang mi rigs legs par rtogs/ /'khor bar 'ching byed ma rig mdud pa brgyas/ /dam por bsdams pa'i kun rmongs sems kyi rtas/ /'jigs rung rigs drug g.yang sar 'phangs pa la/ /'dren pa'i skyabs mchog bslab gsum yon tan yin / /des kyang gtso bo shes rab bslab pa 'di/ /log rtog 'khrul ba gcod pa'i ral gri ste/ /ma rig mdud pa bshig pa'i thur ma dang / /nyon mongs bud shing bsreg pa'i me lce'ang yin/ /de 'dra'i shes rab bslab pa rin po che/ /bden bzhi bden gnyis la sogs ma nor bar/ /yang dag rigs pa'i stobs kyis shes pa ste / /ma bslab nyal bas de dag ga la shes/ /mi shes pa yis sngar yang skyon bskyed de/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir skye shi grangs med 132

thar lam nyams su len lugs/brgyud / /da dung shes rab snang ba ma bskyed na/ /tsom 'jog tsam res bdag 'dzin ji ltar gcod/ /bdag 'dzin rdul rlog shes rab ral gri la/ /rigs pa'i rno so 'byin pa'i man ngag ni/ /gzhung lugs kun bsdus bsdus grwa'i rigs pa ste/ /'di don rtogs na shes rab me bzhin 'bar/ /shes rab 'dod de 'jam dbyangs sogs bsgrubs kyang / /tshig bzhi re yi don kyang shes pa dka' / /shes rab 'dod de bsdus grwar zla gcig la/ /bltas pas shes rab 'phel ba mngon sum ste/ /sngar mi shes pa'i shes bya'i yin lugs brgya/ /gsar du shes pa'i shes rab 'byung ba ni/ /dngos su mig gis mthong sar yod pas na/ /'di las phan yon myur ba'i chos gzhan med/ /de lta yin mod da ni dus snyigs phyir/ /las ngan skye bo khyi dang phag 'dra la/ /rigs lam gtsang ma bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di/ /'thung ba'i skal ba med pas skur 'debs byed / /lhag par da lta bstan pa'i bla btsong 'ga'/ /pad+ma'i ring lugs gsang sngags rnying ma la/ /shes rab 'phel byed bsdus grwa'i rigs pa 'di/ /sngar med da dung dgos pa med ces gleng / /pad+ma'i man ngag zab dgu'i yang snying 'di/ /a ti yin gsungs a ti'i lam srog kyang / /theg dgu'i gnad rdzogs rang byung rig pa 133

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/zhes / /rna ba yod na mkhas pa stong gis gleng / /ci yang mi shes blun po'i sems 'di nyid/ /chos kun mkhyen pa'i rig pa yin srid na / /'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa'o zhes / /dus gsum rgyal bas smad de gang zhig yin/ /rig pa gcig la theg dgu'i gnad rdzogs pa'i / /rdzogs pa che zhes grub thob brgya yi lugs/ /gang yang ma rdzogs ci yang mi shes pa'i/ /blun po'i sems la ngo sprod byed 'di mtshar / /mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul ba'i lo paṇa gyi/ /rang lugs gsang chen rnying ma'i chos kyi bcud/ /theg dgu'i 'od stong rdzogs pa'i nyi ma yang / /rab yangs shes rab mkha' la 'char srid kyi/ /gang yang ma bslab shes rab rtsal med pa'i/ /blun po'i sems kyi khab kyi bu ga ru/ /theg rtse a ti'i nyi ma 'od gor gor/ /'char na theg rim dgu 'di ci la dgos/ /sbyangs pa sngon du song ba'i skal ldan 'ga'/ /tshe 'dir ma bslab par yang grol srid kyi/ /rtsal chen rgya stag mchongs pa'i shul de ru/ /wa mo'i rtsib ma brtsegs te shi rabs yod/ /mi shes pa las skyon chen gzhan med de/ /mi shes pa 'dis chos la chos min dang / /chos min pa la chos su 'khrul gyur te/ /rang gi mdo shor gzhan mgo log par bskor/ /des na rnying ma blun kyang chog snyam pa'i/ /pha bla 'tshong rnams rang sar 134

thar lam nyams su len lugs/bzhugs su chugs/ /thar ba 'dod tshe rang re'i shes rab kyi/ /mig 'di med par thar lam ji ltar bsgrod/ /lo dang zla bar bsgom pas ngal na yang / /nyams rtogs yar skyed med pa phal cher zhig /thar lam ma nor 'byed pa'i shes rab dang / /bral nas gsal rig tsam rer zhen pas nongs/ /shes rab can la bsgom pa mi dka' ste/ /lo zla mi dgos zhag rer bsams pas kyang ske/ /nyon mongs gdon la gnod tshabs cher gyur nas/ /spangs rtogs yon tan dbyar gyi chu bzhin rdol/ /chos dang rang rgyud bsres kyang mi 'dres pa'i/ /skal ngan 'ga' res shes rgyud phyir bltas kyis/ /thos bsam nyon mongs snon par 'gro srid kyang / /gang zag skyon yin chos skyon ga la yin/ /gal te yin na tshe gang bsgoms pas kyang / /chags sdang mgo gnon tsam yang ma 'ongs pa / /srid pa de yang bsgom skyon 'gyur bas na/ /skyon med chos shig med par mi 'gro'am/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse dam chos rdzogs pa che / /chos kyi gnad 'dus chos kyi nying khu ste/ /'di las lhag pa'i nyams len mthar thug cig /dus gsum rgyal bas gzigs kyang med par nges/ /'on kyang theg rtse'i nyams rtogs 'od po ches/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa sel ba'i rang gzugs de/ /theg brgyad spyi dang 135

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pha rol phyin pa yi/ /sa lam me shel rdul gyi khams las grub/ /de ltar min na ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /theg chen 'khor la rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i yum/ /ston pa'i 'o brgyal mdzad kyang mi dgos te / /shin tu sla ba'i sems ngo cis mi spyod/ /legs par go na pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung / /stong phrag brgya ba sogs kyi yum don de/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi gzhi ma lags/ /deng sang 'bum dang nyi khri brgya stong sogs / /nyams len chos shig yin snyam gtan med par/ /khyim rgan 'ga' res mchod bshams yul tsam du/ /mthong 'di bstan pa med pa'i rang rtags yin/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam gyi mig 'byed pa'i/ /gzhung bzang dbu tshad zung du 'brel ba yin/ /phar phyin lam gyi gzhi de mngon pa dang / /spyod pa 'dul bas ston zhes mkhas rnams mthun/ /de 'dra'i phar phyin lam la theg gsum gyi/ /rtogs rigs rdzogs te phyi rgyud sde gsum dang / /nang rgyud ma hā a nu'i 'thus ka rnams/ /tshang ba'i a ti tshe gcig sangs rgyas chos/ /de lta shes na bstan pa thams cad kyang / /'gal med lam gyi cha rkyen gcig nyid du/ /'dril ba'i tshul la blo gros byang gyur te/ /chos spong las ngan zhor la 'gag par 'gyur/ /de lta'i theg dgu'i 136

thar lam nyams su len lugs/nyams rtogs yon tan me/ /cir yang sbar byed bsdus gzhung rigs pa'i rlung / /med du mi rung shes rab grogs mchog ste/ /'di spangs pa la thar ba ga la yod/ /khyad par sbyangs pa dman pa'i las dang po/ /gzhung lugs lta la shes rab mig med rnams/ /gzhung brgya'i don zab mthong ba'i shes rab kyi/ /mig dang sprod byed bsdus grwa'i rigs pa yin/ /bka' pod lnga las rtogs sla sngon 'gro'i rigs/ /gcig bsdus bsdus gzhung nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od/ /legs par shar na theg dgu'i nyams rtogs kyi/ /yon tan me tog skal ldan de la 'dzum/ /kun 'byung 'dren pa phyi yi theg gsum mkha' / /gsal byed bsdus gzhung nyi ma gnyis pa ste/ /dka' thub nang gi theg pa'i ku mu ta/ /'byed la zla ba'i 'od kyang bsdus gzhung 'di/ /gsang ba dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa zhes / /'phags pa'i nor mchog chos kyi rgyal srid bdun/ /bde blag rnyed pa'i bsod nams zong chen yang / /rigs pa'i lam 'di yin pa masmo par mdzod/ /de phyir bsdus gzhung nor bu'i phreng ba 'di/ /gang gis thogs de dad sogs dbang po lnga/ /shin tu rno ba'i rgyal ba'i sras lags pas/ /a ti'i thun min snod du 'ang 'di yis sgrub / /dang po nyid nas dbang rnon mi srid de/ /dbang rnon zhes 137

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bya —skyangs pa'i stobs la rags/ /de yang 'di 'dra'i rigs lam bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /lan mang btung bas shes rab rtsal rgyas nas/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa ting 'dzin sogs/ /shin tu rnon por gyur tshe dbang rnon du/ /'phos pa yin gyi sbyang ba'i rgyu rkyen la//ma ltos dbang po bden grub yod mi srid/ /dbang bo rno rtul tsam gyi ngos 'dzin yang / /mi shes byis pa mgo 'thom yin bzhin du/ /a ti'i lta sgom lag mthil ri mo ltar/ /shes par 'dod pa rang nyid mgo skor yin/ /chos su ma zad 'jig rten lugs la yang /bsdus gzhung mkhyen pa'i blo dang ldan pa na/ /sgra tshad tshe dang bzo yi rig pa 'bum/ /dbyar gyi chu bzhin ngang gis rgyas par 'gyur/ /des na mi yi chos lugs gtsang ma'i srol/ /sa chen skyong ba'i rgyal po'i rgyal thabs sogs/ /lugs kyang gzhung 'di mkhyen la mi dka' ste/ /blo gros rtsal dang ldan na las kun sla/ /mdor na de ltar chos dang 'jig rten gyi/ /phun tshogs gang yin shes rab gcig gis sdud/ /shes rab mchog de rigs pa'i lcags kyu la/ /brten na bde blag nyid du 'dren par nus/ /de phyir shes rab bslab pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /thog mar sgo 'byed bsdus grwa'i rigs pa 'di/ /shin tu don chen yin pa mkhyen mdzod la/ /rigs pa re 138

thar lam nyams su len lugs/re bzhin yang bsgrims la slobs/ /thar lam srog 'di shes rab yin pa'i tshul/ /go na bsdus gzhung don med mi bsam ste/ /shes rab mig dang bral ba'i blun rmongs sems/ /rig par 'khrul tshe bsdus gzhung dgos med 'dor/ /ma rig 'ching ba 'khor rtsa yin gyur na/ /thar lam srog 'di shes rab los kyang yin/ /shes rab ces bya gnas lugs shes pa ste/ /chos kun rtogs pa'i rig pa'ang 'di nyid yin/ /rig pas rig bya chos kyi gnas lugs te/ /ji ltar rig tshul theg dgu'i gzhung lugs las/ /gsungs pa bzhin yin shes bya mi shes na/ /shes pa rab dang rig pa ji ltar yin/ /rig pas spang bya ma rig gdon chen te/ /de yang shes bya'i gnas la 'khrul ba yin/ /'khrul ba de spangs thar ba 'dod pa na/ /shes bya kun gyi gnas lugs rig pa dgos/ /de la 'dzin pa sems kyi gnas lugs de/ /gtso bo yin mod gzung ba yul gyi yang / /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i blo dang mi ldan na/ /shes bya yul la 'khrul ba ji ltar spang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi gnas lugs mthar gtugs pa / /stong nyid lags mod de nyid rtogs pa la/ /gcig dang tha dad 'gal 'brel la sogs pa/ /kun rdzob yin lugs shes pa med mi rung / /'dzam gling 'di na nges don shing rta'i srol/ /'byed 139

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i slob dpon na ga dzu na ste/ /de yis chos dbyings spros pa med pa'i tshul/ /gcig dang du ma'i rtags kyis gtan la phab/ /de sogs bsdus gzhung rigs pa re res kyang / /don dam yin lugs lan grangs du ma ru/ /gtan la phab pa'i dbu ma rtsa shes la/ /brtag na bsdus grwa'i dgos pa rtogs pa sla/ /de ltar yin phyir rang rgyud 'dul ba la/ /'di las lhag pa'i zab chos gzhan med pas / /kha shags 'gyed pa'i thabs shig yin snyam nas/ /chos spong las ngan gsog la dug bzhin 'dzems/ /slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med ces/ /mkhas las ches mkhas dbu ma'i ring lugs pa'i/ /paṇa grub tshogs rnams 'di la zhal mthun gleng / /klu sgrub lugs bzang spros bral lta ba'i gshis/ /bde blag rtogs pa'i rigs pa'i 'phrul thabs 'di/ /thar lam ma nor ston pa'i mdzub mo ste/ /de la skyon du bltas nas gcod rung ngam/ /da ni de ltar bshad na blun po rnams / /klu sgrub la sogs gsar ma'i bla ma re/ /yin snyam rtsis med 'dor ba mang mod de/ /rnying ma'i rig 'dzin brgyad de gang du song / /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis po/ /gsar ma'i yin na gsar ma ches bzang zhing / /rnying mar mkhas 140

thar lam nyams su len lugs/pa'i skal ba chad pas na/ /kye ma de 'dra'i rnying ma'i phyogs 'dzin rnams / /pha rol phyin dang dbu tshad mngon 'dul gyi/ /gzhung lugs 'di dag rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis/ /gsungs pa lags pas thar ba 'dod phyin chad/ /'di la thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams len mdzod/ /bka' pod lnga yi gzhung lugs mdzod chen yang / /'di gar 'byed pa'i rigs pa'i lde mig ni/ /bsdus gzhung 'di na snang phyir chos 'dod phyin/ /blo gsar tshogs rnams bsdus grwar 'jug par rigs/ /de ltar smras na blun po phal cher la/ /dka' 'am snyam pa'i dogs pa 'byung ba ni/ /thog med nas goms le lo'i bag chags stobs/ /rkyen gyis bslangs nas mngon du gyur pa yin / /tshe 'dir lto gos tsam gyi cha rkyen yang / /nyin mtshan ltos pa med par bsgrub dgos na/ /tshe rabs gtan gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas sa/ /dka' bas 'bad de bsgrub pa los re dgos/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs/ /ston pa yang dag de yis slob lam du/ /bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi ye shes tshogs/ /thos bsam sgom pas legs par bsags la ltos/ /blun po la la de 'dra dbang rtul gyis/ /sangs rgyas sgrub lugs yin gyi dbang rnon min/ /dbang po rnon grangs med gsum gyi tshogs/ /ma 141

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bsags pa yang sangs rgyas yod ces zer/ /rang re snyigs dus gdul dka'i sems can la/ /lhag par brtse ba'i thugs rje stobs che bas/ /rgyal ba kun gyis pad dkar ltar bsngags pa'i/ /byang sems de 'dra dbang po ga la rtul/ /gal te rtul na rang re le lo canate/ /pod chung 'ga' la'ang sbyangs par mi nus shing / /nyin mtshan zas gos kho na lhur len par/ /dbang rnon yin zhes smra yang ji ltar phod/ /grangs med gsum gyi tshogs la ma ltos par/ /myur lam sngags kyi theg pa yod do skad/ /rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs sogs kyis/ /ma rtogs gsang lam de 'dra khe nyen che/ /tshangs dang brgya byin sogs kyis mi rnyed pa'i/ /lha yi bdud rtsi khyad 'phags bum pa gang / /khyod la sbyin gyi thungs shig zer ba na/ /sman nam dug ces khe nyen rtog dgos bzhin/ /de phyir ston pas gdul bya'i khams dbang bzhin/ /gnas skabs so sor gsung yang rdzogs byang ched/ /'gal med mdo dang sngags kyi lam gnyis kur/ /bslabs te dal 'byor thob pa don ldan mdzod//rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis kur ma bsten na/ /rdzogs byang rin chen gling du bgrod mi nus/ /theg pa re res byang chub 'thob bo zhes/ /smras pa bdud kyi tshig yin spang bar mdzod/ /la la bsgoms na 142

thar lam nyams su len lugs/thos pa mi dgos zer/ /la las thos pa rkyang bas grol lo zhes/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir smra ba ches mang ste/ /thams cad bdud kyi tshig yin spang bar mdzod/ /sa rnying kur 'brug dge ldan jo nang sogs / /kun gyi mkhas grub snga ma thams cad kyis/ /thos bsam sgom pa zung 'brel lam mchog las/ /byang chub rnyed pa'i rnam thar dran par mdzod/ /lung gi yon tan med par grol srid na/ /sde snod gsum gyi gsung 'dis ci zhig byed/ /thar lam blang dor ma nor ston pa yi/ /bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung la blta rtog mdzod / /bslab pa gsum gyi nyams rtogs mi dgos na/ /sgrib gnyis 'ching ba gnyen po gang gis gcod/ /gsal rig tsam re skyong ba'i u tshugs kyis/ /chos sku'i rang zhal mthong snyam spang bar mdzod / /tshad ma'i rigs pas rno ngar byung ba yi/ /'khrul med dbu ma'i lta ba'i ral gri che/ /phar mngon sgom gyis brtan por bzung ba dang / /'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang rnams zung 'brel mdzod / /de ltar nyams su len pa'i skal ldan gyis/ /tshe 'dir chos sku'i rang zhal mthong 'dod na/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang khyad par bla med pa/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i slob dpon bsten par mdzod/ /bsten nas dbang nod dam tshig srog ltar du/ /bsrungs te rim 143

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gnyis ting 'dzin brtan pa'i tshe/ /spros bcas spros med la sogs a ti yi/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bo don gnyer mdzod/ /de nas snang bzhi'i lam gyi them skas la/ /cog bzhag bzhi yi rtogs pas rim bgrod de/ /rang byung rig pa'i ye shes rdzogs pa che/ /rjen par phyung ba'i nye lam gnad smin mdzod/ /de tshe khyab gdal rig pa'i rang snang zer/ /thabs kyis gcun pa'i sku gsum dkyil 'khor che/ /phyogs ris med pa'i klong chen rig pa'i mdangs/ /lhun gyis grub 'ong 'bad rtsol ga la dgos/ /de 'dra de la sku dang ye shes gnyis/ /'du 'bral med pa rdzogs chen rang lam zhes/ /mkhas grub stong gis lan brgyar bstod bsngags kyi/ /snyan tshig me tog srid zhi'i khams su 'thor/ /kye kye grogs dag pad+ma'i bu rgyud du / /skyes pas chos kyi pha phogs len snyam na/ /theg dgu'i nyams len de ltar byed dgos pas/ /lung rtogs bstan pa kun la sbyang bar gyis/ /de ltar lhag bsam drang pos bshad pa'i dges/ /rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la blo phyogs te/ /rgyal ba'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa kun/ /'gal med nyams su len pa'i rgyur gyur cig/khyad par pad+ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams/ /rim dgu'i theg pa'i chos kyi so nam la/ /brten te ka dag rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs 144

nas / /sku gsum lhun grub lo tog smin gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rang la lung rtogs kyi yon tan gdeng khel ba ci yang med kyang /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin las gsar rnying gi chos rgyus cung zad shes shing lhag bsam drang ba blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya bas rnam rgyal dge ldan nas spel ba dge legs 'phel/ /dge'o/ /
skras

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dze /rang rgyud skul 'debs/༄sha /lha dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bdag ni sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i gnas 'di na/ /yang gcig pur grogs med 'khyams pa deng gi dus/ /chos zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi blud pa'i ma/ /rje btsun gyi mgon po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo/ /khong da lta mjal snying 'dod de sems gdungs kyang ske/ /las bsod nams zhing du deng sang ma bzhugs pas/ /yid dad pa'i ze'u 'brur mgon khyod yongs bkod de/ /pha khyed la rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /rje chos kyi rgyal bo sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /thugs byams brtse'i 'dzum mdangs lhag ger dgongs mdzod la/ /mi kho bo'i spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs su gsol / /chos zab mo gzhung brgya 'dus pa'i gdams pa'i gter//nad nyon mongs khong skran 'joms pa'i dpa' bo'i mchog /gsung skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yi/ /tshig grag stong glu dbyangs rna bar 'bral med mdzod/ /don dang por chos la bskul ba'i mi rtag chos / /chos bar du thar ba 'dod pa'i nges 'byung blo/ /blo tha ma gzhan don sems pa'i theg chen sems/ /sprang bdag gi sems la 148

rang rgyud skul 'debs/lhan ne 'khrungs par shog /yang legs par soms dang rje btsun de yi sras/ /don gdams pa zab mos gces par bskyangs pa'i bu / /chos gzhan la 'chad pa'i slob dpon skad pa khyod/ /khyod rang gi shes rgyud deng sang ji ltar gda'/ /lar rang gi skyid sdug 'byung 'gyur ci yin snyam/ /blos legs par dpyad pa'i shes ngo de ka na/ /sems bde mor sdod pa'i gdeng tshod ci 'dug ces / /dus deng sang bsam mno gtong ba'i dus su gda'/ /rten dal 'byor rin chen rnyed par dka'o zhes/ /chos mdo rgyud rnams las lan gcig min par gsungs/ /da 'on te kho bos blo yis dpyad na yang / /rgyu dge ba'i las la ci tsam brtson dka' ba/ /de tsam du 'bras bu bde 'gro'i 'gro ba yang / /rnyed dka' ba rigs pas dpag na shes par sla/ /dus dbyar gyi lung ba re re'i nang shed na//khong 'bu srin phra mo zir zir rgyu ba yi/ /grangs 'di 'dra 'dzam gling mi yi grangs la yang / /rnyed dka' na dal 'byor rin chen ji ltar rnyed/ /don de ltar bsams na stong gsum khyon gang ba'i/ /rgya mtsho ru gser gyi gnya' shing bu ga ru/ /rus sbal gyi mgrin pa 'phrad par srid dka' yi/ /dpe de la bdag sems 'phrigs su tshud par gyur/ /khyod ma 'khrul rnyan sa ra :zhes bya'i ming / /don 149

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/soms dang chos kyi rgya mtshor grags pa khyod/ /rten rnyed dka' rnyed 'di rnyed nas da lta'i bar/ /phal cher zhig chud zos song kyang mi 'gyod dam/ /tshe lhag ma lo shas bsdad pa yod srid kyang / /yang 'di bzhin chud zos byed rgyu yin nam ci/ /khyod tshe 'di'i snang shas gdon gyis thebs pa dang / /yang rtag 'dzin nad kyis mnar lugs shes sam ci/ /don zhib tu soms dang chos rje bla ma'i sras/ /chos sems la med na chos kyis ci zhig phan/ /lar rdzogs sangs rgyas de'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ /srid gsum gyi dngos kun mi rtag 'gyur ba'i dpe/ /ston dus kyi sprin gyis 'du 'god lta bur gsungs / /don de la khyod blo 'dris pa med 'dis nongs/ /dus da lo de ring bde mor yod do skad/ /ngo mtshar dang skyid du gting nas rlom bzhin du/ /da ci 'gyur mo dang mngon shes mkhan po la/ /blo 'dri bzhin da dung mi rtag mi dgongs sam/ /'di gdon gyis thebs pa min na ji ltar yin/ /khong 'dus byas rtag par bsdad pa med pa ste/ /don mngon sum lags kyang mi rtag lkog gyur pas/ /chos zab mo yin no snying gi mthil du gyis/ /yang dang por ma bu gcig la gcig 'dun pa/ /'bral bzod blag med par yun ring 'grogs 'dod kyang / /dus re zhig tsam na ma bu so so ru/ /shing 150

rang rgyud skul 'debs/lo ma brul ba slar mi 'byar bzhin 'gro/ /don 'di la bsams na mi rtag mi dran nam/ /yang re zhig gces phrug gzhon nu pho mo zung / /snying mdza' gcugs dam pos lhan cig bsdebs na yang / /khong mi 'dod bzhin du tshong 'dus mgron po ltar/ /yang bye bral byas pas mya ngan khur bos non/ /don 'di 'dra bsams na mi rtag mi dran nam/ /dus snga lo sang gnang lo dang zla ba'i tshes/ /zas zhim po'i ro dang 'jam po'i gos bsags bsags/ /kho byi bas bsags kyang za ba'i dbang med ltar/ /lo phyi mar bskyur nas shi ba mthong ba na/ /don de la bsams na mi rtag mi dran nam/ /yang spang ljongs ma rgad zhun ma brdal 'dra na/ /sbra mig sman mdog can mthong na mdzes pa'i ngogs/ /phyugs dkar nag khyu tshogs mang pos brgyan pa yi/ /gzhi 'byor ldan de 'dra rnams kyang re zhig na/ /khong rgan gzhon nges med shi nas stong gyur te/ /phyugs rkang bzhi'i tshogs kyang phyogs bzhir khyer nas 'gro/ /sbra re hrul sa la rul ba mthong na sme/ /don 'di 'dra bsams na mi rtag mi dran nam/ /yang nags tshal brag ri 'thab pa'i ri zhol na/ /gnas khang ba brtsegs pa lha yi khang bzang 'dra/ /rdzas yo byad 'byor ba klu yi bang mdzod bzhin/ /zhing 'bru rigs smin pa'i sa 151

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/chen thob pa yang / /dus lo shas song tshe bca' ga yo byad zad/ /'bru lo tog zhing sa dum bur bgos nas stong / /mthar khang rul gyang log yol ba bris 'dra na/ /khyod mi rtag mi dran khong na snying med dam/ /khong sde dgon 'dzin pa'i bla chen rgyal bo'i tshogs/ /sku dregs pa che bas 'khor tshogs mang na yang / /lar gcig kyang mi 'khrid gcig pur phebs lags na/ /khyod gnyen bshes ma bsams 'jig rten phyi ma soms/ /yang nor mang ldan pa'i 'byor ldan phyug po'i tshogs/ /nor rin thang can la 'bral ba'i glags med bzhin/ /nor bzang dgu shul du bzhag nas shi lags na/ /khyod nor rdzas ma bsams 'jig rten phyi ma soms/ /tshe 'di la nor dang khengs dregs ci tsam du/ /'byor na yang 'chi tshe lag pa stong ba ru/ /sdig ri bo tsam pa khur nas 'gro dgos na/ /khyod tshe 'di ma bsams 'jig rten phyi ma soms/ /dgra 'chi bdag thog tu glo bur babs pa'i tshe/ /khong phyi ma'i lam la lam chen gnyis snang ste / /chos dge ba'i them skas yod na mtho ris 'gro/ /de yod dam med ces rang sems dpang du tshugs/ /da 'di snang bde sdug bsam nas dus yol nas/ /tshe phyi ma bsam pa yid yul mi dran na//kho bsam bsam tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ste thal/ /don ma bsams 152

rang rgyud skul 'debs/phyi ma'i snang tshul mngon gyur tshe/ /gnas mtho ris 'gro ba'i lam zhig mi 'dug pas/ /da ngan song lhung ba las gzhan 'os med na/ /dus de tshe su yis skyob ces de ring soms/ /phyogs gang du bltas kyang lcags bsregs las grub pa'i/ /sa ri thang thams cad me mdag dmar lam lam/ /lus btso sreg sdug bsngal mang bo myong dgos na/ /gnas dmyal ba'i sgo 'phar deng sang mi gcod dam/ /yang mun nag 'khrigs pa gangs ri'i sbubs shig na/ /lus lhags skyob gos med gcer bur 'khum pa na/ /phyogs bzhi nas ldang ba'i bu yug gis btab pa'i/ /sdug bzod dam mi bzod deng sang 'dam ga yod/ /yang yan lag phra la lto ba ri tsam pa'i/ /gzugs mi sdug lus po bkres skom gyis mnar nas/ /lo brgya phrag mang por sdod pa'i yi dwags kyang / /sang rang thog 'bab snyam phyi ma'i don la soms/ /khong lhun po'i zhol na mtsho gling mun nag khrod/ /gcig gcig la za ba'i dud 'gro byings dang ni/ /gnas 'di na bkol spyod drag pos mnar ba yi/ /dman dud 'gro mthong nas phyi ma'i don la soms/ /sdug de 'dra skyob pa'i bslu med skyabs kyi gtso / /lha dkon mchog gsum du grags pa bzhugs lags pas/ /khyod snyom las ma byed de ring skyabs su song / /lan gcig tsam 153

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/min par yang yang skyabs su song / /mgon sangs rgyas bya ba don gnyis mthar phyin yin/ /des bstan pa'i chos mchog de ru phyin byed yin/ /de tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dge 'dun phyin mkhan yin/ /de rnam gsum ston pa lam dang grogs su zungs/ /skyabs rin chen gsum des nam yang mi bslu ba/ /chos zab mo bdag med rigs pas grub pa dang / /byams snying rje'i lam gyi 'gros la brtags pas shes/ /don de phyir skyabs gsum tshad mas yang yang sgrubs/ /blo khyod shes dad pa'i zhing sa ma brtan na/ /tshig gdangs snyan dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs gyer na yang / /skyob nges pa'i mthu byin 'byung ba dka' bas na/ /sems tsab tsub ma mang dkon mchog yon tan soms/ /khong bslu med tshad ma'i skyabs gnas bzang na yang / /gsung las 'bras zab mo'i bslab byar ma 'bad na / /sdig las ngan rnam smin phyag gis mi sel bas/ /khyod u tshugs ma che las 'bras zhib tu soms/ /rgyu dge ba spyad pa'i 'bras bu mtho ris te/ /sdig mi dge'i las kyi rnam smin ngan 'gror gsungs/ /las dkar nag las re la'ang rgyu mthun dang / /yul dbang 'bras zhes bya'i khyad par mang du gsungs/ /gsung de yi bstan don bslu med yin pa'i tshul/ /gsung de 'dra dpyad 154

rang rgyud skul 'debs/gsum dag pas shes so zhes/ /khong rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis gsungs pa la/ /khyod rmongs pa ma che shes rab sgron me sbor/ /don las 'bras 'di las zab pa med do zhes/ /khong dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis yang yang gsungs/ /chos 'di las brtsams te nyams su ma blangs na/ /khyod rdog sner mun pas khebs 'dra 'ong bas soms/ /steng lha yi rin chen khang bzang re re na/ /ches mdzes shing bkra ba'i lha phrug gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /nyams rtse dgas g.yeng ba'i bde skyid de 'dra yang / /chos dge ba'i pir gyis bris pa'i ri mor 'dug /gnas ngan song gsum na 'gro ba re rer yang / /sdug mi bzod sna dgu'i khur bo 'gel mkhan de/ /rgyu mi dge'i las ngan ma gtogs gzhan med pas/ /da spang blang ma nor dge sdig rtsis la thobs/ /chos de 'dra mngon par mtho ba'i chos lags te/ /de tsam gyis mi chog da dung yod lags pas/ /khyod snyom las ma byed rig pa hur byung la/ /don mya ngan 'das pa'i lam la legs par soms/ /gnas 'dzam gling tha gru yangs pa'i byang phyogs na/ /bod bsil ldan chu bo du ma 'bab sa na/ /lha spyan ras gzigs kyis skyong ba'i yul 'di na/ /rten mtho ris mi lus thob pa da lan kyang / /las zag pas bskyed pa'i 'dus byas 155

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'gyur bag rgod/ /kho 'phen byed dge yang rdzogs byed sna tshogs pas / /nyams skyid sdug ma nges skyid kyang brtag mi thub/ /khyod rang gar ma sdod gtan gyi 'dun ma soms/ /yang nyer len phung bo nye bar len tsa na/ /dus dang por ma rig zhing pas las kyi zhing —/ /rten rnam shes myu gu 'phangs pa sred len chus/ /gsos btab ste srid pa mngon par 'grub nus las/ /mngal mi gtsang khu khrag 'dres pa'i rgyar thim ste/ /gnas shin tu dog pa dri nga rul ba der / /lus skye mched rdzogs pa rlung gis phyir 'phud de/ /phyir btsa' ba'i sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba yod/ /yang btsas nas sngar byas las kyi gzhan dbang las/ /kho mi 'dod na tsha zug rngu du mas gzir/ /lus rga ba'i nad kyis nyi ma re bzhin 'joms/ /mi tshe thung 'di la bde skyid cang ma mthong / /rdzas 'byor na bsrung ba'i sdug gis srog kyang 'dor/ /yang dbul na 'tshol ba'i sdug gis sha khrag skem/ /da ji ltar byas kyang mi 'dod sdug gi gzhi/ /sems zag pas bskyed pa'i phung po spang re ran/ /dus tha ma lus sems bral te 'chi ba na/ /tshe yid tsam pa la rgyu nor gnyen bshes zhes / /sems sred pas 'ching thag las kyis gcod pa'i tshe/ /kho sha khrag lus kyang mi dbang sdug re che/ /sems dri za bar ma do ru 156

rang rgyud skul 'debs/'khyams pa na/ /rgyu mi dge'i las kyis bskyed pa'i 'jigs skrag che / /khong phal cher 'gro sa ngan song gsum lags pas/ /sdug ci 'dug gsung rab zab mo mdo sder dris/ /don de 'dra'i rten 'brel 'khor lo dbang med du/ /dus thog ma med nas deng sang bar du yang / /dgra nyon mongs 'di yis bskor bskor bskor lags pas/ /khyod nyon mongs gdon la dgra yi 'du shes zhog /sems nyon mongs mtshon gyis nag por kha bsgyur tshe/ /las mi dge'i rkyal ba dbang med rdol ba yin/ /yang yang dag lta bu'i dkar rtsi phog pa na/ /las dkar bos lan re bde 'gror 'phen mod de/ /khong lha dang lha min yang ni skyid do lo/ /sems 'dod pas bcings pa'i bag med nad de la/ /yang nam zhig 'khor ba'i zug rngu cher ldang zhing / /de min kyang sdug bsngal mngon gyur du ma yod / /gnas bsam gtan bde ba'i khang bzang dam pa na/ /sems snyoms 'jug ro la zhen pa'i lha bu'i tshogs/ /khyed phyir bltas 'dod la mi dgyes ches legs kyang / /yang srid pa'i zag pas dkris 'dis ci ru 'gyur/ /phyi 'dod yon spangs pa ma zad gzugs snang yang / /khong mi bzhed ting 'dzin zhi la ches dgyes pa'i / /lha gzugs med drang srong khyed kyang mar 'byon na/ /da 157

wa 0 sprulaskugasung rab kyi gsung 'bum/srid rtse'i bar la yid brtan ci zhig yod/ /gnas 'khor ba 'di na gnas skabs ji ltar yang / /sems nyon mongs dbang gyur las kyi sgyu ma la/ /da bde'o skad pa bslu ba yin nges pas chos zer ba'i phan yon yang dang yang du soms/ /sems zag pa bral ba'i zhi ba'i dbyings de la/ /khong dgra bcom bye ba zhen pa med par dgyes / /sdug 'khor ba'i snang tshul rnam grangs ci tsam pa/ /de bral ba'i phan yon grangs yang de tsam gda'/ /dgra nyon mongs gtan du zad pa de dag la/ /khong zag med bde zhes 'phags tshogs gtam du gleng / /de gya rnam kun gyi rab dang phul lags na/ /khyod nyon mongs spong ba'i zhi ba'i lam bzang bsten/ /sems nyon mongs zag pa mngon gyur sun 'byin zhing / /yang bag la nyal gyi dri ma bkru ba'i chu/ /lam lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum po yin no zhes//khong bden gsung mnga' ba rgyal ba de skad gsungs/ /dus dang por bslab par bya ba'i gnas bzang po/ /rten tshul khrims sa gzhi gtsang ma gal che bas/ /khyod nyon mongs dgra dang gnyen pos g.yul 'thob la/ /rgyud nyes pas ma gos pa zhig cis kyang dgos/ /khong skye bo ngan pa 'tshogs pa'i tshong 'dus na/ /las mi dge'i tshong zong gcig la gcig 'gyed pa'i/ /grogs 'du 'dzis lha chos 158

rang rgyud skul 'debs/'phral 'phral bshol lags pas/ /khyod 'du 'dzi ma byed dben pa'i ri la song / /yang nags tshal mngon dga' 'khri shing gzhon nu rnams/ /rlung bsil bas bskyod pa'i lcang lo ldem pa'i rtser/ /khong 'jol mo'i gre 'gyur snyan pa'i gling bu bzhin/ /gnas de 'dra lha yul las kyang lhag lags te/ /nyams dga' zhing spro la sos dal gu re yangs/ /yang chags pas 'ching ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan med/ /sems zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa'i rjes su mthun/ /don de 'dra bsams nas dben pa'i ri la song / /rdza lhun stug mtho la brjid pa'i ri sul na/ /gnas brag dmar brtsigs pa'i rang byung khang bzang na/ /chu lhung lhung 'bab pa'i sgra snyan gyis 'bod pas/ /da yun ring ma thogs dben pa'i ri la song / /dgung sngo sangs dwangs pa'i mkha' la bsnyegs pa yi/ /rdza rab rno shel dkar gangs ri'i bzhin ras des/ /steng khri gdugs nyi ma'i 'od kyis yongs brgyan nas/ /khyod 'bod pa 'dra yi dben pa'i ri la song / /gnas de 'dra rnams na de 'dra'i yon tan la/ /khong drang srong tshogs rnams dgyes shing bzhugs lags pas/ /khyod 'dod pas ma yengs dben pa'i ri ngogs nas/ /sems bsam gtan zab mo snying gi ze'u 'brur chongs/ /yang rang nyid kho na bsam pa'i chos 159

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/des kyang / /'bras rang don tsam yang pha mthar 'khyol dka' bas / /rten dal 'byor me tog bzang bo smin dus 'dir/ /chos theg pa chen po'i sbrang rtsi btung re 'tshal/ /lam zab cing rgyas pa byang chub sems gnyis che/ /khong sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /lam de 'dra min pa'i blun po'i mgo skor la/ /khyod ma yengs byang chub sems la gcig dril gyis/ /khong mkha' khyab sems can pha ma drin can du/ /lung rigs pas grub kyang kho bo'i snang tshul la/ /don 'brel med 'gro ba sha stag yin snyam nas/ /tshe 'di yi dgra gnyen bar mar 'dzin pa 'khrul/ /blo 'khrul ba de 'dras da bar bslus bslus nas/ /rang gces par bzung nas rang don bsgrubs bsgrubs kyang / /sdug rang steng 'khrid pa 'dra las gzhan med pas/ /bdag gces 'dzin blo la nyes dmigs ci 'dug soms/ /da pha ma sems can mi 'dod sdug bsngal brgyas/ /rang ji lta ba bzhin ring mo nas mnar na/ /chos theg pa che dang 'phrad pa'i skal ldan khyod/ /da gzhan don mi bsam rang bde ji ltar sems/ /ma lan re byas pa'i tshe yang lto gos sogs/ /ches phangs pa'i dngos dgus bskyangs pa ma zad de/ /bu skyob par mthong na srog kyang gtong nus pa'i/ /drin 'khor med de 'dra blo 160

rang rgyud skul 'debs/yis 'dor phod dam/ /khong don gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skad po che/ /zhing 'di la ma brten 'thob pa mi srid na/ /dman nyam thag 'gro don mi gnyer ka med pas/ /khyod sdug lus ma che sems can don la soms/ /ma drin can de rnams sdug gis dbang med du/ /dus lan gcig min par yang yang mnar ba la/ /khyod bzod bsran ma che sdug bsngal sna re bzhin/ /yang bral na snyam pa'i snying rje'i blo 'di sbyongs/ /blo de 'dra rgyal ba kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /khong rgyal sras bye ba'i thugs dam mthil lags na/ /chos zab mo skad kyi stong sgras ma 'khrul bar/ /thabs ma nor snying rje chen pos gzhi 'ding mdzod/ /rten rdzogs byang 'dod pa'i sems bskyed la brten te/ /lam phyin drug spyod pa'i 'jug ngogs zla med der/ /dus nyin re bzhin yang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed la / /sems theg pa che la snying nas ci 'gro gyis/ /don de ltar spyad pa'i thabs kyi lag rjes las/ /'bras gzhan don rdzogs pa'i gzugs kyi sku 'byung na/ /las gzhan phan mdzad pa'i sku gnyis mi mnga' ba'i/ /lha sangs rgyas 'dug ge bzhad gad ma slongs shig /yang bdag 'dzin spros pa'i nad 'di ma byang na/ /sdug mi 'dod skye ba'i zug rngu mi chod pas/ /ches zab cing phra ba'i gnas lugs 161

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/stong ba'i bzhin/ /'di yang dag rigs pas yang yang byi dor gyis / /khong rgyal ba'i yum chen shes rab phar phyin mdzod/ /mgon klu sgrub zla ba'i rigs pa'i lde mig gis/ /rje 'jam mgon bla mas phyes pa'i pha nor la/ /ches ngo mtshar yod 'dug blo gros ma rmongs shig /yang mi 'dod sdug dang 'phrad par dogs pa'i nga / /yang skyid du song na snyam du zhen pa'i nga / /gzhi lus sems tshogs pa'i tho yor 'di'i steng na/ /mi nga ni ji ltar yod 'dug zhib tu soms//kho shes rig wa le khyug ge yod do skad/ /sems sems byung so sor phyes te nyul na yang / /gcig tha dad gang yang rnyed rgyur mi 'dug pas / /yul rnam par rtog bzhin rtog mkhan gang du song / /yang yan lag tshogs pa'i thag khra'i ngos shig na/ /lus mi sdug sbrul gyi 'jigs skrag yod skad de/ /da ji ltar yod 'dug shes rab kyis brtags na/ /khyod 'khrul ba yin te rmongs pa'i smag gis bslus/ /chab dwangs pa'i mtsho la 'od stong zla ba'i gzugs/ /kho lam lam 'char ba'i snang tshul 'dis brid de/ /klung zab mo brgal te rnyed par re na yang / /de rnyed rgyur mi 'dug snang ba tsam du zad/ /yang rigs sngags mkhan po'i nye 'khor tshong 'dus na/ /rta rin chen rgyan ldan 'gros ldan yod do skad/ /kho bzhin par 'dod de 162

rang rgyud skul 'debs/rkang bas reg na yang / /gzhi rde'u shing tshogs pa sa la 'thor nas 'dug /dpyid tshad pas gdung ba'i mya ngam thang shed na/ /chu bsil ldan klung mang yer yer 'bab bo skad/ /khong ri dwags tshogs rnams skom pas rgyugs na yang / /chab btung du med de bslu ba de rnams bzhin/ /khyod gces par bzung ba'i nga'o skad pa de / /ming tha snyad rkyang bas ji ltar gdags su chugs/ /don gdags gzhi'i ngos na ci yang mi 'dug pas/ /nga rdzun po che de stong ba'i ngang la zhog /don de bzhin snang grags shes bya'i chos so cog /yang bden par grub pa gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ /khyod bdag tu ma 'dzin 'dzin med stong ba'i ngang / /blo lhan ner zhogs dang gnas lugs mthong bar gda'/ /don ngo bo nyid kyis cir yang med na yang / /tshig tha snyad ri mo rtog pas bris pa ltar/ /kho mi bden bzhin yang rgyu 'bras mi bslu bas/ /rgyu dge sdig spang blang ma nor byed re dgos/ /chos lta ba zab la spyod pa rgya che ba'i/ /khong rnam thar gtsang ma bka' gdams snga phyi'i lugs/ /dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /yang snying gi ze'u 'brur 'bral ba med par shog /phyi so thar kun spyod 'dul ba bzhin du dag /nang byang sems bslab pa mdo sde bzhin du rgyas/ /don shes 163

wa sprulaskugasung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rab zab mo mngon pa'i lugs bzhin mdzad/ /chos sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa tshugs par shog /lar 'di nas 'phos pa'i skad cig de nyid la/ /lha mi pham mgon po'i bzang bo'i bzhugs stangs kyis / /gsung tshangs pa'i gdangs kyis theg mchog chos ston pa'i/ /gnas dga' ldan zhing du brdzus te skye bar shog /mgon 'jam dpal snying dang nam mkha' dri ma med/ /khong rgyal sras tshogs rnams rgyal ba'i yum chen don/ /don ji lta ba bzhin bgro ba'i chos grwa der/ /sems theg chen chos kyis rab tu smin par shog /don de ltar smon pa 'grub pa'i dpang po ru/ /lha dkon mchog gsum dang rgyal sras kun tu bzang / /thugs brtse bas gzigs pas nam yang mi bsnyel bar/ /don bden pa'i byin rlabs da lta mngon gyur shog /ces byang chub lam rim las brtsams te rang rgyud la skul ma 'debs pa 'di ni/mos gus kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i rten 'brel bzang bo'i khyad las/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po'i dad pa'i sngon shing gi gsung sgros kyi lugs la dpe byas te/ dge stong gi gzugs brnyan dharma sa ra zhes bya bas rang gi dad pa'i khams gso ba'i slad du bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rang gzhan gyi rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /164
ni gyi mngan pa bzhung

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄/ /dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel nyung ngu lta ba ngan pa gcod pa'i ral gri/khog /'jam dpal thugs la rol ba'i blo gros kyis/ /lnga rig shes bya'i snang ba 'bum brdal ba'i/ /mtshungs bral dge ba'i bshes der gus btud nas/ /dbu ma'i rgyan 'di nyung ngu'i mchan gyis dbye/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma d+dha ma ka dbu ma/ a laṅka ra rgyan/kā ri kā tshig le'ur byas pa/ bod skad du mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbus ston pa'i gzhung dbu ma rtsa she sogs rigs pa dang mdo sde'i lung gi 'thad pas byi dor gyis mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi tshigs su bcad pas le'ur byas pa lo tsā ba chen po zhang ye shes sdes lha btsan po'i bkas bcad dang bstun nas mngon pa'i ngos 'dzin dang / 'gyur mthar phyin pa'i ched du 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mdzad do/ /gzhung don dngos la yang dag shes 'tshol sngon du btang nas snying rje chen po sogs theg pa chen po'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i nyams len bzhin chos kyi rjes 'brang gi dbang du byas nas/ dang po bden pa rigs pas bkag de nas rdzun pa tshad mas sgrub/ dgag sgrub de 166

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/ltar byas pa'i phan yon theg pa mchog gi mngon rtogs khyad par can skye ba bcas bsdus don gsum du nges par byas te/ dang po rtags bkod de mdor bstan pa ni/bdag rang sde dang gzhan sdes smras pa'i dngos po phung sogs dang ske/ bdag dang gtso bo sogs 'di dag dgag bya don dam par grub pa'i tshul gnyis kyi yang dag gang ltar du na yang gcig pa dang —/ du ma'i rang bzhin bral ba'i phyir/ bden grub kyi rang bzhin med de mthun dpe gzugs brnyan bzhin/ ngag 'di tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub pa yin par rang 'grel dang / thal rang gang byas chog par mkhas mchog ka ma la shī las gsungs la/ bsgrub chos med dgag yin pa lugs 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed legs ldan gyis sher sgron du 'phags pa'i grub mthar bshad do/ /thal 'gyur byed tshe rtags khas blang du song tshul dang / rang rgyud byed tshe chos can med kyang ma 'grub par mi 'gyur ba'i zhib cha gnyis shin tu shes dgos so/ /de nas tshul bsgrubs te rgyas par 'chad pa la/ phyogs chos dang / khyab pa'i tshul gnyis las/ phyogs chos kyi zur dang po sgrub pa la yul dang yul can gcig bral du sgrub pa gnyis las/ yul la khyab pa dang / ma khyab pa'i gcig bden 167

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'gog pa'i dang po gzhan sdes btags pa'i rtag gcig 'bras bu skyed pa 'gog pa ni 'bras bu dga' gdung sogs snga phyi rim can nye bar sbyor ba mngon sum yin pas/ rgyur btags pa gtso bo dang bdag sogs rtag pa rnams bden pa'i gcig tu grub pa'i bdag nyid min no/ /khyab ste/ dngos rgyu nus pa thog med la 'bras bu shol mi srid pas cig char 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rkyen dang 'dus pa'i nus pas rim can du skyed zer na/ rgyu la khyad par byar yod pas rtag gcig nyams so/ /yang 'bras bu re re skyed pa'i rgyu tha dad yod zer na/ rgyu de dag rtag gcig tu khas blangs pa las nyams par 'gyur ro/ /'di la dngos bstan rang rgyud dang /shugs la des 'phangs pa'i thal 'gyur gnyis so/ /rang sdes btags pa'i 'dus ma byas 'bras bu mi bskyed pa'i gcig 'gog pa ni/ bsgoms las byung ba'i shes pa yi/ shes bya 'dus ma byas gcig bden smra ba'i lugs la'ang chos gcig min chos can 'gog pa sogs dag ni/ rtags rim can shes dang yul yul can du 'brel ba'i phyir ro/ khyab ste/ shes pa snga phyi dang yul yul can du 'brel kyang yul de dag rtag pa gcig bden yin na/ brtags pa'i mtha' gnyis las/ dang po/ rnam shes snga mas shes par bya 168

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/ba'i / rang bzhin phyi ma'i dus su rjes 'brangs te yod na ni yul snga ma yul can snga ma la ltos te/ de'i shes byar song bas ltos yul shes pa snga ma'ang phyi mar 'gyur/ shes pa phyi ma'ang de ni snga mar 'gyur te/ ltos pa de rang dus su yod dgos par rigs 'phul gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ sngon dang phyi ma'i gnas skabs rnams su yul phan tshun rjes su mi 'brang bas/ de yi ngo bo mi 'byung na/ 'dus ma byas te rnal 'byor mngon sum gyis shes pa mi rtag pa phra mo gzhal ba bzhin/ byung tsam nas skad cig 'byung bar shes par bya zhing / de tshe snga ma snga ma'i skad cig gi nus mthu yis phyi ma rnams 'byung bar 'gyur bas na/ ming don gnyis char nas 'dus ma byas su 'di mi 'gyur te/ sems dang sems las byung ba bzhin / dus snga phyi rang mtshan gyi nus pas 'byung 'jug tu song ba'i phyir ro/ /skyon de spong snyam nas/ skad cig ma rnams 'di dag tu/ /snga phyi so sor byung yang rang dbang gis 'byung bar 'dod na ni/ rang dbang gis byung ba de gzhan la ltos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /dus rtag tu yod pa'am yang na med par 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas de dag chos can/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin te/ res 'ga' 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sems sems 169

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/byung bzhin/ zhes rang 'grel du bsgrubs so/ /rang gzhan sde bas btags pa'i 'dus ma byas de dag yod yod lta bur rlom nas rang ldog nas 'gog pa'i gzhir bzung ba ma gtogs dgag gzhi chos can du mi rigs te/ skyes bu'i 'dod don byed nus pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ khyab ste/ don byed nus pa ma yin la/ de 'dod brtags pas ci zhig bya/ dper na/ ma ning gzugs bzang mi bzang zhes/ /'dod ldan rnams kyis brtags ci phan/ /dngos po min pa bdag gnyis 'gog pa'i gzhir mi 'dzin pa ni gtso bo'i dbang du byas shing / 'di dag gal srid grub na skyes bu'i don bya ba'i gzhir yongs gcod du grub dgos pas yin no/ /yang 'dus ma byas rdzas grub de dag dang 'dra ba'i gang zag brjod med rdzas yod rang sde mang bos bkur bas 'dod pa 'gog par/ skad cig gi bdag nyid yin na du ma'i rang bzhin du 'gyur la/ skad cig ma ma yin na snga phyi sogs ltos med yin pas gcig tu 'gyur bar zad la/ de gnyis gang rung du gang zag bstan du mi rung bar khas len pas/ gang zag gi steng du phyogs chos gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin dang bral ba grub par gsal bar rigs pas rab tu shes so/ /khyab pa gzhan 'gog par tha dad pa'i phyogs can ljon 170

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/shing sogs dang so sor 'brel bas/ khyab pa nam mkha' dang /phyogs dus lta bu rnams gcig pur ga la 'gyur/ khyab ste/ yang na phyogs dus can rnams 'dres par 'gyur la/ min na cha so so bar 'grub pas gcig bden khegs so/ /nang gses dbye na mang ngo / /ma khyab pa gcig bden 'gog pa la/ rags pa dang / phra bar dpyad pa gnyis las/ thog mar bsgrib dang ma bsgrib pa'i dngos po lta bu rdzas kyi 'gal ba dang sogs khong nas g.yo mi g.yo lta bu bya ba 'gal ba dang / tshon gyis bsgyur ma bsgyur sogs yon tan gyi 'gal 'du yod pa'i phyir/ rags pa yan lag can lus dang bum pa lta bu rnams kyang gcig pu ru bden pa min no/ /khyab ste / chos 'gal ba du ma rang gi cha shas su ldan pa'i cha can cha bcas su grub pa'i phyir/ bsgrib sogs yan lag gi yin gyi/ yan lag can gyi min na/ yan lag can yan lag tu ma 'du bar thal la / de tshe rkang ba sogs dang lus sogs mig gis so sor mthong bar thal lo/ /gal te yan lag can yan lag tu 'du ba'i sgo nas yan lag de dag yan lag can gyi yin na/ yan lag can 'gal ba'i cha dang ldan par thal lo/ /zhes pa'i rang 'grel gyi rigs pa rags pa gcig bden 'gog pa la 'phrul che'o/ /phra ba gcig 171

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bden 'gog pa la/ phyogs snga ma rags pa rdul gyis brtsams par 'dod pa bye brag pa dang / rags pa rdul la btags par 'dod pa mdo sde ba'i lugs te rdul phra rab cha med 'dod pa dag yin la/de yang gzegs zan pas 'byar ba dang ni slob dpon dge bsrungs sogs bskor ba'am/ btsun pa mi reg kyang bar med pa'i rnam par gnas pa la reg par 'du shes zer ba gang ltar kyang rung / brtags pa gnyis las mi 'da' bas/ dbus gnas rdul phran rdul gcig la/ /bltas pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /rdul phran gzhan la lta ba yang / /de nyid gal te yin brjod na/ /de lta yin na cha med de lta bus/ rags pa sa chu'i dkyil 'khor la sogs ji ltar rgyas 'gyur ram ste rgyas mi rung bar thal lo/ /'grel 'gyur dgag sgra can 'phyugs pa yin nam snyam mo/ /yang de la skyon mthong nas rdul phran gzhan la blta ba'i ngos/ gal te gzhan du 'dod na ni/ de lta na/ rab tu phra rdul ji lta bur/bden grub kyi gcig pu cha shas med par 'gyur/ des na rdul phran te phra rab cha med rang bzhin med par grub pa/ de'i phyir mig sogs dang rdzas la sogs/ rim bzhin bdag dang gzhan smras khams bco brgyad dang tshig gi don drug sogs mang bo dag172

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon pa yin/ khyab ste/ rgyal po'i bka' lta bus min par rigs pas 'grub pa'i phyir te/ rang sde 'og mas mig sogs de yi rang bzhin gdag gzhi rdul gyi tshogs pa la bzhed pas rdul cha med khegs tshe mig sogs phyi don bden pa khegs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzugs can gyi khams bcu bo'i bden grub khegs tshe de la brten pa'i rnam shes kyi khams lnga bden grub khegs / rnam shes kyi khams lnga bden par med pas de ma thag rkyen des bskyed pa'i yid kyi rnam shes bden grub khegs/ des de 'das ma thag pa'i yid dbang khegs/ de ltar gtso sems bden pa khegs pas grub bde gcig pa'i tshor 'du sogs sems byung rnams khegs/ ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed rnams ni dpyod ldan rnams kyis dum bur bshig zin pa'am yang na 'brel yul khegs pas 'brel ba can kyang khegs/ rnam rig min pa'i gzugs ni/'byung ba chen po rgyur byas pa las skye bas de khegs pas khegs/nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas rnams sngar bkag zin pas khams bco brgyad rang bzhin med par gsal lo gsungs/ rdul gnyis 'dus pa sogs kyis dngos brgyud ci rigs pas yan lag can gyi rdzas rnams rdul des brtsam par gzegs zan pa 'dod 173

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pas rdul cha med khegs pas de khegs pa dang / gzugs dri sogs rdzas de la brten pa yi yon tan du 'dod pas de yang khegs/'degs 'jog sogs las lnga yang rdzas de yi las zhes de'i bdag nyid du 'dod pas de yang khegs/ rdzas de yi rang bzhin khyab byed spyi dang khyab bya khyad par yang rdzas khegs pas khegs te/ de lta bu'i rdzas de dag dngos sam brgyud nas rdul cha med de dang 'du ba can yin pa'i phyir dang / 'du ba yang 'du ba can med na med pas tshogs don drug khegs so/ /rtag dngos mkha' dus phyogs bdag rdul rnams kyang sngar bkag pas yul bden grub tu sgro 'dogs pa'i rang mtshan kun rigs pas phye mar btags so/ /yul can shes pa gcig bden 'gog pa la/ gzung 'dzin rdzas tha dad du 'dod pa'i gnyis kyi tshul gyi shes pa gcig bden 'gog pa dang / gnyis kyi tshul ma yin pa'i rnam rig tsam gcig bden 'gog pa gnyis las/ dang po la gtso phal gyi rang sde dang gzhan sde gnyis yod pa'i rang sde la phyi rol don du smra ba gnyis kyi thog mar bye smras rnam med kyi shes pa gcig bden 'gog par/dang po rang rig bsgrubs te shes pa gzung 'dzin gyi cha gnyis su bzhag nas gcig bden 'gog pa ni/ rnam shes shing rta sogs 174

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/bem po mi gsal ba'i rang bzhin las/ bzlog pa'i sgo nas gsar bar rab tu skye ba ste yin na/ shing rta sogs bem po mi gsal ba yin pas gsal byed dam shes byed gzhan dgos lta bu las log ste/bem po dang 'dra ba min pa'i rang gsal gyi rang bzhin gang yin pa / de nyid shes pa 'di'i bdag nyid kyi ngo bo shes pa'i 'dzin rnam rang rig yin no/ /'dis rang rgyud bstan ma bstan dpyad/shes pa'i ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa la rdzas cha so sor phye rgyu med pas de 'dra'i rang bzhin la/ rdzas gsum gyi rang bzhin mi 'thad phyir/shes pa de yi rang gis rang rig pa ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa gnyis bskyed bya skyed byed dang / rig bya rig byed kyi bya ba dang byed pa'i dngos por rnam bcas mdo sde ba sogs rgyu 'bras kyi gzung rnam 'jog pa ltar 'dod pa min no/ /bshad ma thag pa de'i phyir rang rig 'di ni shes pa yi/ rang bzhin yin pas bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba'i dbang gis rang gi bdag nyid shes rung na/ gzugs sogs don gyi rang bzhin shes pa'i rdzas las gud du gyur pa'i gzhan dag la/ gzhan rig de yis ji ltar shes par 'gyur te mi shes par thal/ rang nyid rang la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i rang gsal dang bcas pa'i shes pa de yi rdzas kyi rang bzhin 175

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ni gzhan don lnga la med pas 'brel med rgyang chad du song ba'i phyir / khyab ste/ shes tshul 'dzin rnam gang gis rang dang rdzas tha dad mi dad pa'i gzung rnam de mngon sum du shes pa'i stobs kyis myong tsam gyi ngo bor gzung 'dzin rig gsum rdzas gcig pas gzhan don yang shes dgos la/ bye smra khyod shes dang shes par bya ba'i don/ rdzas tha dad par ni 'dod phyir ro/ /bye smra la don rig mi 'thad tshul 'di gal che la/ rnam pa dang rang rig med pa'i phyogs la don shes gang yang bsnyad du med par gsungs so/ /bye smra mdo sde ba las kyang dman te/ shes pa rnam bcas phyogs la ni/dngos po'i rdzas su de gnyis tha dad kyang gzung rnam de gzugs sogs de dang de'i gzugs brnyan lta bur 'dra bar skyes pas na/'dra rnam de rang rig gis gzhal nas don la sgro 'dogs chod pas des de rtogs so zhes tha snyad gdags pa tsam gyis tshor bar rung ba la/ don gyi rnam pas bsgyur ldan pa'i/ /rnam shes su zhig mi 'dod pa/ /bye smra man chad de la phyi rol rig pa yi/ gzung ba'i rnam pa 'di yang yod ma yin pas don kyang 'jig mi nus pas so//mdo sde ba 'gog pa la/ rnam pa'i 'dod tshul gyis shes pa gcig bden 'gog pa gsum las/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa 176

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/'gog pa la/ shes pa gcig la gzung ba'i rnam pa du ma dus mnyam du 'char ba sna tshogs gnyis med pa dang de slob dpon gyis yang bzhed pa yin la/ de la dgag bya'i khyad par sbyar te 'gog pa gces kyang 'dir skabs stobs kyis phyi don sbyar yod pas/shes pa gcig dang tha dad ma yin pas/ sngo ser sogs dang 'dra ba'i rnam pa mang po yod par mi 'gyur te/ de phyir rnam pa de yi mthu yis ni/ sngo ser sogs kyi ri mo brkyangs pa'i phyi don so sor shes rnam gyis mthong ba'i dbang gis 'gyur bar gzhag pa med par 'gyur ro/ /khra bo'i tshogs par sngo ser sogs du ma mngon sum yin no zhe na/ khyod rnam pa rnams dang ma bral bas/ rnam pa dang bdag nyid gcig pa'i rnam shes kyang gcig tu mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar cig shos kyi grangs kyi shan gyis cig shos la gnod pa yin na / rnam pa dang shes pa 'di gnyis la/ don dam par ngo bo gcig ces ji skad de ci'i phyir brjod par bya/ yang sna tshogs rim 'dzin pa ni/ rnam shes du mar thal ba la mi 'dod pa med de/dkar bo dag la sogs pa la/ /shes pa de ni rim 'byung ste/ /'on kyang / mgyogs par 'byung phyir blun po dag /cig char snyam du shes pa yin/ /ut+pa la'i 'dab ma brgya 'bigs pa dang / 'gal 177

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/me'i 'khor lo mthong ba bzhin/ zer ba la/ don mi 'thad pa dang dpe dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po/ lhug ma'i sgra la ta dang / shing ta la la sogs pa nas sa raḥr saḥlta bu brjod pa'i sgra dang blo rab tu mgyogs par 'byung ba yin na/ de phyir cig char 'byung bar shes pa la/ rgyu 'dir yang yod pas ci'i phyir cig char du 'byung bar shes par mi 'gyur/ rgyu 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'dra dgos so/ /sems pa dang dpyod pa'i tshe dbang shes dang ma 'dres pa'i yid kyi rtog pa 'ba' zhig la'ang / rim can du shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang gi grub mthar myur du 'jig pa'i blo gang yang yun ring du gnas pa ma yin zhes 'byung bas/ blo rnams kun kyang mgyogs 'byung 'dra bas rgyu thun mong du yod do/ /de'i phyir yul rnams thams cad la/ sgra rtog gis rim gyis 'dzin par mi 'gyur gyis/ rnam pa dag ni tha dad pa shes pas rim par bzung yang mgyogs pas cig char bzung bar snang ba 'dod pa ltar/cig char 'dzin par snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta na mngon sum dang 'gal la/ nges shes med par thal lo/ /dpe yang mi 'thad de / ut+pa la'i 'dab ma 'big pa gsal bar mi snang bas zhib mo rnams kyis rim can du nges pas mi 'dra la/ mgyogs pas ma yin 178

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/par mgal me la yang cig char du/ 'khor lo snang ba'i 'khrul ba 'byung ba yin gyi/ don spyi ma brgyud par gsal bar rab tu snang ba'i phyir/ snga phyir gsal bar mthong ba sdom pas mtshams sbyor te/'khor lor snang ba ma yin no/ /khyab ste/ 'di ltar snga phyi rnams mtshams sbyor ba ni/ don spyi can gyi dran pas byed pa nyid yin gyi/gsal bar mthong bas mtshams sbyor bar snang ba ma yin te/ snga ma 'das zin pa yi/ yul la gsal snang can gyi mthong bas 'dzin pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta min na/ de yi yul du gang gyur pa/ snga ma de ni zhig pas phyi ma dang lhan cig gsal bar snang ba ma yin pa de phyir 'khor lor snang ba 'di gsal bar snang ba ma yin par thal bar 'gyur ba'i rigs so/ /des na mgal me 'khor lor snang ba ni 'khrul rgyu yul la yod pa'i dbang gis dbang bo bslad de snang ba las/ mgyogs pa'i dbang gis snga phyi bar ma chad par 'khor lor snang ba min no/ /legs par bshad yod do/ /yang gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa ni/ ri mo sna tshogs brkyangs pa ste bkram pa mthong ba'i tshe/ de la de ni rigs mthun gyi sems mang po ci ste cig cha'i tshul gyis su/ 'byung bar 'gyur bar 'dod na ko na de lta bu 'dod pa yin na dkar po la sogs/ rnam pa sna 179

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gcig shes pa yang / de'i thog ma tshu rol dbus dkyil mtha' pha rol tha dad pas/ de la dmigs pa'i shes pa yang sna tshogs nyid du 'gyur ro/ /de 'dod na/ shes pa gcig gang yin dris pas gang yan lag med pa'i rdul phran 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dkar po la sogs kyi tshogs pa'i gcig pu'i bdag nyid rdul cha med pa 'dzin pa 'di yin zer na/ de 'dra de ji ltar brtags kyang shes pa gang la'ang snang gyur par/ bdag gis rab tu ste nyams myong tshad mas tshor ba med na ma mthong ba bzhin du sgro btags nas rang gis rang nyid ji ltar bslu/ rtogs ldan gyis yod par khas len pa'i rgyu tshad mas dmigs pa yin na/ de ni de med pas rung ba ma yin no/ /gsungs pas tha snyad tshad grub mi 'dod pa'i thal rang su yang med par grub bo/ /yang phye ma leb khra bo'i kha dog gi rab dbye bzhin du rigs mthun gyi shes pa mang po cig char skye ba ni mi 'thad la/ de tshe shes pa gcig la rnam pa du ma yod pa sna tshogs gnyis med pa'i lugs 'di slob dpon rang gi yang rnam pa'i bzhed tshul yin na/ 'di nyid shes pa gcig bden du 'gyur ram / rang bzhin dang 'dra ba'i rdzun pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa la / tshul 'di lung rigs kyis grub pas de ltar smras pa dge mod/180

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/'on kyang sems tsam pa de dag gi rnam pa'i dngos de yang dag bden grub nyid dam ci/ yang na 'on te rigs shes kyis ma brtags gcig pu ste ma brtags pa kho na'i dbang du na/ nyams dga' bar blo gnod med la snang tsam du khas len pa gang yin/'di gnyis legs par bsam mo ste dpyad do/ /gal te yang dag par grub pa'i phyogs yin no zhe na/ de tshe sngo ser yul khebs par snang ba'i rags pa'i rnam pa 'di ltar dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi dbang gis bden par grub bam/ bag chags kyis bslad pa kho na'i dbang gis rdzun par grub/ dang po ltar ro zhe na/ rnam par shes pa du mar 'gyur ro/ /yang na ni/ rnam shes gcig la snang ba'i rnam pa de dag gcig tu 'gyur te/ gang ltar de gnyis grangs 'gal ba dang ldan pas/ gdon mi za bar so sor 'gyur ro zhes 'gog 'gyur rnam bden gsum spyir btang dang / dgag bya'i khyad par sbyar te rang bzhed sna tshogs gnyis med pa la bye brag tu sbyar nas 'gog pa gnyis ka rung ngo / /de tshe sgo nga phyed tshal ba na re / thal ba gnyis pa rnam pa tha dad ma yin pa 'dod do zhe na/ phye ma leb kyi gshog pa'i sngo ser so so la rags pa khra tsam gyi rnam pa gcig 'char na/ g.yo dang mi g.yo la sogs pa/ gcig gis 181

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/thams cad g.yo la sogs su 'gyur bas bya ba 'gal ba sogs med par thal bar 'gyur te lan gdab dka' 'o/ /phyi rol don gyi tshul khas len pa la yang / rags pa'i cha dang cha can ngo bo gcig par phyi rol tu bden par grub na/ de ltar rnam pa ma bral na/'gal zla gcig gi chos su gzhan thams cad kyang / 'jug par 'gyur te lan gyis bzlog pa med do/ /yang gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa na re/ bde ba la sogs pa ltar sngo ser sogs kyang re re nas myong dgos pas ci ste rnam pa'i grangs bzhin du/ rnam par shes pa khas len pas thal ba dang po 'dod do zhe na/ de tshe mdo gnyis dang rnam 'grel bcas lung 'gal gsum dang kun gzhi rdzas re re bar khas blangs pa dang 'gal ba yod par ma zad/sngar rdul phran cha med kyis rags pa rtsom mi nus pa dang 'dra bar rnam pa'i grangs mnyam gyi rnam shes kyis kyang yul khebs pa'i rags snang gi rnam shes gcig tu mi 'gyur ba sogs kyis rnam bden par ji ltar 'gyur ba yin gyi dpyad pa 'di las bzlog par dka' 'o/ /kun gzhi khas blangs na bden grub tu khas len dgos pas lugs 'di'i kun gzhi mi bzhed pa shes sla'o/ /yang sna tshogs gnyis med pa'i bye brag rnam shes gcig smra ba na re/ nor bu gzi 182

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/bzhin du gal te rnam pa sna tshogs pa de dag rnam shes gcig gis cig char dang rim can gang rung gis shes so zhe na/ 'di ni nam mkha'i gos can gcer bu ba'i lugs sam ci zhig yin/ gang sna tshogs yin na de yang dag par gcig pa'i rang bzhin min pas khyab / dper na/ rin chen sna tshogs dang la sogs pa sems rgyud sna tshogs la yod pa'i shes pa dang 'dra'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa gcig pu'i snyam pa shin tu bsal dgos pas/ dang po rang sde'i lugs las/ rnam shes lnga yi khams lnga ni/ gzugs can phra rdul bsags pa la dmigs pa'i du ma'i rnam pa can yin pas rnam pa du ma'i cha yod phyir gcig bden du mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam shes lnga dang grub bde gcig pa'i yid kyi rnam shes kyang de bzhin dang /chos khams la rnam rig min pa dang / 'dus ma byas gsum kyang mngon sum tshad ma'i snang yul du ma grub pas dang / lhag ma tshor 'du 'du byed kyi phung bo gsum la dmigs pa'i rnal 'byor ba'i mngon sum kyang gcig bden min te/ sems dang sems byung re re ba tsam dmigs pa min par de gnyis tshogs pa na/ rnam shes kyi khams drug pa yid kyi rnam shes kyi dmigs par gzhag par byas pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab ste/ de'i grangs snyed kyi rnam pa'i cha 183

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i gzhung lugs mkhan rnams kyi lugs la'ang rnam shes ni/ rang yul gcig tu snang ba'i sgo nas gcig bden yod par mi rigs te/gzegs zan pa ni/ yon tan nyer bzhi dang la sogs pa'i las lnga dang / spyi gnyis dang bye brag 'du ba gnyis bcas ji ltar rigs par ldan pa yi/ 'bras bu'i rdzas dgu dang la sogs pa yon tan sogs dmigs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di dag dngos dbang gis dmigs dgos pas yon tan lta bu dmigs tshe rten rdzas dang ldan par 'dod pas de sogs dmigs dgos so/ /tshig gi don drug rgyas par shes pa 'dir gal che/ rgyal ba'i rjes 'brang zad byed pa dang dpyod pa ba'i lugs la yul gcig nor bu gzi yi bdag nyid ltar / dngos po sna tshogs pa kun gyi bdag nyid du yod la/ brjod 'dod kyi khyad par las cig char dang rim can gyi tshul gnyis gang rung gis tha dad dang tha dad min par shes so zhes lta ba la/ de la 'dzin pa'i sems kyang ni/ gcig pu'i ngo bor snang mi rigs pa'i phyir te/ yul sna tshogs la rnam shes sna tshogs min pa 'jug tshe yul dang mthun par mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de lta na de 184

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/de'i yul can tshad mar mi 'gyur bar thal lo/ /lha yi bla ma phur bu'i rjes 'brang rgyang 'phen pa la sogs pa 'byung ba 'dus pa la/dmigs pa yul dang dmigs byed dbang bo kun 'jug par byed pa'i sgos blo yang 'byung ba las skye bar su 'dod de yi lugs la yang —/ blo de dngos po gcig dang yang mthun 'jug med de/'dus par rnam par bzhag pa'i rgyu ni 'dus pa can du ma yin pas so/ /ser skya'i rjes 'brang grangs can pa ni/ snying stobs la sogs pas rdul mun gsum cha mnyam pa'i bdag nyid kyi gtso bo sgra de tsam sogs shes bya nyer gsum gyi ngo bor yod par 'dod pa'i phyogs la'ang don gcig snang ba can gyi shes pa rigs pa ma yin te / rang bzhin gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi yul snang phyir/ ma khyab ste/dmigs pa'i tshe gsum ka dmigs pa min gyi/ gang shas che ba de dmigs so snyam na/ mi 'thad de/ rigs kyis rnga mo sogs tsher ma sogs la dad la gzhan skyo/ goms pas bud med g.yem la dga' zhing kun tu rgyu yid dbyung ba sogs dngos po gcig la rdul gyis gdung ba dang / mun pas zhum pa/ snying stobs kyis dga' ba sogs so sor myong ba'i phyir ro/ /yang shas che ba kho na min par mi snang ba chos chos min dang / dbang phyug sogs kyi dbang las de 185

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ltar myong zer na/ dngos po'i ngo bo rang bzhin rnam gsum la blos 'dzin lugs de na gal te rnam gcig ste/ yul de dang mi mthun snang na ko blo de ni yul de 'dzin pa'i tshad mar ji ltar 'dod/ ha cang thal lo/ /gnyis ma yin pa'i tshul gyi shes pa gcig bden dgag pa la phyi nang gnyis las/ bshad tshogs nyung bas dang po rig byed gsang mtha' ba/ sems las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i gzugs sogs yul rnams med par yang / 'khrul dbang gis sna tshogs snang la rtag pa gcig pu ste/ cig char dang rim gyis rnam pa sna tshogs shes so zer na/ sngo ser sogs rnam pa mang po cig char skye ba'am yang ji ste rim can du 'byung ba'i rnam shes rung ba'am 'thad par shin tu dka' ste/ rnam pa du ma dang tha dad min pas dum bur thal ba'i phyir ro/ /rim can la nyes pa gzhan rnam shes kyis rnam pa gcig rig na kun rig par thal ba yang yod do/ /rnam pa lhag ma mi nye bas mi rigs snyam na/ nye bar thal/ rnam shes de'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i rnam pa rnams yod mnyam yin pa'i phyir ro / /skabs 'dir tshangs pa gnyis med kyi shes pa'i ngo bo bden grub 'gog lugs dka' 'grel las gsungs pa shes dgos so/ /186

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/gnyis ma yin par 'dod pa'i rang sde sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi shes pa gcig bden dgag pa la/ thog mar de'i zhar byung rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi mdo sde ba 'dus ma byas gsum kun rdzob tu yod par 'dod pa'i lugs la'ang nam mkha' la sogs te 'gog pa gnyis sogs shes pa'i blo dag snang yul ming brdas bzhag tsam gyi spyi mtshan du ni chos de dag snang ba rnams/ yi ge sgra spyi du ma'i khyad par du byas nas snang ba'i phyir sna tshogs snang bar gsal ba yin / cha bcas yin pas gcig bden khegs so/ /gal srid khas blangs ltar rnam shes rtog pa sna tshogs min snang ba 'ga' zhig yod par gzhag na yang / 'on kyang yang dag bden grub tu gzhag mi rung ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid snang yul du yod pa dang bcas pa'i mngon sum gyi blo shin tu brling bo la'ang yang dag par grub pa la tshad mas gnod pa mthong ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de tshe rtog pa 'khrul ba la lta ci smos pa'i phyir dang / ngo bo 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na / de phyir rnam pa sna tshogs snang ba yis/ rnam shes kyi rnam pa kun tu phal cher khyab par gnas pa yin pas rnam shes de dag ni yul snang gi rnam pa tha dad ltar/ don dam par gcig pu'i rang bzhin mi rigs so/ /zhes mjug bsdus so/ /187

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rang sde theg chen pa blo gros shin tu dkar bas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi rig pa mi rtag par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa ba ni/ ji ste thog ma med pa nas rgyud chags su byung ba'i sems kyi bag chags gsum smin pas sprul ba yi rnam pa dag ni snang ba yang phyi rol tu snang ba ltar grub pa'i sems pa ni nor bas sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yin na/ sna tshogs ngo bor snang ba 'gal ba dang / rnam pa rnams kyi rang bzhin bden pa'i gcig yin na/ rnam pa rnams la bsgribs dang ma bsgribs pa la sogs pa/ so sor med par 'gyur na de dag tha dad pa 'di ni ji ltar 'thad par 'gyur/ mngon sum dang 'gal lo/ /rang lugs la rnam pa du ma can la rang bzhin gcig ma yin pas khyab pa med kyang / rang la ltag chod du mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan shes pa shin tu gal che la/ de yang blo gnod med la snang tsam gyis bzhag pa'i rdzun pa'i sdod lugs la de dag mi 'gal yang / de tsam min par sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa'i bden grub la 'gal bas na/ dgag bya sbyar te 'gog mi dgos kyi skabs so sor phye ste blo gros zhib mor 'jug pa gnad che'o / /yang bag chags kyi dbang gis rags snang rdzun par grub par 188

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/'dod de/ 'di skad du ji ste don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid du shes pa de'i yul go sa gnon nus kyi rags snang gi rnam pa 'di dag snang tshul ltar med pa ste/ yang dag tu na rnam shes de nyid shel sgong dag pa ltar sngon po la sogs pa dang 'phrad pas bye brag tu kha bsgyur bar byed pa'i gzung don gyi rnam pa ci yang med pa'i bdag nyid yin pa la/ thog ma med kyi bag chags smin pa'i mthus sngags kyis dkrugs pas 'jim dum rta glang sogs su snang ba ltar sngo ser sogs kyi rnam pa rnam par shes pa la nor ba ste 'khrul bas snang ngo zhe na/ gal te rnam pa med na ste rags pa yan lag can gang gi rnam ldan du skye ba'i gzung yul sngo ser lta bu med na zhes pa gong 'og 'di dag tu go dgos ji lta bur na/ gzung rnam gyis de dag nyams su myong ba 'di ltar don spyi tsam min par gsal bar tshor/rnam pa'i gzung don de yi dngos po ji lta bu yin pa las tha dad pa ste mi 'dra ba'i shes pa de 'dra skye rigs pa ma yin no/ /de kho na nyid du med pa dang blo don mthun gyis gsal bar shes pa ci 'gal snyam na/ 'di ltar gang la dngos po gang med na/ de la de shes pa nam yang yod pa ma yin pas khyab/ dper na bde ba min pa sdug bsngal la bde sogs dang / dkar ba rnams la'ang mi 189

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dkar ba sngo sogs su mi shes pa bzhin/ be+eḍūr+ya la sogs par yul khebs pa'i sngo ser sogs kyi kha dog rags pa yod pa min no 'am shes pa la yang sngo sogs kyi rnam pa med do zhes pa khyab byed 'gal dmigs yin zhes dka' 'grel las gsungs so/ /'di'i rtags chos rang lugs la ma grub pas rang rgyud min no/ /rtags 'di mi mthun phyogs las ldog pa la the tshom za snyam na/ spyir yul shes tshul la sgras brjod kyis shes pa bem min gsal ba'i mtshan nyid du skyes pas rang dang rang bzhin gcig pa'i gzung 'dzin kun 'brel ba de'i dbang gis dngos gnas la shes pa dang yul des rnam pa gtad de rang gi 'dra rnam du bskyed pa'i de byung gi 'brel bas shes par btags nas 'jog tshul gnyis las/ rnam pa 'di la yul shes pa'i don snga ma dngos gnas su shes pa 'thad pa ma yin te/ shes pa'i bdag nyid du 'brel ba dang bral ba'i phyir/dper na nam mkha'i me tog la sogs bzhin no/ /med pa la 'dra rnam bskyed pa'i nus pa med pas na/ phyi ma gdags pa'i sgos shes pa'ang mi rung ste/ rta ru bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ des bdag nyid snang ba'i shes pa mi bskyed la/ rgyu mtshan kyang nus pa med pas bskyed rung ba ma yin pa bzhin no/ /spyir yang gang dang gang 190

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/'brel ba med na shes mi srid pa'i rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rnam pa de yod pa nges par nyams myong gis tshor ba'i rgyu mtshan shes dang 'brel ba ci zhig yod/ dris na/ rang gi bdag nyid med na de yi bdag nyid du gyur pa dang / de las byung ba'i 'brel ba gnyis gang yang yod pa ma yin no/ /bdag gcig 'brel yod na shes pa bzhin du rnam pa yod pa'am rnam pa bzhin du shes pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de byung gi 'brel ba yod na yang bskyed bya'i ngo bo yod par thal zhing snga phyi yod pas cig char mi shes par thal lo/ /rnam pa tshor ba med par thal bar ma zad rgyu med pa sogs kyi nyes pa gzhan yang mang ste/ rnam pa med na de'i rgyu med la/ rgyu med na ni ltos pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhig gis sngon po'i rnam pa lta bu re 'ga' 'byung 'gyur ba 'di rung 'gyur/ nyes pa des rgyu dang ldan par khas len na rigs pa gang zhig gis/ gzhan gyi dbang las bzlog par 'gyur te/ rten 'brel las gud na gzhan dbang ci yang med do/ /rnam pa de med na ni da dung nyes pa gzhan mthun snang du grub pa'i shes pa gsal rig gi rang bzhin de yang / rnam pa med pa nyid kyis med par 'gyur te/ kha nang du bskor na yul gyis kha ma bsgyur ba'i shel sgong dag pa 'dra ba yi/ shes pa rab tu 191

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ste nyams myong tshad mas tshor ba med de/ nang dang phyi rol gyi rnam pa med na stobs kyis 'di 'ba' zhig dmigs par thal ba'i phyir rol/ /yang kho na re/ rnam pa 'di ni med kyang 'khrul bas shes te/smig rgyu chu dang / mig ser gyi nad kyis btab pa la dung mdog gser du snang ba bzhin zhe na/ de ci 'khrul ba la rag las sam/dpyad na 'khrul ba'i rgyu bag chags las byung na de byung gi rten 'brel gzhan dbang dang / bag chags kyi 'bras bu 'khrul shes de yi bdag nyid la rag las pa'i mthu las byung na ni/ de lta na yang 'khrul ba bzhin du gzhan gyi dbang nyid do/ /rnam pa med na smig rgyu'i chu sogs snang mi rung ba yang mtshungs par yod lugs shes dgos so/ /don smras/ dper na thag ring mya ngam thang na/ chung ngu chen por snang ba bzhin zhes pa'i klan ka la yang phyi don yod na de ltar snang mi rigs par thal ba mtshungs par yod cing / slob dpon dge bsrungs sogs shes pa rnam med du 'dod pa la yang skyon mtshungs par lan btab zin par gsungs so/ /des na sngo sogs kyi rnam pa ni 'khrul ba bag chags dang bcas par 'brel ba ma grub pas de dag log kyang rnam pa log mi dgos par rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ngo bor 'gro ba yin no/ /192

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/da ni bden grub kyi du ma dang bral ba bsgrub par bya ste/dngos po gang dang gang la rigs shes kyis rnam par dpyad na/ de dang de la bden grub kyi gcig nyid med pa bshad zin ltar la/gang la snang tsam min par yul gyi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas gcig nyid yod pa min pa/ de la de lta bu'i du ma nyid kyang med de/ du ma ni gcig bsags pa'i mtshan nyid can yin pas so/ /de ltar gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs 'di nyid lang kur gshegs pa sogs mdo dang / blo gros dkar bo chos kyi grags pa sogs kyi rnam 'grel sogs bstan bcos rnams su gsungs pas legs par grub kyang / chos gnyis ldan gyi dpe ma grub ste/ gzugs brnyan sogs ni bden par grub pa'i phyir/ de yang rgyal dpog pa rnams me long gi ngos la mig gi 'od zer phog pa slar log ste rang gi bzhin 'dzin pa yin zer la/ bye smra me long sogs par shin tu dwangs pa'i gzugs gzhan zhig 'byung ba yin zer zhing / mdo sde pa sogs dngos po'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthus de ltar snang ba'i rnam shes tsam 'byung ba yin zer te/ thams cad bden grub tu 'dod pa spyir bkag zin pa dang / bye brag tu lugs dang po lho byang gi phyogs dang / che chung gi dbyibs/ gyen thur rnams 193

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mi 'dra ba mi rigs pas khegs pa dang / gnyis pa thog bcas gcig gi go sar gcig 'byung ba la gegs byed pas khegs pa dang ske/ gsum pa yang gzugs brnyan bden pa la tshad mas gnod pas rnam shes la snang tsam gyi rdzas su khas len na phyi don gzugs la yang tshad mas gnod pas rnam rig tsam du khas blang dgos par thal bas khegs so/ /rang lugs la der snang gi shes pa tsam 'byung bas rdzun pa yin la/ lhag ma sgyu ma rmi lam smig rgyu dri za'i grong khyer mgal me'i 'khor lo bcas gzugs brnyan dang khyad par med par phra ba rdul phra rab dang / rags pa yan lag can gang gi ngo pos yang bden par med pas/ gcig du bral la bden med kyis khyab pa sgrub pa'i gzhir rdzun par legs par grub par 'grel ba 'grel bshad gnyis su gsungs so/ /dpe 'di dag rdzun pa min par gzhon nu ma len gyis bshad pa 'gog tshul sogs zhib tu ltos/ de ltar phyogs chos kyi tshul legs par grub pa'i 'og tu khyab pa sgrub pa ni/ mthun phyogs la yod kyang mi mthun phyogs las ji ltar ldog snyam na/ gcig dang du ma gang rung ma gtogs par gnyis yin dang / gnyis min gyi phung bo gsum pa'i rnam pa gzhan dang ldan pa yi/ dngos po mi rung ste 'di gnyis ni/ phan tshun 194

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/spangs te gnas phyir ro/ /de yang gcig rnam bcad la bkag na du ma yongs gcod du grub pas gnyis min sel la/ du ma yongs gcod du grub na gcig rnam bcad la khegs pas gnyis yin sel ba yin no/ /des bden grub kyi gcig du bral la'ang de ni sbyar bas ldog pa la the tshom chod cing / gtan tshigs 'di la dam bca'i phyogs gcig rtags su bkod pas ma grub pa'i nyes pa med par thog ma med nas bden par bzung ba'i bag chags mthu brtas pas tshul bzhin yid byed goms dka' ba goms pa'i slad du sgra blo'i tha snyad kyi yul du sgrub lugs sogs shes par bya'o/ /dka' gnad 'dab stong 'byed pa la/ /legs bshad 'od rnon gcig gis chog /nam mkha' nor bu gcig gis kyang / /sa steng mun pa ma bsal lam/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /de ltar bden pa rigs pas bkag nas da ni rdzun pa tshad mas bsgrub par bya ste/ de la kun rdzob ngos bzung ba dang / klan ka ngan pa bsal ba gnyis las dang po ni/ bden grub rigs pas rgyas par bkag pa de'i phyir dngos po 'di dag ni/ blo kun rdzob pa bden 'dzin gyi ngo tsam du bden pa'i kun rdzob bden pa'am/kun rdzob kyi don snang gnas mi mthun pa'i rdzun pa kho na'i mtshan 195

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nyid 'dzin pa yin te/ gal te de ltar min par 'di dag don dam par grub par 'dod pa ltar yin na/ de la kho bos dngos stobs kyi rigs pas dgag pa ci zhig bya bar nus te mi 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na dbu ma ba'i kun rdzob 'jog tshul rdzun pa kho na'i mtshan nyid du 'jog pa las bden pa'i don du 'dod na sngar bden grub bkag pa dgos med du 'gyur ba la sbyar ro/ /skabs 'dir stong bar gang gsung kun btags la dgongs pa dang /gzhan dang gnyis stong bden grub tu 'jog tshul bkag ste mdo dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa gzhan du drangs mi rung bar mdzad pa shes dgos so/ /'o na kun rdzob dngos med du song nas bya byed mi 'thad par 'gyur ro snyam na rigs shes kyis ma brtags pa gcig pu ste kho nar bya byed 'thad pas nyams dga' zhing / skye dang 'jig pa'i chos can rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba skyes bu'i 'dod pa'i don byed pa dag nus pa'i gzhi rnams kyi rang bzhin yang dag kun rdzob pa yin pas rtogs par gyis/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar kun rdzob sgrub rim gnyis dang /don dam dgag rim gnyis sogs shes dgos so/ /yang kun rdzob rgyu dang bcas par/ dper na yan lag tshogs rnams la/ /shing rta 196

dbu ma rgyan gyi mchan 'grel/zhesanibyabara'adod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'dod dgos shing /'dod na blo la snang tsam min par 'gyur la/ rgyu med na rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur ro/ /snyam na/ brtags pa ma byas nyams dga' ba'ang / bdag nyid skyed byed kyi rgyu snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma yi 'bras bu rdzun pa sgyu ma sogs kyi dpe de rnams dang 'dra ba 'byung ba yin no/ /de'i phyir kun rdzob tu med pa'am yod na/ rung ba min zhes pa'i dpyod pa'ang legs pa ma yin no/ /gal te kun rdzob 'di yi nye bar len pa'i rgyu yod na/ yang dag par grub pa yin zhe na/ gong du bden grub rigs pas bkag pa la de spong ba'i lan thos shig de ltar na sgra'i tha snyad tsam ma yin par rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dngos po dpyad mi bzod pa 'di nyid yang dag pa'i kun rdzob yin zhes legs par grub bo/ /klan ka spong ba ni/ rigs pas gnod pa chos thams cad rang bzhin med na nam mkha'i me tog ltar mthong thos bye brag phyed pa sogs kyi tha snyad thams cad chad pas grub mtha' dang 'gal lo zhe na/ dgag bya dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ snang tsam min par sdod lugs la ji ltar grub dpyod pa'i don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa'i lam gyi rjes su 'brang bar byas te/197
