rgyan ṭīka rigs lam snang ba/lugs bzang rgyan/ /mi brjed snying gi ze'u 'brur 'dzin gyur cig /ltos bcas blo gsar tshogs kyang rigs lam 'dis/ /mthar 'dzin lta ba'i dbang du mi 'gyur bar/ /tshul khrims dag cing byang chub spyod pa la/ /bdag cag lhan cig spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rgyal bstan snang ba phra ba'i phyogs 'dir yang / /shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs 'chad pa dang / /rtsod dang rtsom pa'i dge 'dun sde 'phel nas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /ces dbu ma rgyan gyi don cung zad bkral ba rigs pa'i lam gyi snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i bdag nyid snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas spros te/ rjebatsun 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang pos dgyes bzhin du rjes su bzung ba'i bka' drin las gzhung lugs du ma thos pa'i skal bzang thob pa shākya'i dge slong 7 blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtshos 'jam mgon bla ma dang rgyal ba chos rje'i zin bris gzhir bzhag rang 'grel dang dka' 'grel la yang go ba ci lon byas nas snyan mo ri rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi chos sde'i rang shag dkon mchog gsum gyi lha khang nas bris pa 'dis kyang phyogs 'dir shing rta chen 335
gas dar zhing rgyas pa'i ldan lha khang du bzhugs
shesab

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ 'gro drug gdul byed par phyin drug /yi ge drug tu shar ba yi/ /lhun grub rgya chen chos kyi sgo/ /gsang sngags zab mo de la 'dud/ /'dir yum don mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyis bkral ba ltar sbas don yi ge drug gi sgo nas rjes su dran pa'i slad du legs par bshad pa'i skabs dbye bar bya ste/as srung ba lo'i byings rkyen nye bar sbyin nas tshangs pa'i yi ge o grub pa ni a u ma gsum kyi bdag nyid de/ de yang a thung ni dgag pa'i tshig tu sgra gzhung dag nas bshad pa bzhin grol ba don gnyer gyis med du mi rung bar dgag par bya ba ni sgro 'dogs kyi 'dzin stangs yin la/ de bkag pa'i don don dam pa ste/ ji skad du sgra gcan 'dzin gyis/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin / /ma skyes ma 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum zhes gsungs pa der gda'/ /'di ni dge sbyong chen po bu ram shing ba de nyid kyi bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bla na med pa dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di na smra ba 'gran zla med pa'i don mthun gyi ston par yongs su bsngags pa'i che ba'i rigs sngags dpag par dka' ba yin te/ 'di nyid ji lta ba bzhin mngon du byas pa'i 338

yig drug sher phyin dang sbyar ba/ byed pa mthar thug pa ni/ thob pa don dam pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos so / /'di ni chos bcus mtshon te shes dgos pas theg pa chen po'i 'jug sgo sems bskyed de gdams don bcu las brtsam pa'i gdams ngag rgya chen mnyan te zab mo blta bar dka' ba sgom byung gi myong ba 'don zhing / de yang sbyang bya rigs bcu gsum sbyong ba la sbyong byed dmigs pa bcu gcig gi sgo nas sgro 'dogs bcad de ched du bya ba chen po gsum gyi ched du zhugs pa'i theg pa chen po'i bsam sbyor dang tshogs gnyis rgya che ba'i sgrub pas srid zhi'i mtha' las nges par 'byung ba'i rgyu las skyes shing de rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pas kun mkhyen du bzhag pa nges par bya'o/ /u ni u pa nye ba'i sgra ste/ /thob bya de dang nye ba'i sgrub pa don dam pa ni / rigs can gsum rjes su 'dzin pa'i byed mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing / theg pa gsum gyi gang zag gi spang rtogs kyi bya ba thams cad byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i sgo nas khyad thon pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rgyal sras bye ba'i lam po che ni lam gsum mkhyen pa yin pas 'di nyid kyis theg pa mchog gi chos kyi sgo dbye bar bya'o/ /'di la ni rgyu 'bras ngo bo'i yan lag lnga dang 339

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ldan pa'i slob ma dang bse ru lta bu'i 'phags lam shes pa dang /theg pa chen po'i 'di phyir phan yon che ba mthong lam dang / sgom pa'i lam la de'i byed pa dang phan yon/ de ldan gyi rjes thob tu gyur ba'i tshogs gnyis 'dum byed mos bsngo rjes su yi rang gsum/mnyam bzhag tu gyur pa'i spang rtogs kyi lag rjes 'jog byed sgrub pa dang rnam dag gnyis te bcu gcig gis ngo bo mtshon par bya'o/ /srung ba'i tshig tu sgrub pa'i ma ning gi ma srog bral ni rang dbang gis brjod du mi btub cing sgra gzhan la sgra'i khyad par gzhan bskyed pas na 'dis mtshon te/ gzhi phung khams skye mched bdag med du shes pa'i mkhyen pa yang rang dbang gis rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes su mi 'gyur zhing lam gzhan la mtha' gnyis spong ba'i khyad par gzhan bskyed pa'i thams cad shes pa rjes su dran par bya stesto/ de la srid pa'i skyon shes de 'khor ba la mi gnas pa dang /dmigs rnam des bskyed de snying rjes zhi mtha' la mi gnas pa dang —/ de yang sher phyin ltar bcos pa min par 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i thabs mkhas pas zin ma zin gyi nye ring gnyis dang / rgyu mtshan des theg pa chen po'i lam gyi mi mthun phyogs dang / de'i gnyen po'i phyogs kyi sher phyin dngos btags 340

yig drug sher phyin dang sbyar ba/gnyis gnyis byas te/ dngos de skyed pa'i sbyor ba mos spyod kyi sar rtogs rigs rjes mthun du sgrub lugs dang / de'i yang sher phyin dngos kyi byed chos zla med pa mnyam nyid kyi 'dzin stangs gal che ba dang / 'bras bu shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' bar bya ba'i mthong lam dang bcas pa'i sgo nas ngo bo dpyis phyin par nges par byas so/ /de lta bu'i shes bya mkhyen pa gsum mtshon pa'i yi ge gsum po grub gzugs gcig tu 'dus pa ni mthar thug gi thob par bya ba blo gros skad cig ma gcig gi bdag nyid du mkhyen pa gsum rdzogs pa'i tshangs pa mi gnas pa'i myang 'das nyid rjes su dran pa'i slad du'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu ni gang nyams su blang bar bya ba'i theg pa mchog gi lam gyi ngo bo ma nor bar nges par byed pa'i tshul rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton pa'i sgo nas 'phags pa mtha' dag gi mkhyen pa gzigs mor bstar ba lags pas shes par byas te nyams len la u thug mi dgos pa zhig mdzad dgos la/ de yang rang gis mtha' gnyis dag par byed pa dang gzhan rigs can gsum rjes su 'dzin pa dang / rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa legs par grub pa gsum las byed rgyu med cing de'i dbang du byas nas nyams su blang bya la thob bya'i 341

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dbang du byas te gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo lam phyin ci ma log pa ston pa'i bdag rkyen med du mi rung ba'i sgo nas bzhed don sgrub byed rnam mkhyen la mdzub mo tshugs pa zhig dang / thob byed kyi dbang du byas te theg pa chen po gzhan don rgya chen po sgrub pa kho na'i rab tu bye ba'i bdag nyid lam gsum shes pa dang / de lta bu'i theg chen yang srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas par byed pa'i shes rab dang snying brtse mchog ni gzhi phung khams skye mched ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'i byed pas 'ong ba dang / sher phyin ltar snang dang yan lag shod pa sogs la rag las pas mkhyen pa 'og ma gnyis bzhag pa yin no/ /de lta na oṃ zhes brjod de theg pa mchog gi lam gyi lus rdzogs nga/ra shar ba'i sgo nas gang zhig nyams su blang bar bya ba la 'jug ngogs ma nor ba nges par byas te 'jug dgos la/ de la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba ni rnam pa bzhi yod la / de yang nges tshig gis sgrub pa'i dbang du byas te ma ni ma na 'jal bar byed pa'i sgra ste/ bshad ma thag pa'i shes bya mkhyen pa gsum po'i rnam pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis shes par byas te nye bar 'jal ba'i rnam kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dran par bya ste/ de yang mi rtag pa'i rnam pa 342

yig drug sher phyin dang sbyar ba/nas sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar brgya dang don gsum sbyor ba nyi shus nyams su blang ba'i yon tan la spro zhing gegs spangs te mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du nyams su blang bas mngon rtogs skye rim thar cha dang / nges cha rim gyis sngon du btang ste phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun du rang nyid legs par bsgrub nas sku gsum gyi sbyor bas 'tshang rgya bar byed pa zhig ni lam gyi lus so/ ṇi ni ṇi ta thob pa la 'jug pas theg pa mchog gi las dang po ba'i skabs rnam pa yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pas rnam pa mtha' dag la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor la dbang thob pas las dang po'i lam gyi rtse mor gyur ba'i sbyor ba mtshon te/ 'di la nges 'byed cha mthun du gyur ba'i drod rtse bzod mchog gi rtse sbyor rtags dang rnam 'phel/ brtan dang sems kun gnas pa rnams rim pas skye zhing / de nas spang bya'i dngos kyi gnyen po byed pa'i mthong sgom gyi rtse sbyor gnyis dang / rnam mkhyen mngon du byed pa la bar chad kyi chos gcig kyang ma lus pa'i slob lam gyi rtse mo'i sbyor ba mthar thug rnams skye zhing / de dag gi skabs su yang bsal bya gal po che bden gnyis 'gal 'dzin gyi log sgrub sel ba nyams len gyi gnad du che ba yin pa bcas shes dgos so/ /de 343

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ltar na dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras gnyis gyi sgo nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len byed pa ni theg pa mchog gi lam gyi snying bo dbyig mchog nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ba las kyang lhag pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo de 'dra'i nor bu zung gcig gi sgo nas theg pa mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag ma ṇi zhes brjod pa'i sgra rtog gi gdangs su khugs pa zhig byung na mkhas shing grub pa lags snyam mo/ /yang pad ni pad rkang ba la 'jug pas rkang bas 'dod pa'i gnas su gom pa rim can du 'degs te 'gro ba bzhin rnam pa mtha' dag sgom pa'i tshe yang go rim bzhin du bklag nas sgom pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba mtshon la/ de la yang bsgom bya rnam pa'i ldog pa nas gzhi lam rnam pa gsum mkhyen pa'i go rim las zur ba med cing / sgom pa'i tshe sgom thabs zin byed kyi cha nas sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus nas bsam gtan shes rab kyi phar phyin drug dang / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun lha dang gtong ba tshul khrims kyi rjes dran drug ldan dang /de dag thams cad kyang gal bo che la nan tan gyis 'khor gsum gyi ngo bo med pa'i ngo bo nyid med rtogs kyi sher phyin khyad par can gyis rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos pa gnad du che ba 344

yig drug sher phyin dang sbyar ba/bcas dran par bya'o/ /me ni phral bas ma la rigs sngags kyi yum gyi ldog pa nas bud med du sgrub pa'i rkyen yī byin pa'i rjes yin zhing —/ ma han mchod pa'i byings dang chen po la 'jug pas rnam pa go rim bzhin du bklag pa'i sgom gyi mthar thug la rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa dang stan gcig thun gcig pa'i sbyor ba nyams len gyi mchog dang chen po'am/ yang na ma ra ya gcod pa dang 'chi bar byed pa'i bskul tshig ltar grangs med gsum gyi bar du gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi dgra sde 'joms pa'i lag len gnad thog tu khel te dngos su gsod pa'i gnyen po'i mthar thug skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba mtshon zhing / sbyor ba 'di la rnam par smin pa ma yin pa ring song man chad kyi nus pa rdzogs pa dang /rnam par smin pa mi g.yo ba sogs gsum gyi nus pa'i rigs mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang / chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis med par rtogs pa dang / yul dang yul can gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba'i ldog pa bzhi gsungs so/ /de ltar na pad+me ni steng 'phyo'i don du sgra gzhung nas bshad pas go rim bzhin du nyams su blang ba'i lag rjes thun mong min pas rtogs pa gong nas gong du 345

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'phyo ba'i byed sgrub kyi sgo nas brtan pa'i rgyu yi sbyor ba dang /sems can gyi sar de phan bogs dbyung du med pa'i cha nas las sgrub kyis steng du 'phyo grub pa'i brtan pa'i 'bras bu ste/ pad+ma zungs gcig gis bstan pa rgyu 'bras kyi nyams len dpyis phyin par ston pa 'di lta bu legs par nges pa'i sgo nas rgyal sras pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i rdzu bag gis 'gro khams gdul ba la zhum pa dang bsnyil ba med pa'i sems dpa' chen po zhes 'bod par yang mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gsungs so/ /des na ma ṇi ni dam chos dbyig brgya'i snying po gces pa theg pa gsum gyi gang zag gi 'dod dgu stsol ba'i dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab kyi nor bu'i ldog pa nas rnam kun gyi sbyor ba rgyu 'bras nye bar mtshon zhing / pad+ma ni myu gu dang sdong bu me tog 'bras bu bcas mthar chags su 'byung ba'i dpes lam la go rim mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyor ba gal che ba'i sgo nas srid pa'i 'dam du skyes kyang dri mas ma gos pa'i thabs kyi pad+ma'i ldog pa nas mthar gyis pa'i nyams len rgyu 'bras mtshon te bzhi bo 'dis nyams len gyi grangs dang go rim nges par byed pa'i tshul la blo gros mchog tu rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar sbyor ba bzhis mkhyen gsum nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin pa ni chos kyi sku 346

yig drug sher phyin dang sbyar ba/yin te/ de ni 'di ltar hu sbyin pa'i byings rkyen gyis tshig tu grub pa'i mchog gi sgra hūṃ gi glu yis mtshon la/ 'di la srog gi ring cha phyi mo gnyis su bgrangs pas yi ge bzhi yod pa ltar mtshon bya nges pa'i don gyi hūṃ yang / ji skad du/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang ske/ /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul ba'i sku/ /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bral ba'i 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang / rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu lhag ma gsum bcas yod do/ /theg pa mchog gis 'gro ba'i skyes bu chen po'i bzhed pa thun mong min pa ni gzhan gyi don rlabs po che yin la/ de nyid bzhed pa bzhin du sbyin pa'i go 'phangs bla na med pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings mngon du byas pa'i tshogs pa la chos kyi sku zhes tha snyad du byas pa de kho na yin te/des longs sprul gnyis kyis dngos su dang / ngo bo nyid dang ye shes chos kyi skus brgyud pas 'khor ba ji srid du 'gro drug gi mgon skyabs rnam par mi rtog bzhin tu mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar yi ge drug gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don mtshon pa ni / mdo sde za ma tog bkod par yi ge drug par phyin drug gi don du bshad pa dang / bka' gdams glegs bam las kyang de bzhin 347

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/du gsungs pas sbyar rung bar shes shing / mdo sde gzhan du yang yi ge re re chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don du rnam par 'grel bar gsungs pa dang / rje btsun gyis/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang / /de rab de yi go rim dang / /de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni/ /don bsdus gzhan de rnam pa drug /ces dbye bsdud 'bring bo'i lugs su gsungs pa dang mthun par bshad bde ba dang / yi ge bsnan pa'i nges tshig gi bshad pa mang po yod pas de ltar bshad chog pas na/ 'phags mchog 'di nyid kyi snying po'i rigs sngags zab mo bzlas brjod kyi tshe theg pa mchog gi lam gyi lus rjes dran gyi sgor dmigs te/ rang gzhan la phan du re nas/ kho kho o su'i sa cha nyams dga' ba nas/ 7 blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i chos med kyi sprang po zhig nges med du 'khyam skabs sug bris byas pa yin no// //348
'i rdzo

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄ / /'jam mgon mkhyen yangs sprin gyi lding khang las/ /'ongs pa'i zab don legs bshad char gyi rgyun/ /bdag blor stsol mdzad 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs/ /byang chub thob kyang mi 'bral gtsug gis mchod/ /mkhas mchog dpal ldan zla ba'i rang lugs la/ /yang log kun rdzob dbye ba med pa'i tshul/ /cung zad 'chad kyis skal bzang grogs po dag /rigs lam legs bshad sgra dbyangs 'dis sgrogs shig /de yang dbu ma la 'jug pa las/gnod pa med pa'i dbang po drug rnams kyis/ /gzung ba gang zhig 'jig rten gyis rtogs te/ /'jig rten nyid las bden yin lhag ma ni/ /'jig rten nyid las log par bzhag /ces byad bzhin dang de'i gzugs brnyan la yang log gi khyad par 'jig rten gyi shes ngo la ltos nas bzhag tu yod kyang spyir de gnyis la yang log gi khyad par bzhag tu med pa'i tshul gsungs te/ de dag gi don 'grel bar lhag mthong chen mo las/ de lta na'ang dbang bo'i shes pa rnams tha snyad du gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i yul rnams rnam par 'jog pa'i tshad mar mi 'thad pa med de/ de rnams la 'khrul bar 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan snang ba ltar gyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub ba'i don med pa ni rang bzhin yod med dpyod pa'i rigs pa'i 350

zla ba'i lugs la yang log med tshul/shes pas 'grub pa yin gyi tha snyad pa'i tshad mas gtan mi 'grub pas tha snyad pa'i shes pa la bltos te 'khrul ba ma yin no/ /zla ba gnyis snang dang / gzugs brnyan la sogs pa snang ba'i shes pa ni snang ba ltar gyi don zla ba gnyis dang byad bzhin la sogs pa med par tha snyad pa'i tshad ma nyid kyis rigs pa'i shes pa la bltos med du 'grub pas na de dag dang snga ma rnams la yang dag dang log pa'i kun rdzob kyi rnam dbye yang 'thad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de yang dbu ma rang lugs la kun rdzob la yang log gi dbye ba 'jog mi rigs te/ kun rdzob yin na snang gnas mi mthun pa'i rdzun pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ de yin na gnas tshod rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pas stong ba la snang tshod rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par snang ba'i bslu ba'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar rigs shes kyis 'grub pa'i phyir te/ lhag mthong chen mo las/ snang ba ltar gyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i don med pa ni rang bzhin yod med dpyod pa'i rigs pa'i shes pas 'grub pa yin/ zhes so/ /'on kyang tha snyad pa'i shes pa rang ga ba'i ngo la bltos te byad dang de'i gzugs brnyan la yang log gi khyad par bzhag tu yod de/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma rang ga ba 351

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/la bltos te byad bzhin dang / de 'dzin pa'i blo gnyis ka yul yul can phyin ci ma log pa dang / de dang de'i gzugs brnyan de 'dzin gyi blo dang bcas pa tha snyad pa'i tshad ma de la bltos te yul dang yul can phyin ci log tu 'grub pa'i phyir te/ byad dang de'i gzugs brnyan gnyis ka byad bzhin du snang bas 'dra yang snang ba ltar du byad bzhin dngos gnas par grub ma grub kyi khyad par 'jig rten na grags pa'i phyir/ lhag mthong chen mo gong du drangs par / tha snyad pa'i tshad ma gzhan mi 'grub pas tha snyad pa'i shes pa la bltos te 'khrul ba ma yin no/ /zhes 'jig rten shes ngo la yang dag kun rdzob 'jog tshul dang / tha snyad pa'i tshad ma nyid kyis rigs pa'i shes pa la bltos med du 'grub pas/ zhes 'jig rten gyi shes ngo la bltos te log pa'i kun rdzob 'jog tshul gsungs so / /don 'di dag kyang / 'jig rten nyid las bden yin zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yang log gi khyad par 'jig rten pa'i tshad ma de kho na nyid la blo kha ma phyogs pa'i shes pa rang ga ba rnams kyi 'dzin stangs la bltos te phyin ci log tu 'grub mi 'grub kho na'i dbang gis de ltar bzhag gi spyir kun rdzob la bden rdzun dbyer med do/ /skabs 'dir tha snyad tshad mas yang dag kun rdzob 'grub 352

zla ba'i lugs la yang log med tshul/par mi smra ste yang dag kun rdzob gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ de lta na'ang tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i shes ngo la bltos te yang dag kun rdzob bzhag chog pa yin te/ bum pa bum 'dzin tshad ma rang ga ba'i shes ngo de la bltos te snang ba ltar du ma grub pa'i rdzun pa dang phyin ci log tu 'jog mi nus pa'i phyir dang / tha snyad tshad ma de kho na nyid la blo kha ma phyogs pa'i shes pa rang ga ba'i ngo la bltos te ma 'khrul bar ma grub pas ma 'khrul bar grub mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i shes ngo la bltos te 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i dbang po drug yul dang bcas pa phyin ci ma log pa'i kun rdzob yin te/ lhag mthong chen mor/ de ltar yul de gnyis la tha snyad pa'i shes pa la bltos te bden rdzun 'thad pa bzhin du yul yul can gnyis kyang tha snyad pa'i shes pa la bltos te phyin ci log ma log 'thad pa yin no zhes gsungs so// //353
jusprub

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sto /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la zhu 'phrin du gsol ba ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gzhon nu'i sku/ /nyin byed 'char kha'i mdangs la 'gran bzhin du/ /rmongs mun gcod pa'i ral gri'i phyag rgya can/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bla ma rgyal gyur cig /mtha' 'khob bas mtha'i gnas shig na/ /gtsug lag khang chung bre zhabs tsam/ /rnam rgyal dge ldan bya ba der/ /sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs dpon tshul/ /ltar snang dge sbyong sha tshugs can//dha rma snaraḥzhes bya ba/ /thub bstan snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus/ /mar 'grib mun pa'i rum zhig tu/ /las ngan rlung gis 'phangs pa'i tshe/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu bshes gnyen tshul/ /'dzin pa de yis rjes bzung ste/ /dam chos gru char legs phab kyang / /mi srun yid kyi zhing sa nyid/ /ma dul tha mal lus pa'i skabs/ /rtag 'dzin gdon gyis bshol bshol nas/ /zab dang rgya che'i lus 'dzin pa'i/ /theg mchog chos kyi go yul gyi/ /rtogs pa zhu ba ma byung bas/ /phu thag chod pa med gyur cing / /da lta yul dus gnas skabs 'dir/ /theg pa mchog gi gtam gleng ba'i/ /dge ba'i 356

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/bshes dang grogs bral te/ /gcig phur rang gi gdong ba la/ /'dzub mo btsugs pa'i skyo ba'i glu/ /kun tu gzigs pa thogs med pa'i / /rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ /dman la gzigs pa 'bab snyam ste/ /zhu phrin tshul gyis 'di skad gsol/ /kha ba can gyi yul 'di ru/ /lo paṇa grub thob ngo mtshar bas/ /rang rang gdul bya la dgongs te/ /drangs pa'i chos lugs rnying ma dang / /bka' brgyud sa skya jo nang sogs/ /kun kyang thub pa'i ring lugs dang / /gdul bya bkri ba'i thabs yin zhes/ /kun la dad gus sbyong ba lags / /de las rang gi 'jug ngogs ni/ /bstan pa spyi yi dbang byas la/ /thub pa'i lugs bzang yongs rdzogs pa/ /bka' gdams gsar rnying 'di yin snyam/ /kun nas dad pa'i me tog phreng / /chos brgyud de la legs phul te/ /rnam thar gtsang ma'i pha phogs kyi / /cha shas 'dzin la bdag spro ste/ /yul dus sa phyogs pha mes rabs / /sngon gyi lugs srol 'di yin zhes/ /u tshugs byed mkhan mang na yang / /de ko blun pa ma lags sam/ /rgyal ba sras bcas las 'ongs pa'i/ /dam chos gdung sel bdud rtsi'i chab/ /'dren mdzad bshes gnyen yur ba che/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi/ /rtsa bzang yang yang bsngags pa dang / /khyad par theg 357

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i go rim bzhin/ /ji ltar blta dang ji ltar bsten/ /rim pas zab la 'phrigs tshud de/ /'dul bar bla ma mkhan slob la/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni 'du shes dang / /phyir na theg pa thun mong du/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sprul ba dang / /rdo rje theg pa thun min lugs/ /sangs rgyas bla ma'i sprul ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor gtso dang rigs drug pa / /bla ma las gzhan med lags sam/ /khyad par rdo rje theg pa 'di'i / /shwa lo ka zhig gnang ba tshun/ /rdo rje slob dpon chen po zhes / /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor gsungs/ /de la rdo rje mi phyed pa//thogs pa med pa'i don can gyi/ /theg pa bla na med pa 'dis/ /bkri bas de skad brjod lags sam/ /rgyal ba rnams kyang sems can kun/ /go 'phang mchog la dgod pa yi/ /bya ba gcig tu zhugs pa la/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus zer lags sam/ /mdo dang rgyud kyi dbye ba dang / /de bzhin de yi brjod bya'i don/ /rnam mang gang du gzhol ba'i yul/ /mthar thug don dam byang chub sems/ /sku dang ye shes mi phyed pa/ /thog med nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can/ /zung 'jug zhes byar grags pa yi/ /don 'di nges don rdo rje ste/ /de la gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i cha/ /gang gis bzhag ba'i bden 'dzin blo/ /dag pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya che/ /spros med 'di lta'i 358

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/'jug dgos sam/ /spros med de la bde chen gyi/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa sngar med pa/ /bskyed de de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /bsad par bya ba ma yin nam/ /sgyu ma gang gis bskrun pa'i sngags/ /snying ga'i rde'u mi shigs par/ /btab pas sems kyi bzhon pa ni/ /bsdus te bem rig bral dgos sam/ /sdud byed la ni thun min lam / /nyi khri tshig stong khyab byed rlung / /rdo rje gsum gyi gdangs nyid du/ /bkug pa'i bzlas brjod dgos lags sam/ /de la byang sems zhu ba las/ /byung ba'i bde chen stong sbyar ba/ /rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gcig pa'i/ /ma bcos rnal 'byor dgos lags sam / /ma bcos pa la bcos ma yi/ /da lta nyid nas sku gsum du/ /bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo las/ /rang rgyud smin pa gces lags sam/ /'di la gdul bya'i blo rim gyis/ /zab gsal gnyis med thun mong dang / /thun mong min pa yongs 'byed pa'i/ /rgyud sde'i rnam grangs gsungs lags sam/ /de ltar sku gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ru/ /dngos su ldang ba'i sems mchog bla med pa/ /don gnyis gnyis ldan theg chen chos kyi sgo/ /rin chen byang chub sems 'di yin nam ci/ /yod na des chog rlabs chen tshogs sdud la / /med na thabs chag theg chen gzhi stor bas/ /rgyal ba sras 359

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bcas kun gyi thugs dam mthil/ /sems mchog 'di 'dra ngo mtshar che lags sam/ /grangs med tshogs dang sku gsum yon tan cha / /'phrin las 'jig rten bde legs ci mchis pa/ /skyed byed 'dod dgu'i gnyen gcig rin chen sems/ /'di nyid kho na gtso bor 'dzin dgos sam/ /sems mchog 'di la thabs kyi ni/ /yan lag skyes bu chung 'bring gi /chos skor dang ni thun mong ba'i/ /lam gyi rim pa gnyis yod dam/ /'di yis sgrib pa spong ba'i grogs / /shes rab kyi ni yan lag tu/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i 'o ma'i rgyun/ /lung dang rigs pas bsrubs pa las/ /byung ba'i dmigs gtad bshig pa'i blo/ /rang bzhin med pa rtogs pa'i mar / /spros pa'i zug ngu gcod pa'i sman/ /shes rab phar phyin dgos lags sam/ /de yang da lta gang snang ba'i/ /chos 'di rnams la dpyad pa'i tshe/ /rnyed du btub pa ma yin pas/ /yul gyi ngos nas gzhal ba na/ /gang yang med la gang yang min/ /thogs med nam mkha' stong ba bzhin/ /dmigs pa'i gtad so mi 'dug pa / /gnas lugs 'jal ba yin nam lags/ /'jog sa gang yang mi 'dug kyang / /ming rkyang kho nas par bzhag pa'i/ /nga khyod 'khor 'das la sogs pa/ /ma brtag rang gar 'jog lags sam//360

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/de 'dra'i rnam bzhag tsam po 'dir/ /rgyu yis 'bras bu skyed pa sogs / /tha snyad chos kyi spu ris kun/ /bslu med nges shes 'drong dgos sam/ /gang zhig bsgrub dang gang gis legs bsgrub ste/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis char sdud byed pa'i/ /lam mchog rin chen sems gtso 'di kho nas/ /mngon par 'gro la rgyal sras zer ram lags / /phyi ma dang ni thar ba la/ /don gnyer bsam pas gzhi byas te/ /skyabs 'gro tshul khrims sogs kyi rkyen/ /'tshogs pas rin chen sems skye la/ /gsang sngags bla na med pa yi/ /lam gyi snying po bde ba che/ /thun mong thun mong min pa yi/ thabs kyis bsgrub pa'i 'od gsal sems/ /gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i g.ya' 'dzin pa'i/ /rags sems glo bur ba yi khams/ /sbyong byed kun rtog phra ba'i lam/ /gnyis sprod chags pa'i bde ba ni/ /lam du byed pa las 'ongs pas/ /rgyu ming 'bras bu la 'chags pa/ /'di ni rin chen sems kyi rgyud/ /shin tu byi dor gyis sbyangs pas/ /gnas skabs mchog tu gyur ba ste/ /dngos su rdzogs byang nyid du ni / /bzhengs pas rgyu 'bras mi phyed pas/ /rdo rje theg par brjod lags sam/ /de ltar byas na lam gyi gtso bo dang / /de yi yan lag phal ba dmigs phyed de/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa kun tshang ma nor 361

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ba'i / /snyan brgyud man ngag yin snyam yin nam ci/ /a ti sha dang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi/ /lugs bzang che ba bzhi ldan ngo mtshar bar / /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal pos bsngags pa'i srol/ /'di ltar yin nam rje btsun masmo pa'i gter/ /dbu phar gzhung dang brgyud pa'i man ngag dang / /mdo sngags rnam grangs gang yang nyan sems kyang / /gnad don byang chub sems 'di kho na ru/ /'bab par go 'di rnam dag yin nam ci/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i skabasal/ /dngos grub gnyis kyi gzhir gyur ba'i/ /lam srog dam tshig bsrung dgos zhes/ /nan tan gdams pa yid la 'khums/ /de ltar byas na rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len kun / /thun res kyang ni bskyangs pa yis/ /dal rten don ldan 'gyur lags sam/ /grangs tsam lhur len bzlas brjod dang / /rgyal khams nyul pa'i gnas bskor dang / /ltar snang chos brdzu'i dge sbyor gyis/ /bsgrun du yod med ji ltar lags/ /lam gyi ngo bo nor ba dang / /grangs la chad lhag phyogs re ba/ /gang zin go rim med pa sogs/ /mngon par rtogs pa skye ba'i gegs/ /yin zhes bka' dang dgongs 'grel kun/ /gcig tu mthun par gsungs pas na/ /'di ltar mdzad na bde blag tu/ /rtogs pa 'khrungs pa 362

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/yin lags sam/ /thog mar gser ni bsgrub pa bzhin/ /par phyin theg pa'i sta gon gyis/ /de la rgyan bcos pa bzhin du/ /rdzogs byang sbyangs pa sngags kyi tshul/ /stan thog gcig gi nyams len du/ /'dum pa'i dge ldan snyan brgyud lugs/ /'di la kho bo ches spro bas / /yang yang smon gnas byed pa lags/ /ji skad gsol ba 'di dag kun/ /thub pa'i ring lugs dri med bstan/ /yin na slar yang nges shes sgo/ /dbyar gyi chu bzhin stsal du gsol/ /'di la blo skyon gyis sbags pa/ /gang mchis khyod kyi byin rlabs las/ /nyi mas mun stug bsal ba bzhin/ /myur du sel bar mdzad du gsol / /khyod ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen rab phung bo lhag pa'i lhar/ /bzhengs te 'gro ba'i gti mug mun/ /bsal ba'i byed por bsngags gyur na/ /bdag ni mi srun mtha' 'khob tu/ /skyes te lam ston bshes bral bas/ /shin tu nyam thag tshul dgongs la/ /byin rlabs phyag byas dbugs 'byin mdzod/ /de skad rje btsun mchog gi spyan snga ru/ /gsol ba'i zhu 'phrin ut+pal la yi phreng / /blo gsal 'bum gyi mgul ba'i rgyan gyur te/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa ring du rgyas gyur cig /ces rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la zhu 'phrin du gsol ba ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa mañju'i mtshan can gyis bka' drin chen pos rjes su bzung ba las/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab spyi dang bye brag dge ldan snyan 363
brgyud kyi man ngag la dad pa cung zad rgyas pa'i dge stong gi gzugs brnyan 7 snyam sā ra zhes bya bas rang gi go yul rje btsun la zhu 'phrin gyis bsgrigs pa dge lags 'phel/ /

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/༄/ /gzhi gsum phyag len gyi nyer mkho dus tshigs ngos 'dzin sogs/༄gyi/ /bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir gzhi gsum gyi phyag len la nye bar mkho ba'i 'dul mngon gyi dus tshigs ngos 'dzin nyung bsdus 'god pa la/ gangs can 'dir 'dul 'dzin mkhas pa snga phyi bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang ring lugs rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzhes dngos gtsang 'khrul med ltar 'dul 'dzin rin po ches mdzad pa'i gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i rjes su 'brangs te rnam par 'god na/ de nyid las/smin drug zla ba'i yar ngo ston zla tha chung gi tshes bco lngas lo snga ma rdzogs pa yin pas/ de'i bcu drug nas lo gsar ba'i mgo 'dzin pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bod rgyal lo'i lugs kyi zla ba'i ming gi tha snyad kyis rab 'bring tha gsum dang bstun pa'i ston tha'i tshes bcu drug nas lo mgo 'dzin zhing / dus 'khor ba'i lugs la zla ba 'di nyid dgun ra ba yin pas ra 'bring tha gsum gyi 'jog tshul gnyis dang / de phyir dgun ra ba 'jam mgon tsong kha ba sogs 'dul 'dzin phyi ma'i lo mgor bzhed ces pa'i re'u mig 365

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang yang mi 'gal ba shes dgos la/ hor lugs dgun zla tha chung zla ba dang por byas pa'i bcu ba'i tshes bcu drug yin no/ /de ltar yin te/ mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ bdag gi rgyu skar smin drug brjod / /zla ba nya tshe zla rangs 'gyur/ /ston zla tha chung zhes bya ba/ /'di ni rab tu brjod pa yin/ /zhes dang / 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi dus kyi dang po ni dgun dag yin la/ zhes gsungs shing de ltar dus kyi dang po dgun nas brtsams pa'i tshe ston zla tha chung smin drug gis nya ba'i zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig lo mgor shugs kyis 'grub ste/ de nyid las/ zla ba thams cad kyi mar gyi ngo snga ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skyed tshal mkhan po dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'dul ba'i mtha' dpyod las/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa dang /'chi med mdzod kyi lugs bzhin mgo zla ba nas lo mgo 'dzin par bzhed pa dang yang mi 'gal te/ ston tha chung gi tshes bcu drug de mar ngo sngon 'gro'i mgo zla'i tshes gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dgun zla ra ba mgo zla yin pa sogs nyi snang bu yig shog khra sogs su gsal ba bzhin yin pa gang zhig skar ma'i dbang gis mar ngo sngon 'gro yin pa'i phyir/ cho ga las/ spyir lo gcig gi zla ba bcu 366

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/gnyis po thams cad skar ma'i dbang gis mar ngo sngon 'gro yin te/zhes sogs lo mgo 'dzin tshul 'di nyid yongs 'dzin rin po ches mdzad pa'i gzhi gsum gsal byed dang yang shin tu 'grigs te/de nyid las/ smin drug zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas lo mgo 'dzin cing dgun gyi mgo tshugs zhes gsungs/ zla ba bcu ba'i tshes brgyad la bkra shis kyi gso sbyong bya ba yin na/ tshe dang ldan pa dag sang gi skya rengs shar ba na ston gyi zla ba gcig dang zhag nyi shu rtsa gsum 'das shing / lhag ma zhag bdun slad du lus so/ /zhes brjod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de nyid las/shol zla'i dus brjod tshul ni/ dgun gyi dus su zla lhag byung na ston zla tha chung dag gi mar ngo la/ tshe dang ldan pa dag sang gi skya rengs shar ba na dgun rnams kyi shol dang bcas pa'i zla ba phyed ni 'das so/ /zla ba phyed dang gsum ni lus so/ /zhes pa lta bu brjod pas rung ba 'dra zhing / zhes kyang gsungs shing tshig de dag 'dul 'dzin rin po che'i cho ga'i tshig ris ji lta ba bzhin bkod 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /mgo zla nas 'dzin pa'i lugs la yar ngo sngon 'gro'i mgo zla'i mar ngo nas lo mgo bzung na yang shin tu mi 'grigs te/ de nas brtsis pa'i dgun dpyid kyi zla ba brgyad 367

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rdzogs pa'i 'og gi dbyar tsam gyi zla ba yongs grags stag zla'i bcu drug nas 'dzin dgos pa gang zhig de lta na dbyar snga ma khas len pa'i dus/ mdo rtsar/ dbyar gnas par khas blang bar bya'o/ /tshes bcu drug la'o/ /dbyar zla 'bring bo'i nya'i phyi de nyin par ro//zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ dbyar tha chung gi nya'i phyi de nyin par ro/ /zhes gsungs rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /byas pa la/de mar sngon 'gro'i dbang du byas tshe dbyar 'bring gi nya stag zla'i bco lnga la thug pas skyon med do zhe na yang / mi 'thad de/ 'dul mtha' las/ sa dge'i mkhas mang spyi dang / 'dul 'dzin yongs grags kyi hor zla bcu ba'i mar ngo nas lo mgo dang dgun dus kyi dang po 'dzin zhes gsungs shing / cho ga las kyang / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam gyi gnad mtha' dag par thugs su chud nas skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la tshul bzhin du 'doms pa'i chos kyi rje blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi phyag len ltar/ zhes gsungs pas rje btsun tsong kha ba yab sras sa dge'i mkhas mang gi gral du bzhugs min la dogs pa mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang bcu ba dgun zla ra ba la byed snyam na yang mi 'grigs te/ de ltar na khyed 368

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/rang gi lo mgo rgyal zla ba nas 'dzin rigs par thal ba'i phyir te/dgun ra ba'i tshes bcu drug de mar ngo sngon 'gro'i rgyal zla'i tshes bcu drug yin zhing / lo mgo dgun dang / zla mgo mar ngo nas 'dzin pa la bston mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mi 'grigs te / de ltar na ra 'bring tha gsum mar ngo sngon 'gro byas te 'jog dgos shing / nya skar gyi zla ba dag yar ngo sngon 'gros 'jog par 'gyur na/ cho ga las/ de ltar skar ma'i dbang gis mar ngo sngon 'gro ra ba tha chung gi dbang gis yar ngo sngon 'gror byas na lung de gnyis don la mi mthun pa med par legs par bshad par 'gyur ro / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na khyod rang la/ lo mgo dgun ra'i mar ngo nas 'dzin par thal/ mgo zla ba'i mar ngo nas 'dzin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ de bzhin du/ lo drir/ rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga bcas/ /chu stod khrums smad smin drug bcas/ /'di rnams kyi ni nag po'i phyogs/ /zla phyed gso sbyong bcu bzhi ba/ /zhes dang /lo drir/ dgun 'bring / dpyid ra dpyid tha/ dbyar 'bring /ston ra ston tha drug gi mar ngo mi thub par bshad na/ khyod la mgo mchu nag snon gro sbyin tha skar rnams mi thub dang / dgun ra dgun tha/ dpyid 'bring / dbyar ra dbyar tha/ ston 'bring rnams 369

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bcu bzhi bar thal lo zhe na yang skyon med de/ yar ngo sngon 'gro'i zla ba de dang de'i mar phyogs la thug kyang de ltar gsungs pa ni/skar dbang mar ngo sngon 'gro byas na mi mthun pa med par gong du drangs ma thag pa'i cho ga'i lung de'i phyir/ gzhan yang rgyal zla'i mar ngo bcu bzhi bar gsungs pa de yar ngo sngon 'gro'i mgo zla'i mar ngo'i nyer dgu ru grub ste/ mdo rtsa'i rgya cher 'grel dang /bam po lnga bcu bar ra ba tha chung gi dbang du byas pa'i gso sbyong mi thub pa ngos 'dzin pa'i skabs su/ dbyar dgun 'bring thub/ston dpyid 'bring mi thub par gsungs/ zhes cho ga las 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rgyal zla sogs kyi bcu bzhi ba de mar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbang du byed dgos pa dang / dge slong gi lo drir/ dgun 'bring sogs kyi mar ngor bcu bzhi ba gsungs pa yang mar ngo sngon 'gro byas pa'i rgyal zla dgun 'bring du bzhag pa tsam yin no/ /de ltar min na rgya cher 'grel dang bam po gnyis dang 'gal zhing /mdzod rang 'grel du/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi/ /zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das shing / /zla ba phyed ni lus pa na/ /mkhas pas zhag mi thub pa dor/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ dgun zla ba gnyis song zin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal 370

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/srid mi 'gro ste/ dgun ra ba'i tshes bcu drug nas lo mgo bzung ba'i zla ba phyed gnyis kyi mtshams yin no zhe na/ kha ba can 'dir chos gos gsum dras drub yan chad kyi rtags cha lugs nas bzung bstan rtsa 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi nyams len gzhir slong mdzad pas rgyal ba gnyis par sa gsum na grags pa'i chos rje tsong kha ba yab sras kyi phyag bzhes kho nas chog pa ni/ ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i dbang po gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis nyin bzhin gdams pa yis/ /blo bzang rgyal ba yis kyang ma thon pa'i/ /gsar bshad phra men ma yis so nam 'dis/ /phan las gnod pa che bas sgrims shig ang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zhes rang gi blo ngor nges pa'i ched/ 7 rtarma sā ras ba yan sgar du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dze/dben gnas dang lamarim zung 'jug tu smon lam bya ba bzang po'i bag chags 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med shākya'i gtso//snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /phrin las myur ma dpa' mo 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /bdag gi bsam don 'grub pa'i byin rlabs stsol/ /yid 'ong dri bsung mngar po'i rdzi 'thul bas/ /rkang drug tshogs rnams myos pa'i glu len zhing / /sna tshogs me tog 'khrigs pa'i ne'u sing ljongs/ /skye bo'i rgyu 'grul med pa'i gnas rnams su/ /theg mchog sgrub pa snying bor byed pa yis / /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par shog /dwangs bsil yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo'i 'gram/ /ngang ba khrung khrung ngur ba mthing ril sogs/ /bya tshogs bag phebs skad snyan 'byin pa'i gnas / /nyams dga' gud yangs chu shing 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /theg mchog sgrub pa snying bor byed pa yis/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par shog /be+eḍūr khu ba 'khyil 'dra'i sngo ljang mtsho/ /gser mig bkra ba'i nya tshogs rab 'phyo bzhin/ /nyer nyer rlung 372

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/gis bskyod pa'i rlabs phreng gis/ /wu ba dkar bo gsog pa'i gling yangs por/ /theg mchog sgrub pa snying bor byed pa yis/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par shog /phan tshun yal ga sbrel ba'i 'khri shing tshogs/ /kun tu 'khrigs par 'jol mo khu byug sogs/ /nags kyi bya tshogs snyan pa'i skad sgrog pa'i/ /drang srong gnas mchog zhi ba'i nags rnams su/ /theg mchog sgrub pa snying bor byed pa yis/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par shog /rang byung brag dmar spo mtho brtsegs pa'i ngos/ /bya rgyal lding zhing lug pas hung sgra'i gtam/ /rgyun chad med pa'i brag skyibs khod yangs por//bdag med rang shong rdo yi spyil bu ru/ /theg mchog sgrub pa snying bor byed pa yis/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par shog /rtse mo na bun dkar pos rab g.yogs shing / /lhung lhung phu chu chad med 'bab pa yi/ /rab mtho lhun stug rdza ri smug po'i mgul/ /ri dwags tshogs kyi rtsed bro 'khrab pa ru/ /theg mchog sgrub pa snying bor byed pa yis/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par shog /tsha ba'i gdung med ngang gis bsil ba yis/ /byings pa sel zhing rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng ba dngar ba'i stongs / /'du 'dzi bral bas bsam gtan 'phel ba ru/ /theg 373

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mchog bde lta'i dben pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa'i bste gnas su/ /chos gos gnas mal rnyed bkur ngan ngon gyis/ /chog shes 'dod pa chung dang spong sgom la / /dga' ba'i 'phags pa'i rigs bzhir gnas nas ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang thabs mkhas gsum ldan gyis/ /theg mchog sgrub pa snying bor byed pa yis/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par shog /ces dben pa'i gnas dang theg pa chen po'i lam rim zung du 'jug pa'i zung 'jug rin po che la smon lam du bya ba bzang po'i bag chags 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'di ni/ mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin ste/ /'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas / /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i bden pa chud mi za bar bsam te rang gi rgyud la theg pa chen po'i lam gyi bag chags cung zad re'ang theb na ci ma rung snyam du dga' spro dang bcas te dal 'byor la snying po len pa'i ched du/dharma sā ra zhes bya bas gsang bdag mi yi zol du bzhugs pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba'i dga' tshal du bsgrigs pa yin pas de bzhin tu 'grub par bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis byin gyis 374

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /༄ / /'gres byang gang 'dod/ theg mchog bshes gnyen sangs rgyas kun dngos su/ /bsgom nas tshogs gsog byin rlabs bskul bar bya/ /dal 'byor rten la don che rnyed dka'i blos/ /sgrub pa snying por byed la spro bar bya/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i 'du shes shugs drag gis/ /zin med 'di snang bya ba kun bor te/ /ngan song sdug bsngal mthong nas mi bzod blos/ /yang nas yang du yid ches drag po yis/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing ske/ /de yi bslab byar slob cing dge sdig gi /las 'bras mi bslur nges pa bskyed nas ni/ /phun tshogs mngon mtho'i rten bzang sgrub par bya/ /srid gsum sdug bsngal 'bar ba'i mes gdungs pa'i/ /gnas ngan nyer len phung bo'i khur 'di la/ /shugs drag skyo ba bskyed nas thar 'dod blos/ /bslab gsum spyi dang tshul khrims gtsang bar bya/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba drin chen mar shes nas/ /drin gzo'i sems kyi byams dang snying rje yis/ /bde sdug khur du 'khyer 'dod rab bskyed de/ /byang chub sems kyi go cha bgo bar bya/ /gtong sems spel zhing bsrung sems bskyed pa dang ske/ /mi 'khrugs sems dang dge la spro ba'i sems/ /rtse gcig 375

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa dang rnam 'byed blo rnams kyis/ /rang rgyud smin bya bsdu bzhis bsdu bar bya/ /khyad par ting 'dzin tshogs rnams tshang pa yis/ /byings rgod zhi ba'i sems gnas brtan po'i rtar/ /g.yo med bskyon pa'i lhag mthong skyes bu yis/ /so sor rtog pa'i nges shes rgyas par bya/ /snang yang snang tsam de yang mi rnyed cing / /stong yang stong pa bying chad ma yin par/ /tha snyad pir gyis bris pa tsam zhig tu / /btags yod shes bya'i ltad mo blta bar bya/ /'am yang na shog /ces gong ma rnam la'ang rigs 'gres/ yang na/ theg mchog bshes la dad gus rtse gcig pas/ /dal 'byor don che rnyed dka'i 'du shes kyis/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang / khyad par byang chub sems gnyis bsgom par bya/ /'am yang na shog gang bder sbyar ro/ /theg mchog bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i sgos/ /thun mong lam dang thun min bskyed rim gyis/ /yongs smin gsang chen lam mchog rim pa lngas/ /tshe 'dir sgyu 'od zung 'jug bsgrub bar bya/ /'am yang na/ 'grub par shog gang bder sbyar ro/ /yang ske/ theg mchog bla mar mos gus shugs drag sgos/ /sngon 'gro theg brgyad lam gyis rgyud btul nas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor chen po'i rang babs kyis/ /ye shes bla ma'i sa mchog thob par shog /376

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/gam yang na bya zhes sbyar ro/ /༄/ /na mo gu ru mañju sgo ṣā ya/ /gang zhig mos pa'i rdzing bu la / /byin rlabs 'od dkar mi brnyel ba'i/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dbyangs kye/ /'dir yang blo gros mchog sbyin mdzod/ /'jam pa'i dpal de'i tha mal 'gro khams la/ /gang 'tshams sprul ba'i rol ba mi 'gog pa'i/ /smon lam dus su smin pa'i chos kyi rje//yab gcig blo gros mtshan mnga' de la 'dud/ /rigs gzhung blo gros 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i rtser/ /mngon rtogs sbrang rtsis dud pa ma mthong nas/ /chos spang g.yang sar lceb pa'i skal ngan la/ /lung rigs lcags kyi rnon po 'di ltar 'debs/ /de yang kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir mkhas grub gnam gyi skar tshogs lta bu rim par byon pa'i nang na rgyal ba'i lung gis zin cing bstan pa la bka' drin shin tu che ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang po bdag nyid chen po rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i rigs gzhung rnams bsgyur bshad spel ba la bsten nas grub mtha' ris med pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag gis blo gros kyis snyim par bzung ste chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs len pa ni ded dpon mkhas pas rin po 377

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/che'i gling du khrid pa'i tshong phrug nor bu len pa la rings pa bzhin tu gyur to zhes mkhas pa rnams la grags so/ /de lta na yang dus kyi dbang gis skye bo'i blo'i mthu khad kyis 'grib na rigs pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgyas pa rgya mtsho lta bu la 'jug pa'i thog mar rgyal slob pa ltar mdo sems thun mong gi rnam bzhag gzhir byas te blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs par byed pa'i rigs pa'i lam bzang po ston pa'i gzhung bsdus gzhung du grags pa 'di nyid mkhas pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis mdzad de/ skal bzang gi gdul bya dpag tu med pa zhig gsung rab kyi gnas zab mo la dpyod pa'i blo mig ches cher rgyas par gyur ba ni mngon sum lags so/ /de lta na'ang da lta yul dus kyi dbang gis mngon sum gyi gnas rags pa 'di 'dra la yang rmongs pa'i blun po mkhas par brdzus te rigs gzhung 'di nyid sun 'byin pa dang / blun po blun po'i lugs kyi gti mug kho nas rigs gzhung spong bar byed de chos spong gi las ngan gsog pa'i rigs gnyis shig phyogs 'di na snang bas re zhig dang po'i dbang du byas te bshad par bya'o/ /de la gang zhig thos par bya ba dang / de bzhin du bsam sgom bya ba'i gnas rnams nyams len gyi dbang du byas pa zhig dgos par 'dod pa ni legs/378

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/bsdus gzhung 'di lta bu nyams su blang bya min no snyam pa ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi tshig dang don la rgyus med pa'i dbang gis blo phyin ci log tu gol ba'i log rtog yin te/ nged cag nyams len zer ba de nyams su blang bya rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi tshig don la byed na khyed byed dam mi byed/ mi byed na 'u cag ston pa dang /des bstan pa'i chos lugs mi gcig par song bas khyi dang lug gnyis kha zas gang yin rtsad rgyu med pa bzhin no/ /byed na rgyal ba la bskal ba bzang bo 'di la rnam 'dren stong yod pa las gsum ni mya ngan las 'das shing gsung rab kyang mi bzhugs/ byams pa nas mos pa'i bar ni da dung ma byon pas rnam 'dren bzhi ba shākya seṅge 'di la nged rnams bdag cag gi ston pa zhes mdzub mo 'dzugs pa yin na khyed de ltar yin nam min/ min na 'u cag ston pa mi gcig par song la/ yin na ston pa 'dis chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor ba'i/ dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor de thar ba tsam dang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis char sgrub pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bden bzhi 'jug ldog gi lam ston pa'i thun mong ba'i sde snod dang / phyi ma gnyis thun mong min pa'i theg pa chen po'i sde snod du ngos bzung nas/ g.yag zhar gyi rtswa za stangs 379

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ltar phyogs res tsam min pa gnyis ka nyams su len dgos par 'dod na khyed de ltar 'dod dam mi 'dod/ 'dod na/ 'khor lo dang po'i bstan don nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar sdug bsngal du shes par byas te/ de'i rtsa ba rgyu kun 'byung las nyon gnyis su thag bcad de spong nus su mthong nas/ de spangs pa'i 'gog pa mngon du byed 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi bsam pas drangs te/ lam gyi bden pa'i nyams len lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che gdul bya'i rgyud la bsten pa zhig la nged rnams 'dod na/ khyed de ltar 'dod dam mi 'dod/ 'dod na bslab pa gsum de rang rgyud la bskyed tshul ni/ rim pa bzhin tu lhag pa tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab rnams gtso bor ston pa'i 'dul ba dang / mdo sde dang / mngon pa'i sde snod gsum la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis zhugs te bskyed rgyu yin par nged cag 'dod na khyed de 'dod dam mi 'dod/'dod na/ de tshe nged cag bsdus gzhung 'di nyid mngon pa'i sde snod du ngos bzung nas 'di las bslab gsum spyi dang bye brag lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa zhig rnyed du re nas kha mig sa rdul gyis 'tshang bzhin rlung dmar 'gam te lag pa rdol rdol du thal mo deb 380

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/rgyu zhig byung na ma la bu skyes go chod par brtsi ba 'di shes par gyis la 'thad mi 'thad rtogs shig kho na re/ mngon pa'i sde snod gzhan yang yod na bsdus grwa gcig pu la mgo 'khor ci dgos zhe na / kho bo cag ni mngon pa'i sde snod ni bsdus grwa 'di kho na'o mi zer gyis/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyis lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rtsal du 'don lugs ni/ shes rab kyi yul rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gtan la dbab te shes rab skyed pa yin la/ shes byar spyi'i mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa la yang dag pa'i rigs lam phra mos phu thag chod par gtan la phab ste dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang du sgrub pa'i tshul gyis mngon pa'i gzhung lugs gzhan las khyad thon pa ni rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa yin la/ blo gsar bu la rigs gzhung de dag gi sgo thog mar 'byed pa'i lde'u mig tu med mi rung ba yin zhes nged cag bsdus gzhung la yid smon byed pa yin gyis kha shags 'gyed pa'i ched du min pas gzhan gyis kyang skyon 'dog pa'i dogs pa mi dgos la/ rang res kyang dgos pa nor du mi rung ngo //yang kho na re/ bsdus gzhung 'di la bsten nas shes rab bskyed tshul dang shes rab de lhag pa'i shes rab kyi bslab par song nas 381

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nyams len du 'gyur lugs brjod par gyis shig ce na/ bsdus grwa 'di la rigs lam che 'bring chung gsum gdul bya'i blo tshod la dpag de rim gyis dkri ba'i ched du gsungs la/ mdor bsdu na/mngon pa mdzod las/ zag bcas zag pa med chos rnams/ /lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams/ /zag bcas gang phyir de dag la / /zag rnams kun tu rgyas par 'gyur/ /zag med lam gyi bden pa dang / /'dus ma byas rnam gsum yang ste/ /nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ /zhes spang blang bya ba'i gzhi zag bcas zag med gnyis kyi dbang du byas te gsungs pa'i so so'i mtshan gzhi ngos 'dzin pa la 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi rnam dbye legs par shes dgos la/ de la gzhi grub dang / de'i khyad par khyad gzhi ma 'dres pa nges dgos pas rang spyi bden gnyis/ mtshan nyid gsum/ dgag sgrub/ rdzas ldog sogs dang / 'dus byas kyi sger gyi khyad par rgyu 'bras che chung sogs dang / rtag dngos thams cad kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi khyad par nges byed kyi yan lag ldog pa ngos 'dzin/ yod rtogs med rtogs/ yul yul can/yin log min log spyi bye brag 'gal 'brel/ thal 'gyur che chung /drug sgra dris 'phangs sogs kyi rnam bzhag ston pa'i bsdus tshan 382

'jam dbyangs zhu 'phrin sogs/rnams la bsten nas/ chos rnams kyi gnas tshul ma 'dres par 'byed pa'i shes rab bskyed pa yin zhing bskyed pa ltar yang skye mod/shes rab zer ba de chos kyi gnas lugs rnam par 'byed pa'i rnam 'byed cig la nged 'dod kyang khyed ni byed mi byed la the tshom za'o /de ltar na shes bya'i gnas gang la blo kha bskor yang rmongs pa'i mun pa sangs pa zhig gis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa gcod dgos kyis/ kha dog dang dmar bo'i khyad par dris na 'go 'thom pa zhig la chos zab mo'i skal ba yod par dka' 'o/ /rtags gsal khyab gsum grub pa'i sbyor ba gcig gi 'go mjug mi 'phrod bzhin tu sbyangs 'phro la ma ltos par gnas lugs zab mo rtogs rgyu yod tshe gnas lugs de bsgrub ma dgos par grub pas dang po nyid nas chos thams cad mngon sum du shes pa'i rnal 'byor ba de ngo mtshar che'o/ /'o na shes rab de ltar bskyed pa de lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i nyams len du gyur tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ spyir na nyams len gyi 'bras bu thog med nas skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal rngam po che'i khar dbang med du 'dzud pa'i dgra'i dwangs ma nyon mongs rtsa ba nas 'byin pa zhig la byed pa nang ba sangs rgyas pa spyi'i lugs yin la/ de na spang bya nyon mongs bas rgyud grol dgos la/ de 383

grol ba'i thog mar rgyud smin pa zhig grol bar 'gyur bas/ smin grol gyi lam gnyis nges par dgos la/ smin byed mi rtag rtogs pa sogs kyi lam dang / grol byed bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis la ngos 'dzin no/ /
rjethang

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dze /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum kyi dkyil 'khor la stong mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga bzhugs so/ /༄sha /bla ma mchog dang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /dbyer med zhabs kyi pad mo la btud nas/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog mnyes byed stong mchod tshul/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin bsod nams spel phyir 'bri/ /de la 'dir yi dam khyad par can 'di'i dbang bzhi thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor sngon du btang nas/ ser sna'i ma sbags par ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa brgya stong la sogs pa bkod pa mdzes par bshams te/ kun slong rnam par dag pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams rgyud dang 'dres nges byas te 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ o hriḥnyis bsang / swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me ri dur khrod dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum pa nas/ lte ba'i 386

'jigs byed cho ga sogs/dbus su rgyu las 'khor lo rgyu gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi ba/ sogs nas/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas/ de'i nang du re'u mig dgu ba'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ gdan zung re re/gdan dbu ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa nang gi shar du k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣis mtshan pa nas/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po nas/ de'i bang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma nas/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po nas/bdud rtsis gang ba bzhir gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su k+ṣe nas/ nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ dzaḥ'ajam dpal rang bzhin chos rnams kun gyi dngos/nas o hrīḥha bho/ sogs/ rang gi thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi ye shes pa skye mched kyi lha rdo rje gsum dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ o gu ru ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wa ra arnya / sogs nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥsogs kyis 'gugs gzhug bcing mnye bya/ slar yang rang gi thugs ga'i 387

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros nas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta arnya/sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes/ sogs nas/ dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod phreng ni snga mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshams 'dir byin gyis brlab te / phyi mchod 'bul ba dngos ni/ rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing ske/ sogs kyis chu gsum sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dbul/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po be+eḍūr+ya/ sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga 'bul lo//'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan dag /sogs kyis rin chen bdun dang / sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar sogs kyis gos dang /badz+ra wasta rgyal ba mtshan dpe sogs kyis rgyan dang / badz+ra a laṅka ra brtse ba'i 'khor yug sogs kyis mchod pa'i yo spyad gzhan dbul / rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis sogs kyis bum pa bcud ldan 'bul lo/ /de nas nang gi mchod pa ni/ bde chen rigs lnga yab dang yum gyi rdzas/ /lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga sbyar te/ /rdo rje gsum gyis sbyang rtogs sbar ba 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod kyis dgyes par mdzod/ /lha so so'i sngags la/ o aḥrgyu btags pas 'bul/ de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/388

'jigs byed cho ga sogs/yid 'ong lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin drug sogs kyi dang / o ya mān+ta ka sa pā ri wa ra ma hā mu tra pra ti ts+tsha ye sā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis 'bul / de nas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ sgrib bral lhan skyes bde ba'i ye shes sogs dang / ma hā bo rnyi tsit+ta rtarma dha tu pra tits+tsha/sogs kyis 'bul/ de nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa dbul la bstod pa bya ba ni / bla ma gong ma so so'i mdzad pa'i bstod pa ji ltar rigs pa dang ske/ bsdu na/ gnyis med thun mong gshin rje gshed po tsam gyis bstod / de nas stong mchod kyi grangs gsog pa la/ mchod pa gsar ba ji ltar rigs pa bshams te byin gyis brlab pa'am/sarba badha sogs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas slar mchod sprin spel la/ zhing rnam par dag pa la mchod pa'i skal ba thob pa snyed pa legs par snyed pa'i 'du shes kyis dga' zhing spro ba dang bcas te rigs pa dwangs shing gsal ba'i ngang nas 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas (dang )/ /gzugs mchog sogs (dang )/ /nyon mongs bzhi dag gshin rje gshed po bzhi/ /bdud bzhi rnam bcom stobs chen khro rgyal bzhi / /khams bzhi gnas dag spyan sogs lha mo bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag bya/ oṃ trī ji 389

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ha / sogs dang / o gu ru ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wa ra rū pa nas/span pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ yang sngags de'i thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ ma hā sabha rat+na badz+ra wasta a laṅka ra ka la sha pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ o gu ru ya mān+ta ka maṇ+ḍa la de wa sa pa ri wa ra o āḥhū/ zhes nang mchod dang / de nas rgyun bshags bdun pa ni/ sdig pa rnams ni gshaṭa par bya nas/ bgyi(bar rgyud dang 'dres pas ngang )/ sa bzhi spos chus sogs kyis/ de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs cing thugs rgyud bskul ba ni/ o hrīḥsbyi sogs/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed yab yum gyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe bsrings shing mdzad phrin rgyas pa dang / rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang du 'phel zhing bshad sgrub chos spyod kyi bya ba gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang /bdag gis thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung 'bras bu dang bcas pa rnams dang chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag lhag med du zhi ba dang / khyad par du bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyang nas rnam 390

'jigs byed cho ga sogs/shes rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /'og ma dang mtha' ma sbyar te/ dzi na dzi ga sogs/ bcom ldan 'das gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum gyis/ sogs nas/ khyad par du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs nas gzugs phung rnam par dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byed pa'i phrin las mdzod cika/ rat+na jig/ bcom ldan 'das ser sna gshin rje'i gshed yab yum gyis/ sogs nas/ ser sna'i dri ma nas / tshor ba'i nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes nas/ mdzod cig/a ro lika/ bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed nas / 'dod chags kyi dri ma nas/ 'du shes nas/ so sor rtog pa'i nas/ mdzod cig/ pra ñja rnyika dbyug pa nas/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom le lo dang bral te brtson 'grus kyi stobs la/pad+ma sgrika/ pad+ma nas/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom brjed nges dang bral te dran pa'i stobs la/ khaṅga rnyika ral gri nas/ lha'i bu'i bdud nas/ rnam g.yeng dang nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la / mo ha ra ti tsa rtsi ka yab yum nas/ sa'i khams sbyangs/ khro ba dang bral te byams pa tshad med la 'god pa'i/ de sha ra ti phag mo 391

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yab yum nas/ chu'i khams sbyangs/ rnam par 'tshe ba dang bral te snying rje tshad med la/ ra ga ra ti dbyangs can ma yab yum nas/me'i khams sbyangs/ sems can bde ba dang ldan pa la mi bzod pa dang bral te dga' ba tshad med la/ badz+ra ra ti gi ri yab yum nas/rlung gi khams sbyangs/ bdag gzhan gyi phyogs gnyis su 'dzin pa'i phyogs ris dang bral te btang snyoms tshad med la 'god pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces 'dod don la rtse gcig tu gsol ba gdab bo/ /de ltar re re'i mthar ram stong tshang ba na dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bskor ba byed pa'am byed par mos la ma hā ra ta/ sogs dang bskor ba'i gzungs gnyis ci rigs bzla/de nas gtor ma ri lu stong dang bcas pa bshams la nang mchod lhar byin gyis rlabs nas/ mdun skyed kyi lha rnams kyis ljags hūṃ las skyes/ sogs nas/ gtso 'khor gyi gtor sngags rgyas pa lan bdun nam nyer gcig re dang / oṃ gu ru ya mān+ta ka maṇ+ḍa la de wa sa pa ri wa ra e dam ba ling ta kha hi/ stong gis dbul mthar/ chu gsum nyer spyod dang nang mchod kyang dbul la gtso 'khor gyi bstod pas bstod do/ /de nas 'dod don gsol ba ni/ rgyal ba rgya mcho'i zhing na/ sogs sbyar ro/ /phyogs skyong gi gtor ma 'bul 392

'jigs byed cho ga sogs/ba ni/ rang gi thugs ku'i hūṃ sngon po'i nas/ phyogs skyong bskyed lugs rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te/ phrin las mdzod cig bar bya / de nas chos rgyal gyi bskang gsol dang dbyug mchod kyang bya'o//mthar mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya ba ni/sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ bsod nams zhing du gyur ba'i/sogs kyis chu gsum nyer spyod dang bcas pa phul la/ lha so so'i sngags kyis mthar/ oṃ āḥrgyu/ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/gnyis med thun mong / gshin rje gshed po/ sogs kyis bstod nas / rnam dag yid kyi zla shel/ bzod gsol ni lag na me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar te gshin rje'i yig brgya lan gsum bzlas / gang yang bdag blo/ stsol cig/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur la/ yang na rten bzhugs bya/ de nas bdag bskyed bsdu ldang dang shis brjod bya'o/ /zhes dang la rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la stong mchod 'bul tshul gyi cho ga 'di ni bla ma dam pa rnams kyis zhabs pad brtan pa dang khyad par du yul 'di lta bur rje btsun tsong kha pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas kyi bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa'i phyir dang / rang gi bar chad 'ga' zhig sel 393

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ba'i phyir du dmigs nas/ shākya'i dge slong gi gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtshos rab rgyal me byi cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar po'i phyogs la rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du bris pa dza yan+tu/ dge'o/ /༄gi /na mo gu ru/ gnyis snang kun rtog g.yo byed rlung sems ma rig mdud pa/ /chos 'khor ze'u 'brur bgrol ba'i lhan skyes bde ba'i rol mo/ /dag pa'i ngo mtshar 'bum bkra ye shes sgyu ma'i sku mchog /ma rungs 'dul la khros pa'i bla ma gshin rje gshed po / /mi 'gyur 'og min zhing na kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan/ /mi srun gshin rje'i grong na khro rgyal 'jigs mdzad rdo rje/ /mi bzad sprul ba'i zhing du gzhan don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ /mi rtog bzhin du mdzad pa'i bla ma sku gsum dbang phyug /bde chen ye shes gcig gis shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus/ /lus pa med par gzigs pa'i khyab bdag bdag la dgongs la/ /mthing nag char sprin brtsegs 'dra'i 'jigs rung sgyu ma'i lang tsho/ /bdag gi mig gi bdud rtsir da lta nyid du mdzod cig /zhi drag zhal dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdzes shing rngam la brjid pa'i/ /dmar zlum ye shes spyan ras rgyud lnga'i 'gro la btsa' bzhin/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 394

'jigs byed cho ga sogs/bskul ba'i phe gyi nga ro dang bcas/ /gsang ba mchog gi sgra dbyangs rna ba'i bdud rtsir sgrogs shig /dngos grub dbang phyug dag pa'i srog chags bcu drug brdzis te/ /lha chen brgyad kyi gdan la bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis rol ba'i/ /lha yi lha mchog chen po khro la khros pa'i skur ston/ /rab 'bar zhugs phreng 'gyed bzhin bdag gi snying la zhugs shig /so bzhi'i phyag gi mtshan ma dgra sde 'jom pa'i mtshon chas/ /ma rungs dgra yi dwangs ma bdag gi gces 'dzin sgrol la/ /bcu drug zhabs kyi gar stabs bgegs tshogs 'dul ba'i bro chen/ /dngos 'dzin lhan skyes mgo bor da lta nyid du rdungs shig /bden gnyis rwa yi rtse la shes rab me dpung mched pa'i/ /drag shul ma he'i gdong gi zhal khyim bgrad pa'i stobs kyis/ /bdag yid ma rig bag chags 'khrul snang dang bcas gsol la/ /'od gsal dag pa'i mkha' dbyings mngon du mjal bar mdzod cig /sgrib gnyis gos kyi dreg pa ring mo zhig nas spangs te/ /gnyug ma'i rlung sems rang mdangs rjen par phyungs pa'i sku mchog /'jigs rung gcer bu'i nyams kyis rol ba ji bzhin bdag kyang / /g.yo byed phra ba'i 'phrul gyis dag pa'i sgyu mar grub mdzod/ /lhan skyes sku thugs zung 'jug mthar thug go 395

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'phangs mchog de/ /gang las 'ong ba'i thabs mchog gnyis med bde ba chen po/ /mtshon byed mtshan ma 'grengs pa'i brtul zhugs chen po'i spyod pas/ /bdag kyang tshe 'di nyid la bde chen mchog la sbyor cig /mi gnas myang 'das mtshon pa'i kham ser ral ba brjes shing / /gzhan phan phyin drug spyod pa'i rus pa'i rgyan drug 'khrol ba/ /zhe sdang lam du byed pa'i sbrul nag mchod phyir thogs pa'i / /bla ma lhag pa'i lha mchog bdag la brtse bas dgongs shig /ches phra'i srog gi ngo bo 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ /'od lnga'i gur khyim dbus na dmar ser 'od phung lam mer/ /ye shes ral gri 'phyar zhing sher phyin glegs bam bsnams pas/ /bdag gi rmongs mun sol la lam mchog snang ba stsol cig /rig brgya'i dbang phyug chen po rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi/ /zhabs zung bkra shis re kha 'gyur med khri la brtan cing / /skal ldan rdo rje'i mched po dam gtsang rig 'dzin tshogs kyang / /mi 'bral gsang chen chos la rtag tu rol bas 'da' mdzod/ /bdag kyang deng nas brtsams te ji srid byang chub bar du/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon bskrun pa'i dbang bzhi'i lam la brtson cing / /dam tshig sdom pa'i sked rags lhod pa med par bsdams te/ /rim gnyis chos kyi nyams len dbyar gyi 396

'jigs byed cho ga sogs/chu bzhin 'phel mdzod/ /khyad par sangs rgyas kun dang bsod nams zhing du mnyam pa'i/ /drin can bla ma mchog rnams mnyes pa gsum gyis mchod cing / /lugs bzang dri med mchod sdong 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs/ /srid mtha'i bar du 'dzin par byin gyis rlabs par mdzod cig /'jigs byed lha yi lha khyod lhag pa'i lha ru bzung bas/ /'jigs skrag 'khrul snang bdo ba'i skye 'chi bar do'i 'phrang ring / /'jigs med sku gsum ngo bor theg pa mchog gis bsgyur te/ /'jigs rung srid pa nyam ngar mchog sbyin dbugs dbyung stsol cig /bla ma lha yi byin rlabs bslu med sbrang char bzang pos/ /mos gus zhing sa brlan pa'i bde skyid nyams rtogs rkang bro/ /cir yang brdung ba'i dga' ston mchog thun grub pa'i mgron la/ /nyam thag ma rgan 'gro rnams myur du 'bod par gyur cig /lha mchog chen po'i bka' sdod phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje'i/ /ma rungs bdud sde'i g.yul ngo ming med phye mar brlags nas/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i ba dan srid rtser bsgrengs te/ /dge legs mchog gi snang bas sa steng khyab par mdzod cig /ces dpal ldan bla ma dang dpal gshin rje gshed la gdung 397

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba ni/ dpal gshin rje gshed mi yi zlos gar du bsgyur ba khyab bdag 'jam mgon bla ma 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang po'i gsung las skyes pa'i slob bu'i tha shal dharma sā ra zhes bya bas gzhi bsnyen chen mo'i thun gseng du bris pa dge bar gyur cig /

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ rin chen tshe ring /mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ kurma tshe ring /sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/deb dang po/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gzhung las khang gis bsdu sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa dang /si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/si khron ca khrong par 'debs tshad yod 'gan 'khri kung sis dpar/2006lo'i zla12par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2006lo'i zla12par par thengs dang po dpar/par grangs/ 0001wa 2000dpe rtags/1522978—7—5409—3370—8pod gsum po la rin sgor/ 60 00

(mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉 'tshol sdud dag sgrig dpe skrun bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gtso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gco gzhon pa/ byis tshe ring / dkon mchogaskal bzang tshe ring / bstan chos/ 'jigs med/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi(ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)dkon mchog skal bzang tshe ring / klu skyabs/dge legs/ mgon lha/ gces ma/'ju skal bzang / 'jigs med/ bstan chos/thub bzang / dung gces/ nor sde/pad ma rnam rgyal/ byis tshe ring /
